zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 打造 29 种编辑级图表，纯 HTML+SVG
zh.what: 这是一个 Claude Code 技能（skill），能生成 29 种编辑级质量的图表，如架构图、流程图、时序图等。所有图表均为自包含的 HTML+SVG，无外部依赖，可直接在浏览器打开。它还能将 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源文件重绘为指定格式、尺寸和细节级别。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能文件、文档和截图，展示了 27 种视觉类型（README 提到 29 种，可能版本更新）的三种静态变体：极简浅色、极简深色和完整编辑风格。每种类型都有对应的 HTML 模板，无需构建步骤。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript、无外部图片依赖。作为 Claude Code 技能，也兼容 Codex 和 Pi。
zh.hot: 今日新增 2855 星，总星数破万，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了 AI 生成图表千篇一律的痛点，提供编辑级设计，让图表不再像“Mermaid 垃圾”。
uses: 内容创作者和博主：快速生成与网站风格一致的图表，提升文章专业度。
开发者：在文档或代码注释中嵌入高质量图表，无需手动设计。
产品经理和架构师：用语义化模式描述系统行为，自动生成清晰图表。
设计师：作为快速原型工具，避免繁琐的 Figma 操作。

en.tag: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, self-contained HTML+SVG
en.what: A Claude Code skill that generates 29 editorial-quality diagram types, including architecture, flowchart, sequence, and more. All diagrams are self-contained HTML+SVG with no external dependencies, openable directly in a browser. It can also redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources at a chosen format, size, and detail level.
en.content: The repo contains the skill files, docs, and screenshots showcasing 27 visual types (README mentions 29, possibly updated) in three static variants: minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial. Each type has an HTML template, no build step required.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, no JavaScript, no external image dependencies. As a Claude Code skill, it's also compatible with Codex and Pi.
en.hot: Gained 2,855 stars today, surpassing 10k total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily list. It solves the pain point of generic AI-generated diagrams, offering editorial design that avoids 'Mermaid-slop'.
uses: Content creators and bloggers: quickly generate diagrams matching their website style to enhance professionalism.
Developers: embed high-quality diagrams in docs or code comments without manual design.
Product managers and architects: use semantic patterns to describe system behavior and auto-generate clear diagrams.
Designers: as a rapid prototyping tool to avoid tedious Figma operations.

zh.tag: 团队一体化协作工作台，AI 记忆贯穿所有模块
zh.what: Macro 是一个为团队打造的统一工作空间，将邮件、聊天、文档、任务、代理、通话和 CRM 集成在一个快速界面中，并共享团队级 AI 记忆。所有内容通过 @ 链接和双向图关联，可搜索，让团队和 AI 代理无需切换工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Macro 应用源代码，采用模块化 'blocks' 架构（如 Email、Messages、Tasks、Docs、Canvas、Agents 等），每个块都针对特定功能优化，但共享同一后端和双向图数据模型。
zh.stack: 前端使用 SolidJS，后端使用 Rust，文档基于 CRDT 实现实时协作，采用双向图存储交叉引用。
zh.hot: 今日新增 248 星，登上 Rust 日榜第二，因其重新定义团队工作软件的愿景，以及将 AI 代理深度集成到所有工作流中的创新设计。
uses: 初创公司或大型企业中的小团队，希望用一个系统替代 Slack、Linear、Notion 等多个工具。
技术团队需要高效沟通和任务管理，并希望 AI 代理辅助日常工作。
对 Rust 和 SolidJS 技术栈感兴趣的开发者，可学习其模块化架构和双向图实现。

en.tag: All-in-one team workspace with shared AI memory across email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, and CRM
en.what: Macro is a unified workspace for teams that integrates email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM into a single fast interface with shared team-level AI memory. Everything is @-linked and searchable via a bidirectional graph, so teams and agents never need to switch tools.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Macro app, built with modular 'blocks' (Email, Messages, Tasks, Docs, Canvas, Agents, etc.), each purpose-built but sharing a common backend and bidirectional graph data model.
en.stack: Frontend in SolidJS, backend in Rust, docs built on CRDTs for real-time collaboration, and cross-references stored as a bidirectional graph.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, ranking #2 on the Rust daily trending list, due to its ambitious vision to redesign team work software and its innovative integration of AI agents across all workflows.
uses: Startups or small teams in larger companies looking to replace multiple tools like Slack, Linear, Notion with one system.
Technical teams needing efficient communication and task management with AI agent assistance.
Developers interested in Rust and SolidJS, learning from its modular architecture and bidirectional graph implementation.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源图原生上下文与决策基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它能够摄取企业数据，提取关键信息，构建上下文图与知识图谱，并支持图分析和因果推理，同时内置完整的决策溯源。该系统强调可解释、可追踪和可信赖，专为高风险和受监管领域设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档和示例，支持多语言图存储（RDF 和 LPG），遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理和知识建模功能。项目采用模块化设计，便于自托管和审计。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python（3.8+），依赖图数据库和知识图谱技术，支持 RDF 和 LPG 存储，遵循 W3C 标准。可能涉及因果推理和决策智能相关库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1102 星，总星数达 3323，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 13 名。其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，填补了企业级上下文管理和决策溯源的需求，在 AI 信任与合规领域引发关注。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统构建可解释、可审计的上下文管理平台。
受监管行业（金融、医疗）：要求决策可追溯、符合合规要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用图原生基础设施进行知识建模和因果推理。
AI 研究者：探索上下文感知和可问责 AI 系统的实现。

en.tag: Open-source graph-native infrastructure for context and accountable AI systems
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds a Context Graph and knowledge graph, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance. It is explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design, built for high-stakes, regulated domains.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples. It supports polyglot graph storage (RDF and LPG), adheres to W3C standards, and offers ontology management and knowledge modeling. The project is modular, self-hostable, and auditable.
en.stack: Primarily Python (3.8+), leveraging graph database and knowledge graph technologies, supporting RDF and LPG storage, and adhering to W3C standards. It likely incorporates libraries for causal reasoning and decision intelligence.
en.hot: Gained 1,102 stars this week, reaching 3,323 total, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending (Python) weekly. Positioned as 'The Open Source Palantir for AI Agents', it addresses enterprise context management and decision provenance, sparking interest in AI trust and compliance.
uses: Enterprise AI teams: needing an explainable, auditable context management platform for agent systems.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare): requiring traceable decisions and compliance.
Knowledge graph developers: leveraging graph-native infrastructure for knowledge modeling and causal reasoning.
AI researchers: exploring implementations of context-aware and accountable AI systems.

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 一站式AI代理团队，即装即用
zh.what: 这是一个包含多种专业AI代理的集合，每个代理都有独特的个性和专长，旨在提升工作效率。它源自Reddit讨论，经过数月迭代，提供从前端开发到社区管理等各类专家代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含大量精心设计的代理配置文件（如Markdown格式），每个代理都有明确的职责、流程和交付物。还提供了安装脚本和桌面应用，支持一键安装到Claude Code、Cursor等工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用Shell脚本进行安装和管理，代理配置以Markdown文件形式存在，兼容多种AI编码工具。桌面应用支持macOS、Linux和Windows。
zh.hot: 140k+星标，今日新增858，因其提供即插即用的AI代理团队，满足开发者对高效AI工作流的需求，且安装便捷，迅速走红。
uses: 开发者希望快速为Claude Code、Cursor等工具添加专业AI助手
团队需要标准化AI代理配置以提升协作效率
对AI代理个性化和专业化感兴趣的研究者或爱好者

en.tag: One-click AI agent team, ready to use
en.what: A collection of specialized AI agents with distinct personalities and expertise, designed to enhance productivity. Born from a Reddit thread and refined over months, it offers experts ranging from frontend development to community management.
en.content: The repo contains numerous meticulously crafted agent configuration files (e.g., Markdown), each with clear responsibilities, processes, and deliverables. It also includes installation scripts and a desktop app for one-click installation into tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for installation and management, agent configs are Markdown files, compatible with various AI coding tools. Desktop app supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: 140k+ stars, +858 today, popular for its plug-and-play AI agent team, meeting developers' need for efficient AI workflows with easy installation.
uses: Developers wanting to quickly add specialized AI assistants to tools like Claude Code, Cursor
Teams needing standardized AI agent configs to boost collaboration
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in personalized and specialized AI agents

zh.tag: 首个开源金融K线基础模型，解码市场语言
zh.what: Kronos 是首个专为金融K线（OHLCV）设计的开源基础模型，采用两阶段框架：先用专用分词器将连续多维K线数据量化为分层离散令牌，再用自回归Transformer在大规模数据上预训练，以统一处理多种量化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型架构、预训练与微调脚本、实时演示（如BTC/US预测）、论文及Hugging Face模型权重，支持多语言README。
zh.stack: 基于Python，依赖PyTorch、Transformers等深度学习库，模型为decoder-only Transformer，数据来自45+全球交易所。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源金融K线基础模型，填补领域空白，且被AAAI 2026接收，star数达36k+，今日新增238，热度持续攀升。
uses: 量化研究员与交易员：用于市场预测、趋势分析等任务
金融AI开发者：基于预训练模型微调，适配自有量化策略
学术研究者：作为金融时序基础模型的基线或研究对象
金融教育者：用于演示K线数据建模与生成式AI应用

en.tag: First open-source foundation model for financial K-lines, decoding market language
en.what: Kronos is the first open-source foundation model specifically designed for financial candlesticks (OHLCV), using a two-stage framework: a specialized tokenizer quantizes continuous multi-dimensional K-line data into hierarchical discrete tokens, followed by pre-training a large autoregressive Transformer on these tokens to serve as a unified model for diverse quantitative tasks.
en.content: The repository includes model architecture, pre-training and fine-tuning scripts, a live demo (e.g., BTC/US forecasting), the paper, and Hugging Face model weights, with multi-language README support.
en.stack: Built with Python, relying on deep learning libraries like PyTorch and Transformers; the model is a decoder-only Transformer trained on data from over 45 global exchanges.
en.hot: As the first open-source foundation model for financial K-lines, it fills a gap in the field and has been accepted by AAAI 2026; with 36k+ stars and 238 added today, its popularity keeps rising.
uses: Quant researchers and traders: for market forecasting and trend analysis
Financial AI developers: fine-tune the pre-trained model for custom quant strategies
Academic researchers: as a baseline or research subject for financial time-series foundation models
Finance educators: to demonstrate K-line data modeling and generative AI applications

zh.tag: 多平台自媒体数据采集工具
zh.what: MediaCrawler 是一个强大的多平台自媒体数据采集工具，支持小红书、抖音、快手、B站、微博、贴吧、知乎等主流平台的公开信息抓取。它基于 Playwright 浏览器自动化框架，通过保留登录态和 JS 表达式获取签名参数，无需逆向复杂的加密算法，大幅降低技术门槛。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的爬虫实现，支持关键词搜索、指定帖子ID爬取、二级评论、指定创作者主页、登录态缓存、IP代理池、生成评论词云图等功能。代码结构清晰，包含文档和示例，并提供了 MediaCrawlerPro 商业版本的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 语言，基于 Playwright 浏览器自动化框架，利用 JS 表达式获取签名参数，无需逆向加密算法。依赖包括 Playwright、Pandas 等常见数据处理库。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有 60,998 颗星，今日新增 259 颗，位列 Trending 日榜第 3 名。其火爆原因在于它解决了爬虫技术中的痛点——无需 JS 逆向，降低了使用门槛，同时覆盖了多个主流平台，功能全面，吸引了大量开发者和数据爱好者。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，用于收集社交媒体数据进行舆情分析、市场研究等。
开发者，用于学习爬虫技术、浏览器自动化以及多平台数据采集的实现。
内容创作者和营销人员，用于监控竞品动态、收集用户评论反馈。
学术研究者，用于采集公开数据以支持社会科学或计算机科学研究。

en.tag: Multi-platform social media data crawler
en.what: MediaCrawler is a powerful multi-platform social media data collection tool that supports crawling public information from mainstream platforms such as Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Weibo, Tieba, and Zhihu. It is based on the Playwright browser automation framework, preserving login state and using JS expressions to obtain signature parameters, eliminating the need to reverse-engineer complex encryption algorithms and significantly lowering the technical barrier.
en.content: The repository contains a complete crawler implementation, supporting keyword search, crawling by post ID, second-level comments, designated creator homepages, login state caching, IP proxy pools, and generating comment word clouds. The code is well-structured, includes documentation and examples, and provides a link to the commercial MediaCrawlerPro version.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, based on the Playwright browser automation framework, using JS expressions to obtain signature parameters without reverse-engineering encryption algorithms. Dependencies include Playwright, Pandas, and other common data processing libraries.
en.hot: The project has 60,998 stars on GitHub, with 259 new stars today, ranking 3rd on the daily trending list. Its popularity stems from solving a key pain point in web scraping—no JS reverse engineering needed—lowering the barrier to entry, while covering multiple mainstream platforms with comprehensive features, attracting many developers and data enthusiasts.
uses: Data scientists and analysts, for collecting social media data for sentiment analysis, market research, etc.
Developers, for learning web scraping techniques, browser automation, and multi-platform data collection implementation.
Content creators and marketers, for monitoring competitor activity and gathering user feedback.
Academic researchers, for collecting public data to support social science or computer science research.

zh.tag: AI 一键生成原生可编辑 PPT，支持模板、图表与配音
zh.what: PPT Master 是一个 AI 工具，能将文档或主题自动转换为真正的原生 PowerPoint 演示文稿。它生成的是包含原生形状、过渡和动画的 PPTX 文件，而非图片或 PDF，并支持按需添加数据图表、表格、音频旁白，以及使用你自己的 .pptx 模板。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 实现的完整代码、文档（README 中英文版）、示例和配置，以及用于展示功能的演示资源。项目结构清晰，包含核心生成引擎、模板处理、图表生成和音频合成等模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 LLM API（如 Kimi）进行内容理解和生成，使用 python-pptx 等库创建原生 PPTX，可能集成图表库和 TTS 引擎。
zh.hot: 45.5k stars 且日增近 500，因其解决了 AI 生成 PPT 的痛点——输出原生可编辑文件，而非静态图片，并支持模板、图表和配音，实用性强。
uses: 职场人士：快速将报告或文档转为专业演示文稿
教育工作者：将讲义或论文生成教学幻灯片
开发者：集成到自动化工作流中批量生成 PPT
设计师：使用自定义模板保持品牌一致性

en.tag: AI turns documents into native, editable PPTX with charts, narration, and templates
en.what: PPT Master is an AI tool that converts documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint presentations. It generates PPTX files with native shapes, transitions, and animations, not images or PDFs, and supports on-demand data charts, tables, audio narration, and your own .pptx templates.
en.content: The repository contains the full Python implementation, documentation (README in English and Chinese), examples, and configuration, along with demo assets. The project has a clear structure with modules for core generation, template handling, chart creation, and audio synthesis.
en.stack: Built with Python, relies on LLM APIs (e.g., Kimi) for content understanding and generation, uses python-pptx to create native PPTX, and may integrate chart libraries and TTS engines.
en.hot: With 45.5k stars and ~500 daily, it solves a key pain point: AI-generated PPTs are often static images, but this outputs native editable files, with templates, charts, and narration, making it highly practical.
uses: Professionals: quickly turn reports or documents into polished presentations
Educators: generate teaching slides from lecture notes or papers
Developers: integrate into automated workflows for batch PPT generation
Designers: use custom templates to maintain brand consistency

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 构建上下文层
zh.what: RAGFlow 是一个领先的开源检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将前沿的 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力相结合，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量的上下文层。它支持深度文档理解、基于模板的文本切片、可配置的 Agent 工作流，以及基于引用的可追溯回答，确保输出的准确性和可验证性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RAGFlow 系统，包括后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 界面、Agent 工作流编排、文档解析与索引模块，以及 Docker 部署配置。提供多语言 README、云服务入口和详细文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发后端，前端基于 Web 技术；依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，集成多种 LLM 和向量数据库，支持深度文档理解与 RAG 流程。
zh.hot: RAGFlow 凭借其将 RAG 与 Agent 结合的创新理念，以及强大的文档处理能力和可追溯回答，在 GitHub 上获得 87k+ 星标，今日新增 85 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 20 名，持续受到开发者社区的高度关注。
uses: 企业知识库构建：利用 RAGFlow 搭建内部文档问答系统，提升信息检索效率。
AI 应用开发者：集成 RAGFlow 作为 LLM 应用的上下文层，增强回答准确性和可追溯性。
研究机构：用于学术文献的深度解析和知识抽取，辅助研究分析。
开源爱好者：学习 RAG 与 Agent 结合的架构设计，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Open-source RAG engine fusing RAG with Agent capabilities for LLM context layer
en.what: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs. It supports deep document understanding, template-based chunking, configurable Agent workflows, and citation-based traceable answers, ensuring accuracy and verifiability.
en.content: The repository contains the full RAGFlow system, including backend services (written in Go), frontend web UI, Agent workflow orchestration, document parsing and indexing modules, and Docker deployment configurations. It provides multi-language READMEs, cloud service entry, and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Backend primarily developed in Go, frontend based on web technologies; relies on Docker for containerized deployment, integrates multiple LLMs and vector databases, supporting deep document understanding and RAG pipelines.
en.hot: RAGFlow has gained 87k+ stars on GitHub due to its innovative fusion of RAG with Agent capabilities, powerful document processing, and traceable answers. With 85 new stars today, it ranks #20 on the Go trending list, maintaining high attention from the developer community.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Build internal document Q&A systems to improve information retrieval efficiency.
AI app developers: Integrate RAGFlow as a context layer for LLM applications, enhancing answer accuracy and traceability.
Research institutions: Use for deep parsing and knowledge extraction of academic literature to aid research analysis.
Open-source enthusiasts: Learn the architecture of combining RAG with Agent and contribute to the community.

zh.tag: AI 代理团队的企业级编排平台
zh.what: Paperclip 是一个开源应用，用于管理工作场景中的 AI 代理团队。它允许用户自带代理，分配目标，并在一个仪表盘中跟踪工作进度和成本。它像任务管理器，但底层包含组织架构、预算、治理、目标对齐和代理协调。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Node.js 服务器和 React UI，用于编排 AI 代理团队。提供快速入门指南、文档、Discord 社区链接，并支持与 OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 Bash 等集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 和 React 构建。依赖包括各种 AI 代理提供商（如 Claude、Codex）和工具（如 Bash）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理在工作场景中的普及，Paperclip 提供了管理代理团队的企业级解决方案，填补了市场空白。其 76k+ 的 star 数表明社区高度关注，今日新增 198 星，位列日榜第五。
uses: 企业团队：需要协调多个 AI 代理完成业务目标的管理者。
开发者：希望为代理分配任务并监控其表现的工程师。
AI 爱好者：探索如何将 AI 代理应用于实际业务流程的实践者。

en.tag: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents
en.what: Paperclip is an open-source app for managing AI agents at work. It lets you bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs from one dashboard. It looks like a task manager but underneath handles org charts, budgets, governance, goal alignment, and agent coordination.
en.content: The repo contains a Node.js server and React UI for orchestrating teams of AI agents. It includes a quickstart guide, docs, Discord community link, and integrations with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Bash.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, primarily using Node.js and React. It integrates with various AI agent providers (e.g., Claude, Codex) and tools like Bash.
en.hot: As AI agents become common in the workplace, Paperclip offers an enterprise-grade solution for managing agent teams, filling a market gap. Its 76k+ stars show high community interest, with 198 new stars today, ranking 5th on the daily trending list.
uses: Enterprise teams: managers needing to coordinate multiple AI agents to achieve business goals.
Developers: engineers who want to assign tasks to agents and monitor their performance.
AI enthusiasts: practitioners exploring how to apply AI agents to real-world business processes.

zh.tag: LLM 流量代理与协议翻译，让代理用上开源模型
zh.what: Switchyard 是一个 Rust 编写的 LLM 流量代理和库，用于在提供商之间路由请求，并在 OpenAI Chat、Anthropic Messages 和 OpenAI Responses 格式之间进行翻译。它支持将 Claude Code 或 Codex 等编码代理指向开源模型，同时保持代理使用其原生 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的代理服务器（switchyard-server）、命令行启动器（switchyard launch）以及可嵌入的库。提供协议翻译、多后端路由（随机、LLM 分类器、信号驱动等）和 Prometheus 指标。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，使用 Cargo 构建。CLI 通过 uv 安装，支持 Python 3.10 环境。依赖 OpenRouter API 密钥进行启动，可配置 TOML 路由文件。
zh.hot: 今日新增 421 星，总星数 819，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。它解决了将编码代理连接到开源模型的痛点，提供协议翻译和灵活路由，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 开发者希望用 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理连接开源模型（如 vLLM、NVIDIA NIM、Ollama）
需要跨多个模型进行 A/B 测试或基准测试的团队
希望实现自定义路由算法或信号驱动路由的 AI 应用开发者
需要统一监控 LLM 流量指标（如延迟、令牌数）的运维人员

en.tag: Rust proxy for LLM traffic: translate APIs, route across backends, and run coding agents on open models
en.what: Switchyard is a Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic that routes requests across providers and translates between OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses formats. It enables coding agents like Claude Code or Codex to point at open-source models while keeping the agent speaking its native API.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust proxy server (switchyard-server), a CLI launcher (switchyard launch), and an embeddable library. It offers protocol translation, multi-backend routing (random, LLM-as-classifier, signal-driven), and Prometheus metrics.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with Cargo. The CLI is installed via uv with Python 3.10. It uses OpenRouter API keys for launching and supports TOML route configuration.
en.hot: Gained 421 stars today (total 819), ranking #11 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of connecting coding agents to open-source models with protocol translation and flexible routing, drawing significant attention.
uses: Developers who want to use coding agents like Claude Code or Codex with open-source models (vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama)
Teams needing A/B testing or benchmarking across multiple models
AI app developers wanting custom routing algorithms or signal-driven stage routing
Operators needing unified metrics (latency, tokens) for LLM traffic

zh.tag: AI 助教驱动的英语学习应用与开源教材
zh.what: 这是一个将 AI 作为外语老师的英语学习项目，提供网页版、浏览器插件和桌面版应用，包含视频、电子书、闪卡、课程等学习形式。同时收录了《人人都能用英语》和《一千小时》等开源教材，指导用户通过大量输入和练习掌握英语。

教师/教练：作为辅助教学工具推荐给学生

en.tag: AI-assisted English learning app with open-source book
en.what: This project leverages AI as a foreign language teacher, offering web, browser extension, and desktop apps with video, ebook, flashcard, and course formats. It also includes open-source books like 'Everyone Can Use English' and '1000 Hours' to guide users through extensive input and practice.
en.content: The repo contains the Enjoy app source code (TypeScript), web deployment, browser extension (YouTube/Netflix), desktop plans, and full book content for 'Everyone Can Use English' and '1000 Hours'.

Developers: learn TypeScript full-stack and extension dev
Content creators: reuse open-source materials

zh.tag: 开源 OSINT 自动化工具，用于威胁情报与攻击面测绘
zh.what: SpiderFoot 是一个开源情报（OSINT）自动化工具，集成大量数据源并利用多种分析方法，帮助用户收集、分析数据并导航。它提供基于 Web 的界面和命令行两种使用方式，支持攻击面监控和威胁情报收集。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SpiderFoot 的完整源代码，包括 200 多个模块、Web 界面、CLI、YAML 配置的相关性引擎（含 37 个预定义规则）、CSV/JSON/GEXF 导出、SQLite 后端、Dockerfile 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.7+ 编写，依赖包括 SQLite、YAML、Docker，并集成 TOR、DNSTwist、Whatweb、Nmap 和 CMSeeK 等外部工具。
zh.hot: SpiderFoot 拥有 20k+ 星标，今日新增 74 星，因其在网络安全领域的重要性和长期活跃开发（自 2012 年）而广受欢迎，成为 OSINT 和攻击面管理的首选工具。
uses: 安全分析师：用于威胁情报收集和攻击面测绘。
渗透测试人员：在授权评估中快速侦察目标信息。
DevOps/安全团队：持续监控外部资产暴露面。
研究人员：探索 OSINT 数据源和分析方法。

en.tag: Open-source OSINT automation for threat intelligence and attack surface mapping
en.what: SpiderFoot is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) automation tool that integrates with numerous data sources and employs various analysis methods to help users collect, analyze, and navigate data. It offers both a web-based interface and command-line usage, supporting attack surface monitoring and threat intelligence gathering.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of SpiderFoot, including 200+ modules, web UI, CLI, YAML-configurable correlation engine with 37 pre-defined rules, CSV/JSON/GEXF export, SQLite backend, Dockerfile, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python 3.7+, with dependencies including SQLite, YAML, Docker, and integrations with external tools like TOR, DNSTwist, Whatweb, Nmap, and CMSeeK.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and 74 new stars today, SpiderFoot's popularity stems from its critical role in cybersecurity and its active development since 2012, making it a go-to tool for OSINT and attack surface management.
uses: Security analysts: for threat intelligence gathering and attack surface mapping.
Penetration testers: for rapid reconnaissance during authorized assessments.
DevOps/security teams: for continuous monitoring of external asset exposure.
Researchers: to explore OSINT data sources and analysis methods.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台本地文件传输工具，无需互联网
zh.what: LocalSend 是一款免费开源的跨平台应用，允许用户通过本地网络在附近设备间安全地分享文件和消息，无需互联网连接或第三方服务器。它使用 REST API 和 HTTPS 加密确保通信安全，是 AirDrop 的替代方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用源代码，支持 Android、iOS、macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台，并提供多语言翻译、构建指南和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Dart 语言开发，基于 Flutter 框架，利用 REST API 和 HTTPS 实现设备间通信。
zh.hot: 作为 AirDrop 的跨平台替代品，LocalSend 解决了不同设备间文件传输的痛点，拥有 87k+ 星标，今日新增 213 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 需要跨平台（如 Windows 与 iPhone）传输文件的用户
注重隐私、希望避免云端中转的用户
在局域网环境中快速分享文件的办公或家庭场景

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform local file sharing, no internet needed
en.what: LocalSend is a free, open-source cross-platform app that enables secure file and message sharing between nearby devices over a local network without internet. It uses REST API and HTTPS encryption, serving as an AirDrop alternative.
en.content: The repo contains full source code for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux, along with translation files, build instructions, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built with Dart and Flutter, using REST API and HTTPS for device communication.
en.hot: As a cross-platform AirDrop alternative, it solves cross-device file transfer pain points, with 87k+ stars and 213 new stars today, remaining popular.
uses: Users needing cross-platform file transfer (e.g., Windows to iPhone)
Privacy-conscious users avoiding cloud intermediaries
Office or home scenarios requiring quick LAN sharing

zh.tag: 首个DiT架构音视频统一生成模型官方推理与LoRA训练包
zh.what: LTX-2 是一个基于 DiT 的音频-视频生成基础模型，能在单一模型中实现同步音视频生成、高保真输出、多种性能模式和生产级 API。该仓库提供官方 Python 推理代码和 LoRA 训练器，方便开发者本地运行和微调模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的推理管线（ltx-pipelines）、LoRA 训练器、模型下载脚本、示例代码和优化文档，支持通过 uv 快速安装依赖。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Hugging Face Transformers、Diffusers 等，并可选 natten 加速视频 VAE 解码。
zh.hot: 作为首个 DiT 音视频统一模型，LTX-2 凭借开源权重和官方训练支持，在 GitHub 上迅速获得 8700+ 星标，日增 65 星，跻身趋势榜第 15 名。
uses: AI 研究人员：研究音视频生成模型架构与训练方法
内容创作者：快速生成带同步音频的高质量视频
开发者：集成 LTX-2 到应用或进行 LoRA 微调定制风格

en.tag: Official inference & LoRA trainer for LTX-2, the first DiT-based audio-video foundation model
en.what: LTX-2 is a DiT-based audio-video foundation model that unifies synchronized audio and video generation, high fidelity, multiple performance modes, and production-ready API access. This repo provides the official Python inference and LoRA trainer for local use and fine-tuning.
en.content: The repo includes full inference pipelines (ltx-pipelines), a LoRA trainer, model download scripts, examples, and optimization docs, with quick setup via uv.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Diffusers, with optional natten for accelerated video VAE decoding.
en.hot: As the first DiT-based unified audio-video model, LTX-2 quickly gained 8700+ stars with +65 today, ranking #15 on GitHub Trending, thanks to open weights and official training support.
uses: AI researchers: study audio-video generative model architecture and training
Content creators: quickly generate high-quality videos with synchronized audio
Developers: integrate LTX-2 into apps or fine-tune with LoRA for custom styles

zh.tag: JVM 上的智能体框架，Kotlin 编写
zh.what: Embabel Agent Framework 是一个专为 JVM 设计的智能体（Agent）开发框架，支持构建基于大语言模型的自主代理应用。它提供了完整的工具链和运行时支持，让开发者能够快速搭建、部署和管理 AI 智能体。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个模块，如 embabel-agent-api（核心 API）、embabel-agent-core（核心实现）等，并附带文档、示例和 CI/CD 配置。项目采用 Maven 构建，提供 Maven Central 发布版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Kotlin 和 Java，基于 Spring/Spring Boot 框架，支持 Apache Tomcat、Maven、JUnit 5，并集成 OpenAI API、Jinja 模板、JSON、GitHub Actions、SonarQube 和 Docker。
zh.hot: 作为 JVM 生态中少有的智能体框架，它填补了 Kotlin/Java 开发者构建 AI 代理的空白，上线即获得 4220 星，日增 40 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 16 名。
uses: JVM 开发者：希望用 Kotlin/Java 构建 AI 智能体应用
企业级应用：需要与 Spring Boot 等现有 Java 技术栈集成
AI 应用开发者：寻求可扩展、可部署的代理框架

en.tag: Agent framework for the JVM, written in Kotlin
en.what: Embabel Agent Framework is an agent development framework designed for the JVM, enabling the construction of autonomous agent applications powered by large language models. It provides a complete toolchain and runtime support for quickly building, deploying, and managing AI agents.
en.content: The repository contains multiple modules such as embabel-agent-api (core API) and embabel-agent-core (core implementation), along with documentation, examples, and CI/CD configuration. The project is built with Maven and publishes releases to Maven Central.
en.stack: Primarily uses Kotlin and Java, built on Spring/Spring Boot, with support for Apache Tomcat, Maven, JUnit 5, and integrates OpenAI API, Jinja templating, JSON, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, and Docker.
en.hot: As a rare agent framework in the JVM ecosystem, it fills the gap for Kotlin/Java developers building AI agents, quickly gaining 4,220 stars with 40 new stars today, ranking #16 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: JVM developers: wanting to build AI agent applications in Kotlin/Java
Enterprise applications: needing integration with existing Java stacks like Spring Boot
AI app developers: seeking an extensible, deployable agent framework

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 跨平台用户名搜索工具，OSINT 侦察利器

zh.hot: 拥有近 9 万 star，今日新增 235，长期霸榜 GitHub Trending。作为开源 OSINT 工具的代表，它简单实用，被安全研究人员和隐私爱好者广泛使用。

隐私保护者检查自己的用户名是否被滥用
招聘人员或背景调查者快速了解候选人网络足迹
记者或调查人员追踪网络身份

en.tag: Cross-platform username search tool for OSINT reconnaissance
en.what: Sherlock is a command-line tool written in Python that hunts down social media accounts by username across 400+ social networks. It checks username availability on various platforms to help users quickly map a person's online presence.
en.content: The repository includes full Python source code, CLI, site list (sites.md), installation instructions, usage docs, and demo images. It supports multiple output formats (text, CSV, Excel, JSON) and advanced features like proxy, timeout, and batch queries.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, using libraries like requests for HTTP requests. Installable via pip/pipx/uv, with Docker image available.
en.hot: With nearly 90k stars and 235 added today, it consistently ranks on GitHub Trending. As a flagship open-source OSINT tool, it's simple and practical, widely used by security researchers and privacy enthusiasts.

en.what: Transformers is Hugging Face's core library providing a unified API to load, train, and run thousands of pretrained models for text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. It streamlines workflows from research to production, supporting PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX.
en.content: The repo includes model architecture implementations, preprocessing tools, training loops, numerous example scripts, documentation, and integration with the model Hub.
en.stack: Python-based, with core dependencies on PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX, plus tokenizers, huggingface_hub, and more.
en.hot: As a cornerstone project in AI, it has 163k stars with 80 new stars daily, consistently attracting developer attention. Its ease of use and ecosystem integration make it the go-to for model deployment and fine-tuning.
uses: Researchers quickly implementing and comparing latest models
Engineers integrating pretrained models into production apps
Educators teaching and demonstrating NLP/CV techniques
Developers sharing and reusing models via the Hub

zh.tag: 本地运行与训练大模型和扩散模型的桌面应用
zh.what: Unsloth 是一个本地优先的 AI 工具，允许用户在个人电脑上运行和训练大型语言模型（LLM）和扩散模型。它支持包括 Qwen3.8、Kimi K3、MiniMax-H3、Gemma 4、DeepSeek-V4 和 FLUX 在内的多种模型，并提供桌面应用和命令行安装方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）、命令行安装脚本、文档和示例笔记本。核心功能是模型运行、训练和部署，并支持与 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 等代理工具集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构。桌面应用可能使用 Electron 或类似技术打包。
zh.hot: Unsloth 因提供本地运行和训练 AI 模型的便捷方式而广受欢迎，star 数已达 7 万，日增 592，反映了用户对隐私和本地控制的需求。
uses: AI 开发者和研究者：在本地快速实验和微调模型，无需云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望数据不出本地，避免云端泄露风险。
教育者与学生：学习模型训练和推理，无需昂贵硬件。
代理工具用户：将本地模型与 Claude Code、Codex 等集成，构建自动化工作流。

en.tag: Local desktop app to run and train LLMs and diffusion models
en.what: Unsloth is a local-first AI tool that lets users run and train large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models on their own hardware. It supports a wide range of models including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, and FLUX, and offers a desktop app as well as command-line installation.
en.content: The repository contains desktop app installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux, command-line install scripts, documentation, and example notebooks. Core features include model running, training, and deployment, with integrations for agent tools like Claude Code, Codex, and MCP.
en.stack: Built with Python, relying on deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, supporting multiple model architectures. The desktop app is likely packaged with Electron or similar technology.
en.hot: Unsloth is popular for providing a convenient way to run and train AI models locally, with 70k stars and 592 new stars today, reflecting the demand for privacy and local control.
uses: AI developers and researchers: quickly experiment and fine-tune models locally without cloud services.
Privacy-conscious users: keep data on-device to avoid cloud leaks.
Educators and students: learn model training and inference without expensive hardware.
Agent tool users: integrate local models with Claude Code, Codex, etc., for automated workflows.

zh.tag: 用LLM把文档编译成结构化wiki，无向量库的RAG替代
zh.what: OpenKB是一个开源命令行系统，利用LLM将原始文档编译成结构化的、互链的wiki知识库。它基于PageIndex的无向量、基于推理的检索，支持长文档，并自动维护摘要、概念页和交叉引用，让知识随时间累积。
zh.content: 仓库包含CLI工具、文档、配置示例，以及PageIndex集成。核心是wiki基础层（编译和维护知识）和生成器（查询/聊天/技能工厂），支持多种格式输入。
zh.stack: 主要语言是Python，依赖PageIndex（无向量检索）、LLM接口（如OpenAI），以及文档解析库（PDF、Word等）。
zh.hot: 3.7k星且日增48，因提供传统RAG的替代方案，解决知识不累积的问题，并支持多模态和长文档，符合Karpathy提出的概念。
uses: 需要从大量文档中构建持久知识库的研究人员或团队
希望避免向量数据库复杂性的RAG开发者
需要多模态检索（图表、图片）的文档分析场景
构建可复用agent技能的知识工作者

en.tag: Compile docs into a structured wiki with LLMs, a vectorless RAG alternative
en.what: OpenKB is an open-source CLI system that compiles raw documents into a structured, interlinked wiki knowledge base using LLMs. Powered by PageIndex's vectorless, reasoning-based retrieval for long documents, it automatically maintains summaries, concept pages, and cross-references, allowing knowledge to compound over time.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, documentation, configuration examples, and PageIndex integration. It features a wiki foundation layer (compiles and maintains knowledge) and generators (query/chat/Skill Factory), supporting multiple input formats.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relying on PageIndex for vectorless retrieval, LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI), and document parsing libraries for PDF, Word, etc.
en.hot: With 3.7k stars and +48 today, it's hot for offering an alternative to traditional RAG, addressing knowledge accumulation, and supporting multi-modality and long documents, aligning with Karpathy's concept.
uses: Researchers or teams needing to build a persistent knowledge base from large document sets
RAG developers looking to avoid vector database complexity
Document analysis scenarios requiring multi-modal retrieval (figures, tables, images)
Knowledge workers building reusable agent skills

zh.tag: 跨平台个人 AI 助手，连接模型、工具与聊天渠道
zh.what: OpenClaw 是一个运行在你设备上的个人 AI 助手，通过单一网关连接模型、工具、消息渠道和可选配套应用。它专为单用户设计，让你在常用聊天平台中与 AI 交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、CLI 工具、网关（Gateway）控制平面、控制界面（Control UI）以及文档。支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，可通过 npm 或一键脚本安装。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，运行在 Node.js 上（要求 Node 22.22.3+ 等）。依赖 npm 包，支持 Docker、Nix 等部署方式。
zh.hot: 星数高达 38.6 万，今日新增 187，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 4。其“龙虾方式”的跨平台个人助手定位和易用性吸引了大量关注。
uses: 个人用户：希望在手机、电脑等设备上拥有统一 AI 助手的用户
开发者：需要将 AI 集成到聊天平台（如 Discord）或自定义工具的开发者
隐私敏感者：偏好本地运行、数据自控的 AI 用户

en.tag: Cross-platform personal AI assistant connecting models, tools, and chat channels
en.what: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your devices and connects models, tools, messaging channels, and optional companion apps through one Gateway. Designed for a single operator, it lets you interact with AI in the channels you already use.
en.content: The repo includes install scripts, CLI tools, the Gateway control plane, Control UI, and documentation. Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows, installable via npm or one-liner scripts.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Node.js (requires Node 22.22.3+). Distributed as an npm package, with Docker and Nix deployment options.
en.hot: With 386k stars and 187 new today, ranking #4 on TypeScript daily trend, its 'lobster way' cross-platform personal assistant positioning and ease of use attract massive attention.
uses: Individuals wanting a unified AI assistant across devices
Developers integrating AI into chat platforms or custom tools
Privacy-conscious users preferring local, self-controlled AI

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: 为复杂代码库打造的多智能体编码框架，支持 Codex/OpenCode 等。
zh.what: oh-my-openagent 是一个为复杂代码库设计的编码代理框架，支持多种代理后端（如 Codex、OpenCode），提供团队模式等高级功能。它旨在通过多智能体协作和自动化工具，提升大型项目的开发效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、配置文件、文档和示例，支持通过 npx 安装 LazyCodex。项目正在重构以支持多代理系统，并公开了路线图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖现代 Node.js 环境。集成了多种 AI 模型和代理工具，如 Codex、OpenCode 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 67.7k 星标和今日新增 98 星，该项目因提供强大的多智能体编码能力而受到关注，尤其是对 Anthropic 模型的深度支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 大型代码库的开发者，希望利用多智能体协作提升编码效率。
对 AI 编码代理感兴趣的研究者和爱好者，探索不同模型和工具的组合。
需要自动化代码审查、重构和测试的团队，可利用其团队模式。

en.tag: Multi-agent coding harness for complex codebases, supporting Codex/OpenCode and more.
en.what: oh-my-openagent is a coding agent harness designed for complex codebases, supporting multiple agent backends like Codex and OpenCode, with advanced features such as Team Mode. It aims to boost development efficiency in large projects through multi-agent collaboration and automation.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, configuration files, documentation, and examples, with an option to install LazyCodex via npx. The project is undergoing a refactor to support multiple agent harnesses and has a public roadmap.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, relying on modern Node.js. Integrates various AI models and agent tools like Codex and OpenCode.
en.hot: With 67.7k stars and 98 new stars today, the project gains attention for its powerful multi-agent coding capabilities, especially its deep support for Anthropic models, attracting many developers.
uses: Developers working on large codebases seeking multi-agent collaboration for efficiency.
Researchers and enthusiasts interested in AI coding agents, exploring combinations of models and tools.
Teams needing automated code review, refactoring, and testing via Team Mode.

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与精选插件集
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方发布的插件仓库，包含插件规范（manifest 格式）和一系列官方/第三方插件，覆盖代码审查、文档可视化、CLI 设计、Gmail/Drive 集成等场景。每个插件独立成目录，通过 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 声明。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件一个文件夹，如 continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、pr-review-canvas、orchestrate 等，另有 third_party 目录存放 Gmail、Google Drive 等第三方集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Cursor SDK（@cursor/sdk），插件通过 plugin.json 清单定义，可能涉及 MCP、CLI 工具等。
zh.hot: Cursor 作为 AI 编辑器热度极高，官方插件仓库是生态扩展的关键入口，今日新增 27 星，总星数 2645，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 7 名，开发者关注如何用插件增强 AI 代理工作流。
uses: Cursor 用户：安装官方插件提升代码审查、文档浏览等效率
插件开发者：参考规范与示例创建自己的 Cursor 插件
团队协作：利用 Team Kit、Orchestrate 等插件优化 CI/CD 和并行任务处理

en.tag: Official Cursor plugin spec and curated plugins
en.what: This is the official Cursor plugin repository, containing the plugin specification (manifest format) and a collection of first-party and third-party plugins for code review, docs visualization, CLI design, Gmail/Drive integration, and more. Each plugin lives in its own directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.
en.content: Each plugin is a standalone folder at the repo root, e.g., continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, pr-review-canvas, orchestrate, plus a third_party directory for Gmail, Google Drive, etc.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk), plugins defined via plugin.json manifests, may involve MCP, CLI tools, etc.
en.hot: Cursor is a hot AI editor, and this official plugin repo is a key entry point for ecosystem expansion. With +27 stars today and 2,645 total, it ranks #7 on the TypeScript daily trending list, drawing developers interested in enhancing AI agent workflows via plugins.
uses: Cursor users: install official plugins to boost code review and docs navigation
Plugin developers: reference the spec and examples to create your own plugins
Teams: leverage Team Kit, Orchestrate, etc. to streamline CI/CD and parallel task handling

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源 AI 原生 CRM，Salesforce 替代品
zh.what: Twenty 是一个开源 CRM 平台，旨在成为 Salesforce 的替代方案，专为 AI 时代设计。它提供技术团队构建自定义 CRM 所需的模块，并支持将 CRM 作为代码进行开发、部署和版本控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 CRM 应用、CLI 工具（create-twenty-app）、SDK（twenty-sdk）、网站和文档。支持通过代码定义对象、字段和视图，并可发布到云端工作区。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React 前端和 Node.js 后端，支持 Docker 部署。依赖包括 PostgreSQL 数据库和 GraphQL API。
zh.hot: 作为 Salesforce 的开源替代品，Twenty 吸引了大量关注，目前拥有 54,831 颗星，今日新增 65 颗，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 9 名。其 AI 原生设计和代码化 CRM 理念符合开发者需求。
uses: 技术团队：希望构建高度定制化 CRM 的开发者，可像管理代码一样管理 CRM。
创业公司：需要灵活、可扩展 CRM 且不想受制于商业软件的企业。
AI 应用开发者：需要将 CRM 与 AI 工作流集成的场景。
开源爱好者：关注开源替代商业软件趋势的社区成员。

en.tag: Open-source AI-native CRM, Salesforce alternative
en.what: Twenty is an open-source CRM platform designed as a Salesforce alternative, built for the AI era. It provides technical teams with the building blocks to create custom CRMs and supports developing, shipping, and versioning CRM as code.
en.content: The repository contains the core CRM app, CLI tool (create-twenty-app), SDK (twenty-sdk), website, and docs. It allows defining objects, fields, and views as code and publishing to cloud workspaces.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with React frontend and Node.js backend, Docker deployment. Uses PostgreSQL and GraphQL.
en.hot: As an open-source Salesforce alternative, Twenty has gained significant traction with 54,831 stars (65 today), ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its AI-native design and code-first CRM approach resonate with developers.
uses: Technical teams: Developers who want to build highly customized CRMs, managing them like code.
Startups: Companies needing flexible, scalable CRM without vendor lock-in.
AI developers: Those integrating CRM with AI workflows.
Open-source enthusiasts: Community members interested in open alternatives to commercial software.

zh.tag: 在浏览器里跑 VS Code，随时随地开发
zh.what: code-server 让你在任何设备上通过浏览器访问 VS Code，提供一致的开发环境。它利用云端服务器加速测试、编译和下载，同时节省本地电量，因为所有繁重任务都在服务器上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 VS Code 浏览器版本，包括安装脚本、部署指南、截图和文档。支持通过安装脚本、手动安装、云提供商一键部署或 devcontainer 功能等多种方式启动。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 VS Code 项目。需要 Linux 机器，启用 WebSockets，至少 1GB RAM 和 2 vCPU。
zh.hot: 近 8 万星标，长期热门，因为它将 VS Code 带入浏览器，极大提升了开发灵活性和协作效率。今日新增 37 星，稳居 TypeScript 日榜前十。
uses: 远程开发者：在云端服务器上编码，保持环境一致
团队协作：通过 coder/coder 部署，统一开发环境
轻量设备用户：在平板或低配电脑上使用完整 IDE
教学与演示：无需本地安装，快速启动 VS Code

en.tag: Run VS Code in the browser, develop anywhere
en.what: code-server lets you access VS Code from any device via a browser, providing a consistent development environment. It uses cloud servers to speed up tests, compilations, downloads, and more, while preserving local battery life since all intensive tasks run on the server.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser-based version of VS Code, including install scripts, deployment guides, screenshots, and documentation. It supports multiple ways to get started: install script, manual install, one-click cloud deployment, or devcontainer feature.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, based on the VS Code project. Requires a Linux machine with WebSockets enabled, at least 1GB RAM and 2 vCPUs.
en.hot: With nearly 79k stars, it's consistently popular because it brings VS Code to the browser, greatly enhancing development flexibility and collaboration. Gaining 37 stars today, it remains in the top 10 of the TypeScript daily trend.
uses: Remote developers: code on cloud servers with consistent environments
Team collaboration: deploy via coder/coder for unified dev environments
Lightweight device users: use full IDE on tablets or low-spec machines
Teaching and demos: launch VS Code quickly without local install

zh.tag: 将整个代码库打包成单个 AI 友好文件
zh.what: Repomix 是一个强大的工具，能将整个代码仓库打包成一个 AI 友好的文件，方便喂给大型语言模型（如 Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek 等）或其他 AI 工具。它解决了直接复制代码库时上下文窗口不足、格式混乱的问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Repomix 的完整源代码，包括命令行工具、核心打包逻辑、配置文件支持、以及一个在线版本（repomix.com）。还提供了详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Node.js 环境。依赖包括文件系统处理、代码解析、压缩等库，并支持多种输出格式（如 Markdown、XML）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手流行，开发者需要高效地将代码库提供给 AI，Repomix 正好满足这一需求。其 star 数已达 27.8k，今日新增 30，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 11 名。
uses: 开发者使用 AI 工具（如 Claude、ChatGPT）进行代码审查或重构时，快速打包代码库。
需要将代码库分享给团队或外部 AI 服务时，生成简洁的上下文文件。
在 CI/CD 流程中，自动生成代码快照供 AI 分析。
学习 AI 编程实践，了解如何优化代码输入给 LLM。

en.tag: Pack your entire codebase into a single AI-friendly file
en.what: Repomix is a powerful tool that packs your entire repository into a single, AI-friendly file, perfect for feeding your codebase to LLMs or AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and more. It solves the problem of limited context windows and messy formatting when copying code directly.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Repomix, including the CLI tool, core packing logic, configuration file support, and an online version (repomix.com). It also includes comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, running on Node.js. It uses libraries for file system handling, code parsing, and compression, and supports multiple output formats like Markdown and XML.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding assistants, developers need an efficient way to feed codebases to AI, and Repomix fills this need perfectly. It has 27.8k stars, with 30 added today, ranking 11th on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Developers using AI tools (like Claude, ChatGPT) for code review or refactoring, to quickly pack their codebase.
When sharing codebases with teams or external AI services, generating a concise context file.
In CI/CD pipelines, automatically generating code snapshots for AI analysis.
Learning AI coding practices, understanding how to optimize code input for LLMs.

zh.tag: 视觉驱动的跨平台 UI 自动化与测试工具
zh.what: Midscene.js 是一个开源的、基于视觉的 UI 自动化工具，允许用户用自然语言编写测试，自动操作任何平台（Web、iOS、Android 等）。它通过 AI 理解界面元素，无需依赖脆弱的 DOM 结构或选择器，使自动化更稳定、更易维护。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 SDK（如 @midscene/web）、示例展示（Web/iOS/Android 自动化案例）、以及 Midscene Skills 子项目，用于与 OpenClaw 集成控制任意平台。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 UI-TARS 模型（如 ByteDance-Seed/UI-TARS-1.5-7B）进行视觉理解，支持 npm 安装，并集成 Discord、Twitter 等社区渠道。

uses: 前端开发者：用自然语言编写端到端测试，无需维护复杂选择器。
QA 工程师：跨平台（Web/iOS/Android）自动化回归测试，提高效率。
AI 爱好者：探索视觉驱动自动化与 LLM 结合的应用场景。

en.tag: Vision-driven UI automation & testing for any platform
en.what: Midscene.js is an open-source, vision-driven UI automation tool that lets users write tests in natural language and automate any platform (Web, iOS, Android, etc.). It uses AI to understand UI elements, eliminating reliance on fragile DOM structures or selectors, making automation more robust and maintainable.

en.hot: With its AI-driven vision automation concept, it solves pain points of traditional UI testing, amassing over 14.5k stars and consistently appearing on GitHub trending, gaining wide developer attention.
uses: Frontend developers: write end-to-end tests in natural language without maintaining complex selectors.
QA engineers: automate cross-platform (Web/iOS/Android) regression testing to boost efficiency.
AI enthusiasts: explore applications combining vision-driven automation with LLMs.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的网页搜索、抓取与交互 API
zh.what: Firecrawl 是一个开源 API，用于大规模搜索、抓取网页，并将内容转换为干净的 Markdown 或结构化数据，供 AI 代理使用。它处理代理轮换、速率限制和 JS 渲染等复杂问题，提供高可靠性和低延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 API 端点（搜索、抓取、爬取、映射、提取等）、SDK（Python、Node 等）、自托管部署选项，以及用于与 AI 代理集成的 MCP 支持。

uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供实时网页数据，支持搜索、抓取和交互。
数据科学家/分析师：从网页提取结构化数据用于分析和训练。
自托管用户：通过 Docker 部署，掌控数据隐私和成本。
企业级应用：需要高可靠性和低延迟的大规模网页数据采集。

en.tag: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale
en.what: Firecrawl is an open-source API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale, converting content into clean Markdown or structured data for AI agents. It handles proxies, rate limits, and JS rendering, offering high reliability and low latency.
en.content: The repo includes core API endpoints (search, scrape, crawl, map, extract), SDKs (Python, Node), self-hosting options, and MCP support for AI agent integration.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses Playwright for browser automation, supports various deployment options (Docker, cloud).
en.hot: With 165k stars and 835 daily additions, Firecrawl is the go-to tool for AI agents to obtain web context, loved for its reliability and LLM-friendly output.
uses: AI agent developers: provide real-time web data for agents, supporting search, scrape, and interaction.
Data scientists/analysts: extract structured data from web for analysis and training.
Self-hosters: deploy via Docker for data privacy and cost control.
Enterprise applications: large-scale web data collection with high reliability and low latency.

Teams: Use shared memory and 100+ integrations for collaborative AI workflows across tools and apps.
AI enthusiasts: Explore local-first agent orchestration with built-in models or BYOK flexibility.

en.tag: AI-driven declarative infographic generation and rendering framework

zh.tag: 本地 AI 图像转 3D 网格的桌面应用

en.tag: Open-source composable payments platform with intelligent routing and cost optimization
en.what: Hyperswitch is an open-source, composable payments platform that enables businesses to connect to multiple payment, payout, fraud, vault, and tokenization providers. It offers intelligent routing, revenue recovery, and cost observability to optimize payment processing and reduce costs.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the payments platform, including payment modules (e.g., cost observability, intelligent routing), architecture docs, quickstart guides, deployment options (SaaS and self-host), and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, with a modular architecture supporting various deployment options. Dependencies include common infrastructure components like PostgreSQL and Redis.
en.hot: With 43k+ stars, Hyperswitch has gained significant traction due to its open-source, composable payment solution, offering businesses a way to avoid vendor lock-in and reduce payment costs.
uses: Developers: Those looking to integrate multiple payment gateways and optimize payment flows.
Businesses: Enterprises aiming to reduce payment processing costs and improve authorization rates.
Fintechs: Fintech companies seeking customizable payment infrastructure.
Platform operators: Platforms requiring multi-provider payment support.

zh.tag: 20MB 轻量跨平台数据库客户端，支持 60+ 数据库与 AI 助手
zh.what: DBX 是一款极致轻量的跨平台数据库管理工具，仅 20MB 体积却支持 60 余种数据库。它提供桌面端与 Docker 自托管部署，并内置 AI 助手辅助查询与运维。
zh.content: 基于 Rust 构建的桌面端应用源码，包含多数据库驱动适配层、内置 AI 助手模块及 Docker 部署配置。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言构建，采用跨平台桌面框架，集成多种数据库原生驱动与 AI 接口。
zh.hot: 凭借 20MB 极简体积覆盖 60+ 数据库，月度激增 4470 Star 登榜 Rust 区第 4；内置 AI 助手与多平台支持直击开发者“轻便全能”的痛点。
uses: 多数据库运维开发者 —— 一键管理 MySQL、PG、Redis、MongoDB 等异构数据库
追求轻量工具的独立开发者 —— 20MB 体积替代臃肿的客户端套件
需要本地/内网自托管的团队 —— Docker 部署满足隐私与统一访问需求
借助 AI 提升查询效率的 DBA —— 内置 AI 助手辅助 SQL 编写与优化

en.tag: 20MB lightweight cross-platform DB client with AI assistant for 60+ databases
en.what: DBX is an ultra-lightweight, cross-platform database client packing support for 60+ databases into a 20MB footprint. It offers desktop and Docker self-hosting options and includes a built-in AI assistant to help with querying and management.
en.content: Rust-based desktop application source with multi-database driver adapters, an integrated AI assistant module, and Docker deployment configurations.
en.stack: Built primarily in Rust using a cross-platform desktop framework, integrating native drivers for 60+ databases and AI APIs.
en.hot: Its 20MB footprint covering 60+ databases, combined with a built-in AI assistant and multi-platform support, resonates with developers' need for lightweight versatility—driving 4,470 new stars this month and a #4 spot on the Rust trending chart.
uses: Multi-database developers — manage heterogeneous DBs like MySQL, PG, Redis, and MongoDB from one tool
Developers favoring lightweight tools — replace bloated client suites with a 20MB alternative
Teams requiring local/self-hosted access — Docker deployment satisfies privacy and unified access needs
DBAs leveraging AI — built-in assistant helps write and optimize SQL queries faster

zh.tag: 一站式媒体下载与学习管理桌面应用
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款开源桌面应用，支持从 1800+ 网站下载视频、音频、课程和电子书，并内置 PDF/EPUB 阅读器、专注模式、带时间戳的笔记和间隔重复功能。无需命令行，无需 Python，开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，基于 Tauri + Rust + Svelte 构建，提供媒体下载、播放、阅读、笔记和插件系统。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Tauri（桌面框架）、Rust（后端）、Svelte（前端）、yt-dlp（媒体下载）、SQLite（本地存储）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 357 星，总星数 7277，位列 Rust 日榜第 10。其“一站式下载+学习”的定位精准解决了用户在多平台间切换的痛点，且完全免费开源。
uses: 在线课程学习者 —— 一键下载 Udemy、YouTube 等平台的课程视频和资料
媒体收藏爱好者 —— 从 1800+ 站点下载视频、音乐和电子书
高效学习者 —— 利用内置阅读器、笔记和间隔重复功能进行主动学习

en.tag: All-in-one desktop app for downloading, organizing and studying media
en.what: OmniGet is an open-source desktop app that downloads videos, audio, courses, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites, with built-in PDF/EPUB reader, focus mode, timestamped notes, and spaced repetition. No command line, no Python, just download and run.
en.content: The repo contains the full desktop app source code built with Tauri + Rust + Svelte, featuring media downloading, playback, reading, note-taking, and a plugin system.
en.stack: Tech stack: Tauri (desktop framework), Rust (backend), Svelte (frontend), yt-dlp (media downloading), SQLite (local storage).
en.hot: Gained 357 stars today, total 7277, ranked #10 in Rust daily trending. Its 'all-in-one download + study' positioning solves the pain of switching between platforms, and it's completely free and open-source.
uses: Online course learners — one-click download courses from Udemy, YouTube, and more
Media collectors — download videos, music, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites
Active learners — use built-in reader, notes, and spaced repetition for effective study

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: gpui-component 是一个 Rust 编写的桌面应用 UI 组件库，基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 框架。它提供 60 多个组件，帮助开发者快速构建高性能、跨平台的桌面应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、示例、文档和在线画廊，涵盖按钮、输入框、表格、列表、图表、代码编辑器等，并支持主题定制和 Markdown 渲染。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 GPUI，依赖 Zed 的 gpui 和 gpui_platform，支持 Tree Sitter 语法高亮，图表和编辑器等功能。
zh.hot: 随着 Zed 编辑器的流行，GPUI 生态受到关注，该组件库填补了 GPUI 缺少现成 UI 组件的空白，star 数已超 1.2 万，今日新增 32 星。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 GPUI 构建桌面应用，需要现成组件
Zed 编辑器相关项目或插件开发
需要高性能、可定制 UI 的跨平台桌面应用
对 Rust GUI 生态感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop UI components built on GPUI
en.what: gpui-component is a Rust UI component library for desktop apps, built on GPUI, the framework used by Zed editor. It offers 60+ components to help developers quickly build high-performance, cross-platform desktop applications.
en.content: The repo contains component source code, examples, docs, and an online gallery, covering buttons, inputs, tables, lists, charts, code editors, etc., with theme customization and Markdown rendering.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and GPUI, depending on Zed's gpui and gpui_platform, with Tree Sitter for syntax highlighting, charts, and editor features.
en.hot: With Zed's popularity, the GPUI ecosystem gains attention; this library fills the gap of ready-made UI components for GPUI, with 12.5k+ stars and 32 new today.
uses: Rust developers building desktop apps with GPUI needing ready-made components
Projects or plugins related to the Zed editor
Cross-platform desktop apps requiring high-performance, customizable UI
Learners interested in the Rust GUI ecosystem

zh.tag: 快速、轻量、开源的本地文档解析器
zh.what: LiteParse 是一个专注于快速和轻量解析的独立开源 PDF 解析工具，提供高质量的空间文本解析和边界框，无需专有 LLM 功能或云依赖，一切都在本地运行。对于复杂文档，可选用 LlamaParse 云服务获得更好效果。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库，提供 PDFium 快速文本解析、内置 Tesseract OCR 及可插拔 HTTP OCR 服务器、复杂度检测、截图生成、多种输出格式（Markdown/JSON/Text），并支持 Rust、Node.js、Python 和 WASM 多语言绑定。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 PDFium 进行文本解析，Tesseract 用于 OCR，支持通过 HTTP 集成 EasyOCR/PaddleOCR 等，提供 npm 和 PyPI 包，支持 WASM 在浏览器运行。
zh.hot: 凭借 12k+ stars 和今日新增 19 星，LiteParse 因其轻量、快速且完全本地化的解析能力而受到关注，成为 RAG 和 LLM 工作流中处理 PDF 的热门选择。
uses: 开发者：需要快速本地 PDF 解析以构建 RAG 或 LLM 应用的开发者
数据工程师：在数据管道中提取文档文本和布局信息
隐私敏感场景：要求数据不出本地的企业或组织
多语言用户：通过 Python、Node.js 或 WASM 集成到现有系统

en.tag: Fast, lightweight, open-source local document parser
en.what: LiteParse is a standalone open-source PDF parsing tool focused on fast and light parsing, providing high-quality spatial text parsing with bounding boxes, without proprietary LLM features or cloud dependencies. Everything runs locally. For complex documents, LlamaParse cloud service is recommended.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust core library with fast PDFium text parsing, built-in Tesseract OCR and pluggable HTTP OCR servers, complexity detection, screenshot generation, multiple output formats (Markdown/JSON/Text), and multi-language bindings for Rust, Node.js, Python, and WASM.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging PDFium for text parsing and Tesseract for OCR, with HTTP integration for EasyOCR/PaddleOCR, distributed via npm and PyPI, and supports WASM for browser use.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 19 new stars today, LiteParse gains traction for its lightweight, fast, and fully local parsing capabilities, becoming a popular choice for PDF processing in RAG and LLM workflows.
uses: Developers: building RAG or LLM applications needing fast local PDF parsing
Data engineers: extracting text and layout info in data pipelines
Privacy-sensitive scenarios: enterprises requiring data to stay on-premises
Multi-language users: integrating via Python, Node.js, or WASM

zh.tag: 开源智能代码审查，基准测试第一
zh.what: PR-AF 是一个基于 AgentField 构建的开源智能代码审查工具，在 Martian Code-Review-Bench 上排名第一。它将每个 PR 转化为任务特定的审查计划，生成专注的审查代理，以代码证据为基础，挑战结果，从而从更便宜的模型中提取更多有用的审查情报。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心审查引擎、CLI 工具、Docker 部署支持、基准测试脚本和文档。支持通过 CLI、curl、CI 或 API 触发审查，并流式输出进度和结果。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，基于 AgentField 框架，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GLM-5.2、Opus 类），可通过 Docker 自托管。
zh.hot: 在 Code-Review-Bench 上超越所有商业工具，成为开源第一，且审查成本比闭源工具低约 10 倍。本周新增 78 星，登上 GitHub 周榜。
uses: 开源项目维护者：希望用低成本获得高质量代码审查，提升代码质量。
CI/CD 集成：将 PR-AF 作为自动化审查步骤，在合并前捕获 bug。
AI 研究者：研究智能体代码审查的基准和方法。
企业团队：需要自托管、模型灵活的代码审查方案。

en.tag: Open-source agentic code review, #1 on Code-Review-Bench
en.what: PR-AF is an open-source agentic code review tool built on AgentField, ranking #1 on Martian Code-Review-Bench. It turns each PR into a task-specific review plan, spawns focused reviewer agents, grounds findings in code evidence, and challenges results to extract more useful review intelligence from cheaper models.
en.content: The repository includes the core review engine, CLI tool, Docker deployment support, benchmark scripts, and documentation. Reviews can be triggered via CLI, curl, CI, or API, with live progress streaming and result output.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, built on the AgentField framework, supports multiple models (e.g., DeepSeek, GLM-5.2, Opus-class), and can be self-hosted via Docker.
en.hot: It tops the Code-Review-Bench among all tools, becoming #1 open-source, with review costs about 10x cheaper than closed-source tools. Gained 78 stars this week, hitting the GitHub weekly trending list.
uses: Open-source maintainers: want high-quality code review at low cost to improve code quality.
CI/CD integration: use PR-AF as an automated review step to catch bugs before merge.
AI researchers: study benchmarks and methods for agentic code review.
Enterprise teams: need self-hosted, model-flexible code review solutions.

zh.tag: AI视频翻译配音全链路工具，支持人类与AI Agent调用
zh.what: KrillinAI 是一款由 Krillin AI 团队开发的音视频本地化与增强工具，面向人类用户和 AI Agent。它覆盖视频下载、语音转写、字幕翻译、TTS 配音、人像转换、封面生成等完整流程，支持横竖屏，适配各大主流平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具，提供分阶段命令，每个阶段独立执行并输出结构化结果，支持跨阶段产物复用。另有 skills/ 目录，为 AI Agent 提供可直接调用的分阶段 Skills，以及一键端到端操作的客户端。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 LLM 进行翻译和 TTS 配音，支持 100+ 语言。
zh.hot: 今日新增 155 星，总星数达 10947，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）第 4 名。其面向 AI Agent 的 Skills 集成和全链路自动化能力吸引了大量关注。
uses: 内容创作者：一键将视频翻译配音并适配多平台，快速出海。
AI Agent 开发者：通过 skills/ 目录集成视频本地化能力到自动化工作流。
多语言团队：利用 CLI 分阶段处理，灵活定制翻译和配音流程。

en.tag: AI video translation & dubbing tool for humans and agents, full pipeline
en.what: KrillinAI is a versatile audio/video localization and enhancement tool developed by the Krillin AI team, designed for both human users and AI Agents. It covers the complete pipeline including video download, transcription, translation, TTS dubbing, portrait conversion, and cover generation, supporting landscape and portrait formats for major platforms.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI tool with phased commands, each executing independently and outputting structured results, supporting cross-stage artifact reuse. It also includes a skills/ directory providing per-stage Skills for AI Agents, plus a client for one-click end-to-end operation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging LLMs for translation and TTS dubbing, supporting 100+ languages.
en.hot: Gained 155 stars today, reaching 10,947 total, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily. Its Skills integration for AI Agents and full-pipeline automation attract significant attention.
uses: Content creators: one-click video translation and dubbing for multi-platform global reach.
AI Agent developers: integrate video localization capabilities into automated workflows via skills/ directory.
Multilingual teams: use CLI for phased processing, customizing translation and dubbing pipelines.

zh.tag: 最强泄露凭证发现、验证与分析工具
zh.what: TruffleHog 是一款用于发现、验证和分析泄露凭证（如 API 密钥、数据库密码、私钥等）的安全工具。它能在 Git 仓库、聊天记录、wiki、日志等多种来源中扫描敏感信息，并对发现的凭证进行分类和验证，确认其是否仍然有效。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的命令行工具，核心是 pkg/detectors 目录下的 800 多种凭证检测器，以及用于扫描、分类、验证和分析的模块。还提供企业版产品用于持续监控多个平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 GoReleaser 进行构建发布，并集成了 Go Report Card 等质量工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 27415 颗星，今日新增 36 颗，位列 GitHub 趋势榜 Go 语言第 4 名。其强大的凭证检测能力和活跃的社区支持使其备受欢迎。
uses: 安全工程师：在代码库和 CI/CD 流程中扫描泄露的凭证，防止安全事故。
DevOps 团队：持续监控 Git、聊天工具等，确保敏感信息不泄露。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中快速发现目标系统中的有效凭证。
开源贡献者：参与 800 多种检测器的维护和扩展。

en.tag: The most powerful leaked credential discovery, verification, and analysis tool
en.what: TruffleHog is a security tool for discovering, verifying, and analyzing leaked credentials such as API keys, database passwords, and private keys. It scans various sources like Git repos, chats, wikis, and logs, then classifies and validates the found secrets to confirm if they are still active.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI tool with over 800 credential detectors in pkg/detectors, along with modules for scanning, classification, validation, and analysis. An enterprise product is also available for continuous monitoring across multiple platforms.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, using GoReleaser for builds and releases, and integrated with quality tools like Go Report Card.
en.hot: With 27,415 stars and 36 added today, it ranks 4th on GitHub Trending for Go. Its powerful credential detection and active community contribute to its popularity.
uses: Security engineers: scan codebases and CI/CD pipelines for leaked credentials to prevent breaches.
DevOps teams: continuously monitor Git, chats, etc., to ensure sensitive info isn't exposed.
Penetration testers: quickly find valid credentials in authorized security assessments.
Open source contributors: help maintain and expand the 800+ detectors.

zh.tag: 云原生高性能消息系统服务器
zh.what: NATS Server 是 NATS.io 消息系统的高性能服务器实现，为分布式系统提供简单、安全、高效的通信。它支持云、边缘、本地甚至树莓派部署，是 CNCF 项目，拥有 40 多种客户端语言实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NATS 服务器的 Go 源码、文档、配置文件示例、Docker 镜像支持，以及测试和 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库及少量外部库，支持多种部署方式（二进制、Docker、Kubernetes）。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，NATS 在云原生领域广受欢迎，今日新增 33 星，总星数超 2 万，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 微服务架构中的服务间通信和事件驱动
物联网边缘设备的数据采集与传输
需要高吞吐、低延迟消息传递的实时应用
云原生环境下的消息中间件替代方案

en.tag: High-performance server for cloud & edge native messaging
en.what: NATS Server is the high-performance server implementation of NATS.io messaging system, providing simple, secure, and efficient communication for distributed systems. It supports cloud, edge, on-premise, and even Raspberry Pi deployments, and is a CNCF project with 40+ client language implementations.
en.content: The repository contains the Go source code of the NATS server, documentation, configuration examples, Docker image support, tests, and CI workflows.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, relying on the standard library and a few external libraries, supporting multiple deployment methods (binary, Docker, Kubernetes).
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, NATS is widely popular in cloud-native, gaining 33 stars today and over 20k total, continuously attracting developers.
uses: Service-to-service communication and event-driven in microservices
Data collection and transmission for IoT edge devices
Real-time applications requiring high throughput and low latency messaging
Message broker alternative in cloud-native environments

zh.tag: 实时基础设施可观测性平台，AI 加持
zh.what: Netdata 是一个开源的全栈可观测性平台，能够以每秒一次的频率收集、可视化和分析服务器、容器、应用等基础设施的指标。它提供开箱即用的仪表盘、告警和 AI 驱动的异常检测，帮助团队快速定位问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Netdata 的核心守护进程（用 C 编写）、Go 编写的部分组件、Web 仪表盘、数百个监控插件（collectors）、告警引擎、机器学习模块以及 Docker/Kubernetes 部署文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C 语言编写核心，Go 用于部分工具和组件；依赖 libuv、LZ4、OpenSSL 等；支持 Linux、FreeBSD、macOS 和容器环境。
zh.hot: 拥有 80k+ 星标，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的可观测性项目之一。其 AI 驱动的全栈可观测性定位吸引了大量中小团队，且持续活跃更新。
uses: DevOps/SRE 团队：实时监控服务器和容器，快速定位性能瓶颈
个人开发者：轻量级监控个人 VPS 或家庭服务器
中小型企业：无需复杂部署即可获得全栈可观测性
云原生环境：与 Kubernetes 集成，监控集群健康

en.tag: Real-time infrastructure observability with AI, for lean teams
en.what: Netdata is an open-source full-stack observability platform that collects, visualizes, and analyzes metrics from servers, containers, and applications at one-second granularity. It provides out-of-the-box dashboards, alerts, and AI-powered anomaly detection to help teams quickly identify issues.
en.content: The repository contains the core daemon (written in C), Go components, web dashboards, hundreds of collectors, alerting engine, machine learning modules, and Docker/Kubernetes deployment files.
en.stack: Core written in C, with Go for some tools and components; depends on libuv, LZ4, OpenSSL; supports Linux, FreeBSD, macOS, and containers.
en.hot: With 80k+ stars, it's one of the most popular observability projects on GitHub. Its AI-powered full-stack observability positioning attracts lean teams, and it's actively maintained.
uses: DevOps/SRE teams: real-time monitoring of servers and containers to quickly pinpoint bottlenecks
Individual developers: lightweight monitoring for personal VPS or home servers
SMBs: full-stack observability without complex deployment
Cloud-native environments: integrates with Kubernetes to monitor cluster health

zh.tag: 自托管多云文件管理与分享系统
zh.what: Cloudreve 是一个自托管的文件管理和分享系统，支持将文件存储到本地或多种云存储提供商，如 OneDrive、S3 兼容 API、阿里云 OSS 等。它提供直观的 Web 界面，支持文件上传下载、在线预览、分享链接、WebDAV 等功能，适合个人或团队搭建私有云盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的后端服务（Go 编写）和前端界面（基于 React），提供预编译的二进制文件、Docker 镜像以及详细的部署文档。功能涵盖多用户管理、文件压缩/解压、媒体元数据提取、在线编辑 Office 文档等。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端使用 React，支持多种数据库（如 SQLite、MySQL）作为元数据存储。集成了 Aria2/qBittorrent 用于后台下载，并支持 WebDAV 协议。
zh.hot: Cloudreve 拥有 28.5k 星标，因其功能全面、部署简单且支持多云存储而广受欢迎。今日新增 23 星，持续受到自托管社区关注。
uses: 个人用户：搭建私有云盘，替代公有云服务，保护数据隐私。
团队协作：集中管理文件，通过分享链接和权限控制实现安全共享。
开发者：利用 WebDAV 和 API 集成到自动化工作流中。
企业：利用多云存储冗余和离线下载功能，降低存储成本。

en.tag: Self-hosted multi-cloud file management and sharing system
en.what: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system that supports storing files locally or on multiple cloud providers such as OneDrive, S3-compatible APIs, Aliyun OSS, and more. It offers an intuitive web interface with features like file upload/download, online preview, share links, and WebDAV, suitable for individuals or teams to build private cloud storage.
en.content: The repository includes a complete backend service (written in Go) and a frontend interface (React-based), providing precompiled binaries, Docker images, and detailed deployment docs. Features cover multi-user management, file compression/extraction, media metadata extraction, online Office document editing, and more.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend uses React, and it supports multiple databases (e.g., SQLite, MySQL) for metadata storage. It integrates Aria2/qBittorrent for background downloads and supports the WebDAV protocol.
en.hot: With 28.5k stars, Cloudreve is popular for its comprehensive features, easy deployment, and multi-cloud storage support. It gained 23 stars today, continuing to attract attention from the self-hosting community.
uses: Individual users: build a private cloud drive to replace public cloud services and protect data privacy.
Team collaboration: centralize file management and share securely via links and permission controls.
Developers: integrate with automation workflows via WebDAV and APIs.
Enterprises: leverage multi-cloud storage redundancy and offline download features to reduce storage costs.

zh.tag: Go 语言专属 AI 代理技能集，提升编码助手专业度
zh.what: 这是一个为 Go 语言定制的 AI 代理技能集合，包含语言、测试、安全、可观测性等领域的可复用指令集。这些技能按需加载，不会增加上下文负担，旨在让编码助手更懂 Go 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 Go 技能模块，如 golang-performance 等，每个技能都是独立的指令集。支持通过 skills CLI 或各工具（Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等）的插件机制安装。
zh.stack: 基于 Agent Skills 标准，兼容 skills.sh CLI 及主流 AI 编码工具。内容由 Claude Code 引导生成，但经过人工编辑、测试和审查。
zh.hot: GitHub Trending 日榜 Go 第 8 名，star 近 3k。它解决了 AI 编码助手在 Go 项目中缺乏专业性的痛点，强调“无 AI 垃圾”，质量可靠。
uses: Go 开发者：在 IDE 或 CLI 中提升 AI 助手的 Go 编码建议质量
AI 编码工具用户：为 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等添加 Go 专项技能
团队：统一 Go 项目的最佳实践，减少代码审查成本

en.tag: Production-ready Go agentic skills to supercharge your coding assistant
en.what: A collection of Go-specific agentic skills (language, testing, security, observability, etc.) that extend coding assistants with domain expertise on demand, without bloating context.
en.content: Contains multiple Go skill modules (e.g., golang-performance), each as a standalone instruction set. Installable via skills CLI or plugin mechanisms of various tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.).
en.stack: Built on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with skills.sh CLI and major AI coding tools. Bootstrapped with Claude Code, but human-edited, tested, and reviewed.
en.hot: Ranked #8 on GitHub Trending Go daily, ~2.9k stars. It addresses the lack of Go-specific expertise in AI coding assistants, emphasizing 'No AI slop' and human-verified quality.
uses: Go developers: improve AI assistant suggestions for Go coding in IDEs or CLI
AI coding tool users: add Go-specific skills to Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.
Teams: standardize Go best practices and reduce code review overhead

zh.tag: 开源LLM知识平台，集RAG、自主Agent与自维护Wiki于一体
zh.what: WeKnora 是一个面向企业的开源知识平台，利用大语言模型实现文档理解、语义检索和自主推理。它提供基于 RAG 的快速问答、能自主编排检索和工具的 ReAct Agent，以及将原始文档转化为自维护知识图谱的 Wiki 模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码，涵盖 RAG 问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki 模式、树状文件夹视图、分块编辑与修订历史、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀等）、网站嵌入组件和带作用域的 API 密钥管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 LLM 推理、向量检索和 MCP 工具集成，支持多种文档格式和外部数据源。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1637 星，总星数近 2 万，位列 GitHub Go 语言趋势榜第 14 名。其将 RAG、Agent 和 Wiki 三种能力整合在一个平台，满足企业知识管理需求，且来自腾讯背书，备受关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档转化为可查询的 RAG 系统，支持快速问答。
复杂任务自动化：利用 ReAct Agent 处理多步骤推理，集成搜索和外部工具。
知识管理协作：通过 Wiki 模式自动生成和维护知识图谱，支持编辑与回滚。
开发者集成：通过 API 和嵌入组件将知识能力集成到现有应用或网站。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source, LLM-powered knowledge platform for enterprise-grade document understanding, semantic retrieval, and autonomous reasoning. It offers RAG-based Q&A, a ReAct agent that orchestrates retrieval and tools, and a Wiki mode that turns raw documents into a self-maintaining knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, including RAG Q&A, ReAct agent, Wiki mode, tree-structured folder view, chunk editing with revision history, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, etc.), website embed widgets, and scoped API key management.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging LLM inference, vector retrieval, and MCP tool integration, supporting various document formats and external data sources.
en.hot: Gained 1,637 stars this month, reaching nearly 20k total, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending for Go. Its unique combination of RAG, agent, and Wiki in one platform addresses enterprise knowledge management needs, backed by Tencent, attracting significant attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: turn internal documents into a queryable RAG system for quick Q&A.
Complex task automation: use ReAct agent for multi-step reasoning with search and external tools.
