Efficiency-focused developers: leverage prefix caching to reduce redundant computation and speed up responses
Long-running automation tasks: require a stable, uninterrupted AI agent environment

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个在浏览器中运行的免费数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，用户无需注册即可快速绘制数据库图表、导入导出 SQL 脚本、生成迁移脚本并自定义编辑器。它旨在简化数据库设计流程，让开发者可以直观地可视化和操作数据库结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 drawDB 前端应用源码，包括 React 组件、状态管理、样式和构建配置。还提供了本地开发、生产构建和 Docker 部署的脚本，以及可选的分享功能（需要配套的 drawdb-server）。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 React 构建，使用 npm 进行依赖管理和构建，支持 Docker 容器化部署。主要依赖包括 React 生态、状态管理库（如 Redux 或 MobX）以及代码编辑器组件（如 Monaco）。
zh.hot: drawDB 因其免费、无需注册、直接在浏览器中使用的便捷性而广受欢迎，star 数已达 38k+，今日新增 48 个，在 GitHub 趋势榜 JavaScript 类别中排名第 10。它解决了数据库设计中的常见痛点，提供了简洁直观的界面和强大的 SQL 生成功能。
uses: 数据库开发者：快速可视化数据库结构，生成 SQL 脚本和迁移文件。
软件架构师：在项目初期设计 ER 图，便于团队协作和沟通。
教育场景：用于教学演示数据库设计概念，无需安装复杂软件。
全栈开发者：在开发过程中快速原型化数据库模型，并导出为 SQL 语句。

en.tag: Free, simple, intuitive online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a free, browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that lets users quickly build diagrams, import/export SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize the editor without creating an account. It simplifies database design by providing an intuitive visual interface for structuring and manipulating database schemas.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the drawDB frontend application, including React components, state management, styles, and build configuration. It provides scripts for local development, production build, and Docker deployment, along with optional sharing features that require a companion drawdb-server.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript and React, using npm for dependency management and build, with Docker support for containerized deployment. Key dependencies include React ecosystem, state management libraries (e.g., Redux or MobX), and code editor components (e.g., Monaco).
en.hot: drawDB has gained popularity for being free, requiring no sign-up, and working directly in the browser, amassing 38k+ stars with 48 new stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending for JavaScript. It addresses common pain points in database design with a clean, intuitive interface and powerful SQL generation capabilities.
uses: Database developers: quickly visualize database schemas and generate SQL scripts and migrations.
Software architects: design ER diagrams in early project phases for team collaboration and communication.
Educational settings: demonstrate database design concepts without installing complex software.
Full-stack developers: prototype database models quickly during development and export to SQL statements.

zh.tag: 把技术书 PDF 变成 Claude Code 技能，按需加载、即问即答
zh.what: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍、文档文件夹或资料集合转化为统一的代理技能（Agent Skill），供 GitHub Copilot CLI、Amp 或 Claude Code 等工具使用。它提取书中的框架、决策规则和反模式，生成按章节组织的文件，使代理能按需加载相关章节并基于真实内容回答，避免幻觉。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 命令行工具、文档（安装、使用、FAQ、性能、架构）以及示例技能输出。核心功能是三步流程：指定文件/文件夹/glob，提炼为技能，代理按需加载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，支持 PDF、EPUB、DOCX、MD、HTML、RTF、MOBI 等格式。依赖包括文档解析库和与 Claude Code 等代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3903 stars，总星数达 17689，登上 GitHub 周榜第 5。它解决了 AI 代理使用技术书籍时的上下文爆炸问题，声称比直接导入书籍节省 24×–51× 的 token，并保证基于真实内容回答，因此受到开发者追捧。
uses: 开发者：将技术书籍转化为可交互的代理技能，边写代码边查阅
学习爱好者：把 PDF 书籍变成按需问答的私人导师
团队：将内部文档或规范转化为统一技能，供 AI 助手使用
AI 工具用户：在 Claude Code、Copilot CLI 等环境中增强代理能力

en.tag: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — on-demand, no hallucination
en.what: book-to-skill converts any technical book, document folder, or collection of sources into a unified agent skill for use with GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, or Claude Code. It extracts frameworks, decision rules, and anti-patterns, generating per-chapter files so the agent can load relevant chapters on demand and answer from real content, avoiding hallucinations.
en.content: The repo includes a Python CLI tool, documentation (install, usage, FAQ, performance, architecture), and example skill outputs. Core is a 3-step flow: point to a file/folder/glob, distill into a skill, agent loads on demand.
en.stack: Primarily Python, supporting PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, MOBI formats. Dependencies include document parsing libraries and integration interfaces with agents like Claude Code.
en.hot: Gained 3,903 stars this week, reaching 17,689 total and #5 on GitHub weekly trending. It solves the context explosion problem when using technical books with AI agents, claiming 24×–51× fewer tokens than dumping the book, and ensures answers from real content, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers: turn technical books into interactive agent skills for on-the-fly reference while coding
Learners: convert PDF books into on-demand Q&A personal tutors
Teams: transform internal docs or standards into unified skills for AI assistants
AI tool users: enhance agent capabilities in Claude Code, Copilot CLI, etc.

zh.tag: 模块化节点式 AI 创作引擎，支持图像/视频/3D/音频生成
zh.what: ComfyUI 是一个功能强大且模块化的 AI 内容创作引擎，提供图形化节点界面，让用户能够精细控制每个模型、参数和输出。它支持最新的开源模型，并通过 API 节点接入顶级闭源模型，可用于生成图像、视频、3D 模型和音频等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ComfyUI 源代码，包括前端界面、后端 API、节点图编辑器、示例工作流、文档和安装脚本。项目结构清晰，支持桌面应用、便携版和云端部署。

uses: AI 艺术家和设计师：通过可视化节点工作流生成高质量图像、视频和 3D 内容。
开发者：利用 API 集成 ComfyUI 到生产管线，构建 AI 应用。
研究人员：快速实验最新模型，定制和优化生成流程。
教育者：在教学中演示 AI 生成原理和模型工作流程。

en.tag: Modular node-based AI engine for image, video, 3D, audio generation
en.what: ComfyUI is a powerful and modular AI content creation engine with a graph/nodes interface, giving users fine-grained control over every model, parameter, and output. It natively supports the latest open-source models and provides API nodes for top closed-source models, enabling generation of images, videos, 3D models, audio, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of ComfyUI, including the frontend UI, backend API, node graph editor, example workflows, documentation, and installation scripts. The project is well-structured, supporting desktop app, portable install, and cloud deployment.

en.hot: ComfyUI has become the go-to tool for AI creators due to its powerful modular node interface and broad model support. With 1,505 stars added this week and a total of 124k stars, it consistently ranks on GitHub Trending, backed by an active community and rich ecosystem.
uses: AI artists and designers: create high-quality images, videos, and 3D content via visual node workflows.
Developers: integrate ComfyUI into production pipelines via API to build AI applications.
Researchers: quickly experiment with latest models, customize and optimize generation pipelines.
Educators: demonstrate AI generation principles and model workflows in teaching.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打包资深工程师工作流与质量门禁
zh.what: 这个仓库提供一套生产级工程技能，将资深工程师的流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码为 AI 代理可遵循的规范。它通过斜杠命令和自动触发，覆盖从规格定义到发布的完整开发生命周期。

团队想将内部最佳实践标准化并让代理自动遵循
对 AI 辅助开发流程感兴趣的技术管理者或架构师

en.tag: Packaging senior-engineer workflows and quality gates for AI coding agents
en.what: This repo provides production-grade engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices of senior engineers for AI agents to follow. It covers the full development lifecycle from spec to ship via slash commands and automatic triggers.
en.content: The repo contains 24 skills, each mapped to a development phase or concern (e.g., code review, TDD, web performance), and 8 slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, etc.) to activate them. It also includes a CLI installer supporting 70+ agents.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, relies on the Vercel Labs skills CLI (npx skills add) for installation, compatible with major AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.
en.hot: With 83k stars and +593 today, ranking #2 on trending, it addresses the pain point of AI coding agents lacking engineering discipline by systematizing senior engineer experience, gaining wide attention.
uses: Engineers using AI coding agents who want to improve code quality and consistency
Teams looking to standardize internal best practices and have agents follow them automatically
Technical managers or architects interested in AI-assisted development workflows

zh.tag: 开源身份认证与单点登录平台
zh.what: authentik 是一个开源的身份提供商（IdP），为现代应用提供单点登录（SSO）功能。它支持 SAML、OAuth2/OIDC、LDAP、RADIUS 等多种协议，适用于从个人实验室到大型生产集群的自托管场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 authentik 的核心服务、Outpost（用于代理和认证的组件）以及 Web 前端。提供 Docker Compose、Kubernetes Helm Chart、AWS CloudFormation 和 DigitalOcean Marketplace 等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，后端基于 Django，前端使用 Web 技术（如 JavaScript/TypeScript）。依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis 等常见基础设施组件。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代 Okta、Auth0 等商业 IdP 的方案，authentik 在自托管社区中广受欢迎。今日新增 138 星，总星数达 23168，位列 GitHub 趋势榜第五。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控身份认证基础设施的个人或团队。
中小企业：需要替代昂贵商业 IdP 的可靠身份管理方案。
开发者：需要为应用集成 SSO 或统一认证流程的开发者。
DevOps 工程师：在 Kubernetes 或云环境中部署和管理身份服务。

en.tag: Open-source identity provider and SSO solution
en.what: authentik is an open-source Identity Provider (IdP) that provides single sign-on (SSO) for modern applications. It supports protocols like SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS, and more, designed for self-hosting from small labs to large production clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the core server, outposts (for proxy and authentication), and web frontend. Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm, AWS CloudFormation, and DigitalOcean Marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, with backend based on Django and frontend using web technologies (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript). It relies on common infrastructure components like PostgreSQL and Redis.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to commercial IdPs like Okta and Auth0, authentik is popular in the self-hosting community. With 138 stars today and 23,168 total, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: individuals or teams wanting full control over their identity infrastructure.
SMBs: seeking a reliable identity management solution to replace costly commercial IdPs.
Developers: needing to integrate SSO or unify authentication flows in their applications.
DevOps engineers: deploying and managing identity services in Kubernetes or cloud environments.

zh.tag: 企业级 AI 代理安全检测与响应系统
zh.what: ADR 是 Uber 开发并部署于生产环境的企业级 AI 代理安全系统，用于保护员工使用的编码代理（如 Cursor、Claude Code）和面向客户的 AI 代理。它通过可观测性、安全基准测试、威胁检测和预防来确保代理行为安全。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ADR Sensor（遥测收集与统一模式）、ADR-Bench（含 133 个 MCP 服务器和 303 个基准任务）和 ADR Detector（双代理检测器），并提供可复现论文实验的完整工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Anthropic 和 OpenAI API，通过 uv 管理依赖。
zh.hot: 一周新增 424 星，总星数达 1387，因 Uber 生产验证和 MLSys 2026 论文而备受关注，填补了 AI 代理安全领域的空白。
uses: 安全工程师：评估和加固企业 AI 代理的安全态势
AI 基础设施团队：集成可观测性和威胁检测到现有代理工作流
研究人员：使用 ADR-Bench 基准测试和复现论文实验

en.tag: Enterprise-grade security system for AI agents: observability, benchmarking, detection, prevention
en.what: ADR is an enterprise security system for AI agents, deployed in production at Uber. It secures employee-facing coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and customer-facing AI agents through observability, security benchmarking, threat detection, and prevention.
en.content: The repo includes ADR Sensor (telemetry collection and unified schema), ADR-Bench (133 MCP servers, 303 benchmark tasks), and ADR Detector (dual-agent detector), plus a full reproducibility workflow for the paper.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depends on Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, managed with uv.
en.hot: Gained 424 stars this week (total 1387) due to Uber production deployment and MLSys 2026 paper, filling a gap in AI agent security.
uses: Security engineers: assess and harden enterprise AI agent security posture
AI infrastructure teams: integrate observability and threat detection into agent workflows
Researchers: use ADR-Bench for benchmarking and reproducing paper experiments

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理优化的 Android 开发技能库
zh.what: 这是一个专门为 AI 代理（如 Gemini、Antigravity）设计的 Android 开发技能库，包含模块化的指令和资源，帮助代理遵循 Android 最佳实践。它聚焦于 LLM 表现不佳的领域，通过 SKILL.md 文件为代理提供技术规范和领域知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块（如 r8-analyzer），每个技能由 markdown 文件（SKILL.md）组成，描述任务的技术规范。还提供了 Android CLI 工具，用于安装和管理这些技能到代理目录。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，基于开放标准 agent skills（markdown 格式），依赖 Android CLI 和开发者工具。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手普及，开发者需要标准化技能库提升代理的 Android 开发能力，该项目由 Google 官方支持，star 数快速增长（6.6k+），今日新增 47，登上日榜。
uses: Android 开发者：使用 AI 代理辅助开发时，安装技能以提升代码质量
AI 代理工具链开发者：参考技能格式和实现，构建类似技能库
技术团队：在 CI/CD 中集成代理，利用技能自动化 Android 开发任务

en.tag: AI-optimized modular skills for Android development agents
en.what: This is a repository of AI-optimized, modular skills for Android development agents (like Gemini, Antigravity), containing instructions and resources to help agents follow best practices. It focuses on areas where LLMs underperform, providing technical specs and domain knowledge via SKILL.md files.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules (e.g., r8-analyzer), each consisting of markdown files (SKILL.md) that specify tasks. It also includes an Android CLI tool to install and manage skills into agent directories.
en.stack: Primarily Python, based on the open-standard agent skills (markdown format), with Android CLI and developer tools as dependencies.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding assistants, developers need standardized skill libraries to enhance agents' Android development capabilities. Backed by Google, the project's stars are growing fast (6.6k+), with 47 new today, hitting the daily trending list.
uses: Android developers: install skills to improve code quality when using AI agents
AI agent toolchain developers: reference the skill format and implementation to build similar libraries
Tech teams: integrate agents into CI/CD to automate Android development tasks with skills

zh.tag: 用自然语言构建、部署并运行 AI 代理的开源平台
zh.what: AutoGPT 是一个开源平台，允许用户用自然语言描述目标，自动生成并运行 AI 代理来完成完整的工作流程。它提供可视化构建器、调度和触发功能，让非程序员也能轻松使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AutoGPT 平台的源代码、文档、示例和可视化构建器。它提供四种交互界面：AutoPilot（对话式创建代理）、代理仪表盘、构建器和调度器，并支持自托管。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖现代 AI 模型和工具链，支持与外部服务集成。
zh.hot: AutoGPT 拥有超过 18.6 万星标，是 AI 代理领域的先驱项目，被 Andrej Karpathy 等专家誉为提示工程的下一个前沿。它让非程序员也能轻松创建 AI 代理，因此广受关注。
uses: 希望自动化重复性工作流程的职场人士，通过自然语言创建代理来节省时间。
对 AI 代理感兴趣的开发者，用于学习和构建自定义代理。
企业团队需要部署可调度的 AI 代理来处理数据、报告等任务。
教育者或研究者探索 AI 代理的潜力，进行实验和教学。

en.tag: Open-source platform to build, deploy, and run AI agents with plain English
en.what: AutoGPT is an open-source platform that lets users describe goals in plain English and automatically builds and runs AI agents to complete entire workflows. It offers a visual builder, scheduling, and triggers, making it accessible even to non-programmers.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, examples, and visual builder for the AutoGPT platform. It offers four interaction surfaces: AutoPilot (conversational agent creation), agent dashboard, builder, and scheduler, with self-hosting support.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging modern AI models and toolchains, with integrations for external services.
en.hot: With over 186k stars, AutoGPT is a pioneering project in the AI agent space, praised by experts like Andrej Karpathy as the next frontier of prompt engineering. Its accessibility to non-programmers drives its popularity.
uses: Professionals looking to automate repetitive workflows by creating agents with natural language to save time.
Developers interested in AI agents, for learning and building custom agents.
Teams needing to deploy scheduled AI agents for tasks like data processing or reporting.
Educators or researchers exploring the potential of AI agents for experiments and teaching.

zh.tag: 2027暑期科技实习汇总，每日更新
zh.what: 这是一个由Pitt CSC和Simplify维护的GitHub仓库，汇总了2027年夏季的科技实习岗位，涵盖软件工程、数据科学、AI/ML、量化金融、产品管理和硬件工程等领域。列表每日更新，并支持社区贡献。
zh.content: 仓库包含按类别分类的实习列表（如软件工程119个、数据科学/AI/ML 110个等），每个岗位有链接和标签（如是否提供sponsorship、是否要求公民身份等）。另有非活跃列表、淡季列表和应届生职位仓库的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（可能用于自动化更新），但仓库本身是Markdown格式的列表，依赖GitHub Issues进行贡献管理。
zh.hot: 拥有46k+星标，周增403，因为实习信息对全球学生至关重要，且每日更新、分类清晰，社区活跃。
uses: 计算机及相关专业学生：寻找2027年暑期实习，快速浏览各方向岗位。
求职者：利用标签筛选支持sponsorship或无需公民身份的岗位。
招聘者/社区贡献者：通过提交issue分享新实习机会，帮助他人。
教育机构/职业顾问：作为资源推荐给学生，跟踪行业招聘趋势。

en.tag: Curated Summer 2027 tech internships, updated daily
en.what: This GitHub repo, maintained by Pitt CSC and Simplify, aggregates Summer 2027 tech internships across software engineering, data science, AI/ML, quant finance, product management, and hardware. It's updated daily and open to community contributions.
en.content: Contains categorized internship lists (e.g., 119 SWE, 110 DS/AI/ML roles) with links and tags (sponsorship, citizenship, etc.). Also links to inactive listings, off-season roles, and new-grad positions.
en.stack: Primarily Python (likely for automation), but the repo is a Markdown list; uses GitHub Issues for contributions.
en.hot: With 46k+ stars and +403 weekly, it's vital for students worldwide; daily updates, clear categorization, and active community drive its popularity.
uses: CS and related majors: find Summer 2027 internships across fields.
Job seekers: filter by sponsorship or citizenship tags.
Contributors: submit issues to share new roles and help the community.
Educators/career advisors: recommend to students and track hiring trends.

zh.tag: 法律 AI 代理的开放评测基准
zh.what: Harvey LAB 是一个开源基准测试，用于评估 LLM 代理在真实法律工作环境中的表现。它包含一个任务数据集（包含代理指令、文档和评分标准）以及一个执行框架，用于运行和评估代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含任务数据集、执行框架、文档（教程、架构、评估方法）以及贡献指南。任务覆盖 24+ 法律领域，共 1671 个任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 LLM 代理框架和评估工具，支持自定义模型适配器。
zh.hot: 今日新增 28 星，总星数 1078，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 13 名。作为首个开源法律代理基准，填补了法律 AI 评估空白。
uses: 法律科技公司评估 AI 代理在法律任务上的表现
研究人员对比不同 LLM 在法律场景中的能力
开发者构建和优化法律领域的 AI 代理
法律从业者了解 AI 在法律工作中的潜力

en.tag: Open benchmark for evaluating legal AI agents
en.what: Harvey LAB is an open-source benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on realistic legal work. It comprises a dataset of tasks with agent instructions, documents, and rubrics, plus an execution harness to run and score agents.
en.content: The repo contains a task dataset, execution harness, docs (tutorial, architecture, evaluation methodology), and contribution guide. Tasks span 24+ practice areas with 1,671 tasks.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relies on LLM agent frameworks and evaluation tools, supports custom model adapters.
en.hot: Gained 28 stars today, total 1,078, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending. As the first open-source legal agent benchmark, it fills a gap in legal AI evaluation.
uses: Legal tech companies evaluating AI agents on legal tasks
Researchers comparing LLM capabilities in legal scenarios
Developers building and optimizing legal AI agents
Legal professionals exploring AI potential in legal work

zh.tag: 开源 AI 安全运营中心，可自托管，MIT 许可
zh.what: AiSOC 是一个由 AI 驱动的开源安全运营中心，集成了告警融合、紫队演练、代理辅助分诊和 MITRE ATT&CK 调查等功能。它通过 AI 代理自动分析安全告警，减少噪声，并支持逐步回放代理的推理过程。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个应用和包，如 Web 界面（apps/web）、CLI 工具（packages/aisoc-lite）等，提供完整的 SOC 功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，可能涉及前端框架（如 React）和 AI 代理框架，依赖包括 LLM API 等。
zh.hot: 本周新增 591 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 AI 驱动的安全运营是热点，且项目提供自托管、MIT 许可的完整解决方案。
uses: 安全团队：希望用 AI 自动化告警分诊和调查，减少噪声。
红蓝队：进行紫队演练，测试检测和响应能力。
开发者：对 AI 代理在安全领域的应用感兴趣，可自托管部署。

en.tag: Open-source AI-powered SOC, self-hostable, MIT-licensed
en.what: AiSOC is an open-source, AI-powered Security Operations Center that integrates alert fusion, purple-team drills, agent-assisted triage, and MITRE ATT&CK investigation. It uses AI agents to automatically analyze security alerts, reduce noise, and supports step-by-step replay of agent reasoning.
en.content: The repository contains multiple apps and packages, including a web interface (apps/web) and a CLI tool (packages/aisoc-lite), providing a full SOC feature set.
en.stack: Primarily Python, likely with a frontend framework (e.g., React) and AI agent frameworks, with dependencies on LLM APIs.
en.hot: Gained 591 stars this week, trending on GitHub, because AI-driven security operations are hot, and the project offers a self-hostable, MIT-licensed complete solution.
uses: Security teams: want to automate alert triage and investigation with AI, reducing noise.
Red/blue teams: conduct purple-team drills to test detection and response.
Developers: interested in AI agent applications in security, can self-host.

zh.tag: 多智能体群体智能预测引擎，模拟未来
zh.what: MiroFish 是一个基于多智能体技术的下一代 AI 预测引擎。它从现实世界提取种子信息（如新闻、政策草案、金融信号），自动构建高保真的平行数字世界，让数千个具有独立人格、长期记忆和行为逻辑的智能体自由互动并进行社会演化。用户可以从“上帝视角”动态注入变量，精确推演未来轨迹，从而在数字沙盒中预演未来，优化决策。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎实现，包括智能体模拟、世界构建、预测报告生成等模块，提供 Docker 镜像便于部署，并附有中英文文档和社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，依赖多智能体框架和 AI 模型，支持 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 凭借“预测万物”的宏大愿景和简洁通用的设计，迅速获得 7 万+ Star，本周新增近千，成为 Python 趋势榜常客，吸引了 AI 爱好者和决策者关注。
uses: 决策者：在零风险环境中测试政策、公关策略或商业决策。
研究者：探索群体智能、社会模拟和涌现行为。
开发者：集成预测功能，构建基于多智能体的应用。
创意工作者：用小说或剧本作为种子，生成互动故事世界。

en.tag: Multi-agent swarm intelligence engine for predicting the future
en.what: MiroFish is a next-generation AI prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It extracts seed information from the real world (e.g., breaking news, policy drafts, financial signals) to automatically construct a high-fidelity parallel digital world, where thousands of intelligent agents with independent personalities, long-term memory, and behavioral logic interact freely and undergo social evolution. Users can inject variables dynamically from a 'God's-eye view' to precisely deduce future trajectories, rehearsing the future in a digital sandbox to optimize decisions.
en.content: The repository contains a full engine implementation, including agent simulation, world construction, prediction report generation, and more. It provides a Docker image for easy deployment, along with bilingual documentation and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, leveraging multi-agent frameworks and AI models, with Docker containerization support.
en.hot: With its grand vision of 'predicting anything' and a simple, universal design, it quickly gained over 70k stars, adding nearly a thousand this week, and consistently appears on the Python trending list, attracting AI enthusiasts and decision-makers.
uses: Decision-makers: test policies, PR strategies, or business decisions in a zero-risk environment.
Researchers: explore swarm intelligence, social simulation, and emergent behavior.
Developers: integrate prediction capabilities to build multi-agent applications.
Creative professionals: use novels or scripts as seeds to generate interactive story worlds.

zh.tag: 用编程而非提示词来构建和优化语言模型系统
zh.what: DSPy 是一个用于编程（而非提示）语言模型的框架，允许你快速迭代构建模块化 AI 系统，并提供优化提示和权重的算法。它通过声明式 Python 代码替代脆弱的提示，教会语言模型产出高质量输出。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DSPy 框架的源代码、文档（位于 docs/）、示例和安装说明。核心是声明式编程接口，支持构建分类器、RAG 管道和 Agent 循环等。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习库，支持多种语言模型后端（如 OpenAI、Anthropic 等）。可通过 pip 安装，也支持从 GitHub 安装最新版。
zh.hot: DSPy 在 AI 社区广受欢迎，因其将提示工程转化为编程范式，显著提升开发效率和模型性能。36.9k stars 和持续增长表明其已成为构建 LLM 应用的主流框架之一。
uses: AI 开发者：快速构建和优化复杂的 LLM 管道，如 RAG、Agent 系统
研究人员：探索提示优化、权重微调等前沿方法
数据科学家：用声明式代码替代手动提示调优，提升模型输出质量

en.tag: Programming, not prompting, language models with self-improving pipelines
en.what: DSPy is a framework for programming—rather than prompting—language models, enabling fast iteration on modular AI systems and offering algorithms to optimize prompts and weights. It replaces brittle prompts with compositional Python code to teach LMs to deliver high-quality outputs.
en.content: The repository contains the DSPy framework source code, documentation (in docs/), examples, and installation instructions. The core is a declarative programming interface supporting classifiers, RAG pipelines, and agent loops.
en.stack: Built on Python, with dependencies on deep learning libraries like PyTorch, and supports various LM backends (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic). Installable via pip or directly from GitHub.
en.hot: DSPy is widely popular in the AI community for transforming prompt engineering into a programming paradigm, boosting development efficiency and model performance. With 36.9k stars and steady growth, it has become a mainstream framework for building LLM applications.
uses: AI developers: rapidly build and optimize complex LLM pipelines like RAG and agent systems
Researchers: explore cutting-edge methods in prompt optimization and weight fine-tuning
Data scientists: replace manual prompt tuning with declarative code to improve output quality

zh.tag: 系统设计面试与大规模系统学习一站式指南
zh.what: 这是一个系统设计入门与面试准备的综合性资源库，涵盖大规模系统设计的原则、案例和面试题。它提供结构化的学习路径，帮助工程师掌握构建可扩展系统的能力，并配有 Anki 闪卡辅助记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统设计基础、可扩展性、可用性、一致性等主题的详细笔记，以及常见面试题和解决方案，配有图表和代码示例。还提供多语言翻译和 Anki 闪卡。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，但内容以 Markdown 文档为主，辅以图表（如 PNG 图片）和代码片段。依赖 Anki 用于闪卡学习。
zh.hot: 作为系统设计面试的经典资源，star 数高达 36 万，今日新增 733，长期占据 GitHub 趋势榜。其全面性和实用性使其成为工程师的必备参考。
uses: 准备系统设计面试的求职者 — 提供常见问题和解决方案，助你高效备考。
希望提升系统架构能力的工程师 — 系统学习大规模系统设计原则。
技术面试官 — 参考其中问题与答案，设计面试题目。
计算机科学学生 — 作为系统设计课程的补充教材。

en.tag: One-stop guide for system design interviews and large-scale system learning
en.what: A comprehensive resource for learning system design and preparing for interviews, covering principles, case studies, and interview questions. It offers a structured learning path to help engineers master building scalable systems, with Anki flashcards for memorization.
en.content: The repo contains detailed notes on system design fundamentals, scalability, availability, consistency, etc., along with common interview questions and solutions with diagrams and code examples. It also offers multi-language translations and Anki flashcards.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, but content is mostly Markdown documents, supplemented with diagrams (e.g., PNG images) and code snippets. Uses Anki for flashcards.
en.hot: As a classic resource for system design interviews, it has 362k stars, with 733 new today, consistently trending on GitHub. Its comprehensiveness and practicality make it a must-have reference for engineers.
uses: Job seekers preparing for system design interviews — provides common questions and solutions for efficient preparation.
Engineers looking to improve system architecture skills — systematically learn large-scale system design principles.
Technical interviewers — reference questions and answers to design interview problems.
Computer science students — as supplementary material for system design courses.

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。
zh.content: 仓库包含产品文档、快速入门指南、模型目录说明，以及各产品（桌面、CLI、Web、云、聊天）的详细介绍和安装链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，CLI 通过 npm 安装，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GPT-5.6 Luna 等），桌面端可集成本地 Claude Code 和 Codex 代理。
zh.hot: 免费且无需API密钥的AI编码工具，提供多产品覆盖和多种模型选择，今日新增105星，登上GitHub趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：在终端或桌面端快速进行AI辅助编码
全栈开发者：使用Web版构建和部署完整应用
研究者：通过聊天版进行AI驱动的研究与思考
团队：在GitHub仓库上运行云端代理进行协作

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, CLI installable via npm, supports multiple models (DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, etc.), and Desktop can integrate local Claude Code and Codex agents.
en.hot: Free AI coding tool with no API key required, offering multi-product coverage and model variety; gained 105 stars today and hit the GitHub trending list.
uses: Developers: AI-assisted coding from terminal or desktop
Full-stack developers: build and ship apps with the Web version
Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat
Teams: run cloud agents on GitHub repositories for collaboration

zh.tag: 开源 AI 销售操作系统，自托管 CRM 集成 WhatsApp 智能代理
zh.what: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，将 CRM 与原生 AI 代理相结合，能够在 WhatsApp 上自动接待、筛选和销售。它是 Kommo、Octadesk 和 Intercom 的开放替代品，支持自托管、多租户和 LGPD 合规。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CRM 应用（基于 Next.js 16 和 TypeScript）、WhatsApp 集成（通过 WAHA）、Supabase 后端（Postgres、Auth、Storage）、一键安装脚本（hostgator-setup-kit）以及文档（架构、路线图、运行手册）。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Next.js 16、TypeScript（严格模式）、Supabase（Postgres、Auth、Storage）、WAHA（WhatsApp API）、Docker 和 CI（GitHub Actions）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 166 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 6，因其提供免费、自托管的 AI 销售解决方案，无需月费且数据自主可控，吸引寻求替代昂贵 CRM 的中小企业。
uses: 销售团队：通过 WhatsApp 自动接待和筛选潜在客户，提高转化率
中小型企业：希望摆脱按月付费的 CRM，自托管并保留数据所有权
开发者：需要可定制、支持 MCP 的 CRM 平台，可集成到现有工作流
巴西及拉美市场：需要符合 LGPD 的本地化销售工具

en.tag: Open-source AI sales OS: self-hosted CRM with native WhatsApp AI agents
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales operating system that combines a CRM with native AI agents to automatically attend, qualify, and sell on WhatsApp. It is an open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk, and Intercom, self-hosted, multi-tenant, and LGPD-compliant.
en.content: The repository contains a full CRM app (Next.js 16 and TypeScript), WhatsApp integration via WAHA, Supabase backend (Postgres, Auth, Storage), one-command installation scripts (hostgator-setup-kit), and docs (architecture, roadmap, runbooks).
en.stack: Tech stack includes Next.js 16, TypeScript (strict), Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), WAHA (WhatsApp API), Docker, and CI via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: Gained 166 stars this week, ranking #6 on TypeScript trending, because it offers a free, self-hosted AI sales solution with no monthly fees and full data control, appealing to SMBs seeking an alternative to expensive CRMs.
uses: Sales teams: automate lead qualification and engagement on WhatsApp to boost conversions
SMBs: want to avoid monthly CRM fees and self-host with full data ownership
Developers: need a customizable, MCP-ready CRM platform to integrate into existing workflows
Brazil/LATAM market: require LGPD-compliant, localized sales tools

zh.tag: 企业级 UI 设计语言与 React 组件库
zh.what: Ant Design 是一套面向企业级应用的 UI 设计语言和 React 组件库，提供丰富的开箱即用的高质量组件，帮助开发者快速构建优雅、一致的用户界面。它基于设计原则和最佳实践，支持主题定制和国际化。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 React 组件源码、设计规范文档、示例、测试、构建配置等。核心组件包括按钮、表单、表格、日期选择器等，并提供了图标、布局、反馈等模块。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 TypeScript 构建，使用 Less 进行样式开发，支持 CSS-in-JS 方案。依赖包括 dayjs、rc-* 系列组件库等，通过 npm 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 React 生态最流行的 UI 库之一，拥有近 10 万 star，本周新增 128 星，持续保持高关注度。其稳定性和丰富的组件使其成为企业级应用的首选。
uses: 企业级中后台管理系统开发
需要一致设计语言和高质量组件的 React 项目
快速原型和产品迭代，减少 UI 开发成本
团队协作，遵循统一设计规范

en.tag: Enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
en.what: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library, offering a rich set of high-quality, out-of-the-box components to help developers quickly build elegant and consistent user interfaces. It is based on design principles and best practices, supporting theme customization and internationalization.
en.content: The repository contains complete React component source code, design specification docs, examples, tests, build configs, etc. Core components include Button, Form, Table, DatePicker, and more, along with icons, layout, feedback modules.
en.stack: Built with React and TypeScript, styled with Less, and supports CSS-in-JS. Dependencies include dayjs, rc-* component libraries, distributed via npm.
en.hot: As one of the most popular UI libraries in the React ecosystem, it has nearly 100k stars, with 128 new stars this week, maintaining high attention. Its stability and rich components make it the go-to for enterprise apps.
uses: Developing enterprise-level admin dashboards
React projects needing consistent design language and high-quality components
Rapid prototyping and product iteration, reducing UI development cost
Team collaboration with unified design standards

zh.tag: Hermes Agent 的多平台 Web 控制台与桌面应用
zh.what: Hermes Studio 是 Hermes Agent 的配套界面，提供桌面应用、本地运行时和 Web 控制台。用户可以在其中与代理聊天、构建可视化工作流、管理模型和配置文件，并保持所有数据本地化。
zh.content: 仓库包含客户端、服务端等包，提供 AI 聊天、会话管理、自动化工作流、文件浏览器、终端等工具。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Socket.IO 实现实时通信，SQLite 存储会话，支持 npm 和 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 321 星，总星数破万，登上 TypeScript 周榜，因其为 Hermes Agent 提供了易用的可视化界面，降低了使用门槛。
uses: 希望以图形化方式管理 Hermes Agent 的开发者
需要本地化 AI 聊天和自动化工作流的团队
对多平台代理控制台感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Multi-platform web console and desktop app for Hermes Agent
en.what: Hermes Studio is a companion interface for Hermes Agent, offering a desktop app, local runtime, and web console. Users can chat with agents, build visual workflows, manage models and profiles, and keep everything local.
en.content: The repository contains client and server packages, offering AI chat, session management, automation workflows, file browser, terminal, and more.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses Socket.IO for real-time communication, SQLite for session storage, and supports npm and Docker deployment.
en.hot: Gained 321 stars this week, surpassing 10k total, and hit the TypeScript weekly trending list, thanks to its user-friendly visual interface for Hermes Agent, lowering the entry barrier.
uses: Developers who want a graphical way to manage Hermes Agent
Teams needing local AI chat and automation workflows
Tech enthusiasts interested in multi-platform agent consoles

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 代码库（约 8 万行）、TypeScript 编写的编码代理包，以及安装脚本和文档。提供 60+ 提供商、31 个内置工具、14 个 LSP 操作和 28 个 DAP 操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 TypeScript，运行时支持 Bun（推荐），并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。依赖包括 LSP 和 DAP 协议，以及多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Pi 的 fork，它提供了更强大的代理表面，并持续根据真实使用进行调优。本周新增 1739 星，总星数达 22525，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，反映了开发者对终端 AI 编码工具的高度关注。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
需要高度可定制和可扩展的 AI 代理，支持多种提供商和工具
喜欢使用 Rust 和 TypeScript 构建高性能命令行工具的技术爱好者
希望利用 LSP 和 DAP 集成进行代码导航和调试的开发者

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in
en.what: oh-my-pi is a terminal AI coding agent that integrates IDE capabilities into the command line. It supports hash-anchored edits, an optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, and subagents, aiming to provide an out-of-the-box yet deeply customizable coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains a core Rust codebase (~80k lines), a TypeScript coding agent package, and installation scripts and docs. It offers 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: AI 工程基础框架，让 AI 代理直接生成生产级业务应用
zh.what: Open Mercato 是一个开源基础框架，旨在解决 AI 代码助手只生成代码但不知道代码放哪、如何分层的问题。它提供架构感知的 AI 工具链，让 Cursor、Claude Code 等代理能自主完成从添加数据表到实现完整功能的任务，并内置 CRM/ERP 等企业级模块，让开发者从 80% 完成度开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用（apps/mercato）、AI 技能与规范（specs）、领域模块（CRM、销售、订单等）、文档与示例，以及用于代码审查、工单流程和调试的协作工具。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Next.js，采用规范优先开发，集成 AI 代理工具链（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex），并包含多租户、RBAC、事件流等架构决策。
zh.hot: 本周新增 52 星，登上 TypeScript 周榜第 11 名。它切中 AI 编程的痛点——AI 生成代码但缺乏架构一致性，提供开箱即用的企业级模块，让团队能快速用 AI 交付生产级应用。
uses: CTO/技术负责人：已部署 Cursor/Copilot 但发现不够用，希望让整个团队进入 AI 辅助开发。
开发者：想快速构建专业业务应用和后端，避免重复造轮子。
创业公司：需要 CRM/ERP 等企业级功能，但不想从零开始。
AI 工具链集成者：希望为 AI 代理提供架构感知的代码生成环境。

en.tag: AI-Engineering Foundation Framework for production-grade apps with AI agents
en.what: Open Mercato is an open-source foundation framework that solves the problem of AI code assistants generating code without knowing where to place it or how to layer it. It provides an architecture-aware AI harness, enabling agents like Cursor and Claude Code to autonomously handle tasks from adding data tables to implementing full features, with built-in CRM/ERP modules so developers start at 80% done.
en.content: The repo includes a Next.js app (apps/mercato), AI skills and specs, domain modules (CRM, sales, OMS, etc.), documentation and examples, plus collaboration tools for code review, ticketing, and debugging.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Next.js, spec-first development, integrated with AI agent toolchains (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex), and includes architectural decisions like multi-tenancy, RBAC, and event flow.
en.hot: Gained 52 stars this week, ranking #11 on the TypeScript weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI coding—generated code lacks architectural consistency—by offering ready-made enterprise modules, enabling teams to ship production apps fast with AI.
uses: CTOs/tech leads: already deployed Cursor/Copilot but found it insufficient, want to onboard the whole team to AI-assisted dev.
Developers: want to build professional business apps and backends quickly without reinventing the wheel.
Startups: need enterprise features like CRM/ERP but don't want to start from scratch.
AI toolchain integrators: want an architecture-aware code generation environment for AI agents.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，GUI+TUI 一体化
zh.what: Kun 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，将代码、写作、设计、研究和自动化整合到一个产品中。它通过共享运行时连接桌面 GUI 和终端 TUI，让任务从澄清到交付全程可控、可回溯。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面 GUI 和终端 TUI 的完整实现，支持多平台（macOS、Windows、Linux），内置多种工作模式（Direct、Agent Graph），并提供文档、示例和安装包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖跨平台桌面框架和终端 UI 库，支持多种模型接入（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容、自托管等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 6091，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 12 名。其本地优先、GUI+TUI 共享运行时的理念吸引开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：用于 AI 编程、代码审查和自动化任务，可在 GUI 或 TUI 中操作。
写作者：利用 AI 写作、润色和文档导出，支持 Markdown、PDF 等格式。
设计师：生成交互原型和设计系统，并与代码实现衔接。
研究人员：处理 PDF、图片等多模态资料，进行研究和分析。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace unifying GUI & TUI
en.what: Kun is a local-first AI agent workspace that unifies coding, writing, design, research, and automation in one product. It connects desktop GUI and terminal TUI via a shared runtime, making tasks visible, controllable, and traceable from clarification to delivery.
en.content: The repo contains full implementations of desktop GUI and terminal TUI, supporting multiple platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux), with built-in modes like Direct and Agent Graph, plus docs, examples, and installers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, leveraging cross-platform desktop frameworks and terminal UI libraries, with support for multiple model providers (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible, self-hosted, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, reaching 6,091 total, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its local-first approach and unified GUI+TUI runtime resonate with developers.
uses: Developers: AI coding, code review, and automation, operable via GUI or TUI.
Writers: AI writing, polishing, and document export (Markdown, PDF, etc.).
Designers: Generate interactive prototypes and design systems, bridging to code.
Researchers: Process multimodal sources like PDFs and images for research.

zh.tag: 可视化拖拽构建 AI 智能体与工作流
zh.what: Flowise 是一个开源的可视化工具，允许用户通过拖拽组件的方式构建 AI 智能体、聊天机器人和自动化工作流。它提供了直观的界面，无需编写代码即可集成各种 AI 模型、工具和数据源。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 monorepo，内含多个模块：server（Node.js 后端）、ui（React 前端）、components（第三方节点集成）以及 api-documentation（自动生成的 Swagger API 文档）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js、React 和 TypeScript，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 5.5 万+ stars 和本周新增 213 颗星，Flowise 成为构建 AI 智能体的热门选择，其可视化拖拽方式大幅降低了 AI 应用开发门槛，吸引了大量开发者和非技术用户。
uses: 开发者快速原型验证 AI 应用，无需从零编写代码
非技术用户（如产品经理、业务分析师）通过可视化界面构建聊天机器人和自动化流程
企业集成现有 LLM、向量数据库和工具，搭建内部 AI 助手
教育场景中用于教学 AI 概念和 Agent 工作流设计

en.tag: Build AI agents and workflows via drag-and-drop visual interface
en.what: Flowise is an open-source visual tool that lets users build AI agents, chatbots, and automation workflows by dragging and dropping components. It provides an intuitive interface to integrate various AI models, tools, and data sources without coding.
en.content: The repository is a monorepo with modules: server (Node.js backend), ui (React frontend), components (third-party node integrations), and api-documentation (auto-generated Swagger API docs).
en.stack: Built on Node.js, React, and TypeScript, managed with pnpm, and supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With over 55k stars and 213 new stars this week, Flowise is a popular choice for building AI agents, as its visual drag-and-drop approach significantly lowers the barrier to AI app development, attracting many developers and non-technical users.
uses: Developers rapidly prototype AI applications without writing code from scratch
Non-technical users (e.g., product managers, business analysts) build chatbots and automation flows via visual interface
Enterprises integrate existing LLMs, vector DBs, and tools to create internal AI assistants
Educational settings for teaching AI concepts and agent workflow design

zh.tag: Claude Code 全家桶：代理、技能、钩子、规则与 MCP 配置
zh.what: 这是一个由 Anthropic 黑客松获奖者开发的 Claude Code 配置集合，包含生产级的代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置。这些配置经过 10 多个月的日常使用打磨，用于构建真实产品。

en.tag: Complete Claude Code toolkit: agents, skills, hooks, rules, and MCP configs

AI-assisted dev teams: teams needing standardized agents, skills, and hooks.

zh.what: witr 是一个命令行工具，用于回答“为什么这个在运行？”的问题。它能追溯进程、端口、容器或文件是由谁启动的，并展示完整的启动链，如 systemd → PM2 → node。支持 CLI 输出、机器可读 JSON 和交互式 TUI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 程序，提供安装脚本、文档和浏览器演示。核心功能是解析进程树、服务管理器、容器和文件系统，生成因果链。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖系统工具如 ps、lsof、ss、systemctl、docker 等来收集信息。支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 FreeBSD。
zh.hot: 解决了开发者常遇到的“这个进程/端口是谁启动的”痛点，提供直观的因果链展示，且支持多平台和多种包管理器，上线后迅速获得近 2 万星。
uses: 系统管理员排查异常进程或端口占用，快速定位源头。
开发者在容器或微服务环境中追踪服务启动链，便于调试。
安全分析师调查可疑进程或文件来源，辅助取证。
DevOps 工程师理解系统启动流程，优化服务管理。

en.tag: Trace any process, port, container, or file back to its origin with CLI+TUI
en.what: witr is a CLI tool that answers 'Why is this running?' by tracing any process, port, container, or file back to the exact chain that started it, such as systemd → PM2 → node. It offers CLI output, machine-readable JSON, and an interactive TUI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI and TUI program, along with installation scripts, documentation, and a browser demo. It parses process trees, service managers, containers, and file systems to generate causal chains.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it leverages system utilities like ps, lsof, ss, systemctl, and docker to gather information. Supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and FreeBSD.
en.hot: It solves the common pain point of 'who started this process/port' with intuitive causal chain visualization, multi-platform support, and multiple package managers, quickly gaining nearly 20k stars.
uses: System admins investigating abnormal processes or port usage to quickly locate the source.
Developers tracing service startup chains in container or microservice environments for debugging.
Security analysts investigating suspicious processes or file origins for forensics.
DevOps engineers understanding system startup flows to optimize service management.

zh.tag: 统一云端与本地离线推理的跨平台 AI 客户端
zh.what: 这是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，无需联网），同时可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini 或 Kimi 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久化会话、后台任务和智能自动配置等功能。

uses: 注重隐私的用户：希望在本地运行模型，避免数据上传到云端。
移动开发者：需要参考 Flutter 跨平台 AI 客户端架构和本地推理集成。
AI 爱好者：希望在没有网络或低配设备上体验 LLM 和图像生成。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client bridging cloud APIs and on-device offline LLM inference
en.what: A production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android with GPU acceleration (no internet after download) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, background tasks, and smart auto-configuration.

en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), uses GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and Firebase for push notifications. Local inference relies on Vulkan acceleration.

Mobile developers looking for a reference Flutter cross-platform AI client architecture and local inference integration.
AI enthusiasts who want to experiment with LLMs and image generation offline or on low-end devices.

zh.tag: 1-bit LLM 官方推理框架，CPU 上高效运行
zh.what: BitNet 是微软推出的 1-bit 大语言模型推理框架，旨在让超低比特量化模型在 CPU 上高效运行。它支持 BitNet b1.58 等三元模型，并提供优化的内核和工具链，实现接近全精度模型的性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎（C++ 实现）、CPU 和 GPU 内核、模型转换工具、示例代码，以及针对嵌入模型的 I2_S 量化支持。还发布了 BitNet-embedding 系列模型和 VibeASR.cpp 等衍生项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 OpenMP 等并行库，支持 x86 (AVX2) 和 ARM (NEON) 指令集，并提供 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: BitNet 代表了 LLM 推理的极低比特量化方向，能大幅降低内存和计算需求，在 CPU 上实现高效推理。近 4 万星标表明社区对边缘部署和成本优化的强烈兴趣。
uses: 在无 GPU 的服务器或边缘设备上部署 LLM，降低硬件成本
需要低延迟、高吞吐的 CPU 推理场景，如实时语音识别（VibeASR）
研究低比特量化技术和模型压缩的开发者
构建嵌入模型应用，利用 BitNet-embedding 加速检索

en.tag: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, efficient on CPU
en.what: BitNet is Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, enabling efficient CPU deployment of ternary models like BitNet b1.58. It provides optimized kernels and tooling to achieve near-full-precision performance.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference engine (C++), CPU and GPU kernels, model conversion tools, examples, and I2_S quantization support for embedding models. It also hosts BitNet-embedding models and VibeASR.cpp.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with OpenMP for parallelism, supporting x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON), and offering Python bindings.
en.hot: BitNet represents the extreme low-bit quantization direction for LLM inference, drastically reducing memory and compute needs while enabling efficient CPU inference. Its ~40k stars reflect strong community interest in edge deployment and cost optimization.
uses: Deploy LLMs on CPU-only servers or edge devices to cut hardware costs
Low-latency, high-throughput CPU inference scenarios like real-time ASR (VibeASR)
Developers researching low-bit quantization and model compression
Build embedding-based applications with accelerated retrieval via BitNet-embedding

zh.tag: GPU 多卡通信原语库，高性能集合通信
zh.what: NCCL 是一个独立的 GPU 通信库，实现了 all-reduce、all-gather、reduce、broadcast、reduce-scatter 以及任意 send/receive 通信模式。它针对 PCIe、NVLink、NVswitch 以及 InfiniBand 或 TCP/IP 网络进行了优化，支持单节点或多节点任意数量的 GPU，可用于单进程或多进程（如 MPI）应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NCCL 库的源代码、构建脚本（支持 Debian/RPM/txz 包和 Python wheel）、测试工具（通过单独的 nccl-tests 仓库）以及文档。主要目录包括 src/（核心实现）、makefiles/（构建配置）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CUDA 工具链，支持多种 GPU 架构（通过 NVCC_GENCODE 配置）。构建系统基于 Makefile，可生成多种格式的安装包。
zh.hot: NCCL 是 NVIDIA 官方的高性能 GPU 通信库，是深度学习分布式训练的关键组件，几乎所有主流框架（如 PyTorch、TensorFlow）都依赖它。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期保持高关注度，在 C++ 日榜中排名第四。
uses: 深度学习工程师：在多 GPU 或多节点环境下训练大规模模型，需要高效集合通信。
HPC 开发者：构建高性能计算应用，利用 GPU 集群进行并行计算。
框架开发者：集成 NCCL 以优化分布式训练性能。
研究人员：需要了解或定制 GPU 通信原语以进行实验。

en.tag: Optimized primitives for collective multi-GPU communication
en.what: NCCL is a stand-alone library of standard communication routines for GPUs, implementing all-reduce, all-gather, reduce, broadcast, reduce-scatter, and any send/receive based communication pattern. It is optimized for high bandwidth on platforms using PCIe, NVLink, NVswitch, and networking via InfiniBand or TCP/IP, supporting any number of GPUs in a single node or across multiple nodes, and usable in single- or multi-process (e.g., MPI) applications.
en.content: The repository contains the NCCL library source code, build scripts (for Debian/RPM/txz packages and Python wheel), tests (maintained separately in nccl-tests), and documentation. Key directories include src/ (core implementation), makefiles/ (build configuration), etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on CUDA toolkit, supports multiple GPU architectures (configurable via NVCC_GENCODE). Build system is Makefile-based, producing various package formats.
en.hot: NCCL is NVIDIA's official high-performance GPU communication library, a critical component for distributed deep learning training, relied upon by major frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow. Although today's star increase is modest, it maintains high long-term attention, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Deep learning engineers: training large models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups requiring efficient collective communication.
HPC developers: building high-performance computing applications leveraging GPU clusters.
Framework developers: integrating NCCL to optimize distributed training performance.
Researchers: needing to understand or customize GPU communication primitives for experiments.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上的机器学习数组框架
zh.what: MLX 是苹果机器学习研究团队推出的面向 Apple 芯片的数组框架，提供类似 NumPy 的 Python API 以及 C++、C、Swift API。它支持自动微分、自动向量化、惰性计算和动态图构建，并采用统一内存模型，可在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、Python 绑定、高层包（如 mlx.nn 和 mlx.optimizers）、文档和示例。示例涵盖 Transformer 训练、LLaMA 推理与 LoRA 微调、Stable Diffusion 图像生成和 Whisper 语音识别等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，提供 Python、C、Swift API。依赖包括 Metal 和 Accelerate 框架，用于 GPU 加速和高效计算。
zh.hot: 作为苹果官方开源的机器学习框架，MLX 在 Apple 生态中备受关注，star 数已达 2.79 万。其统一内存和动态图设计使其在 Apple 芯片上训练和部署模型非常高效，吸引了大量研究人员和开发者。
uses: Apple 平台上的机器学习研究人员，希望快速实验新想法。
在 Mac 上训练或微调大语言模型（如 LLaMA）的开发者。
需要利用 Apple 芯片 GPU 进行高性能计算的工程师。
对 NumPy/PyTorch 熟悉，希望在 Apple 设备上无缝迁移的用户。

en.tag: Array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon
en.what: MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, developed by Apple's ML research team. It offers NumPy-like Python APIs along with C++, C, and Swift APIs, supporting automatic differentiation, vectorization, lazy computation, and dynamic graph construction. With a unified memory model, it runs efficiently on both CPU and GPU.
en.content: The repo contains core C++ implementation, Python bindings, high-level packages (mlx.nn, mlx.optimizers), documentation, and examples. Examples include Transformer training, LLaMA inference with LoRA fine-tuning, Stable Diffusion image generation, and Whisper speech recognition.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Python, C, and Swift APIs. It leverages Metal and Accelerate frameworks for GPU acceleration and efficient computation.
en.hot: As Apple's official open-source ML framework, MLX has gained significant attention in the Apple ecosystem, reaching 27.9k stars. Its unified memory and dynamic graph design make it highly efficient for training and deploying models on Apple silicon, attracting researchers and developers.
uses: ML researchers on Apple platforms seeking rapid experimentation.
Developers training or fine-tuning LLMs (e.g., LLaMA) on Mac.
Engineers needing high-performance compute on Apple silicon GPUs.
Users familiar with NumPy/PyTorch wanting seamless migration to Apple devices.

zh.tag: 基于GZDoom的DOOM引擎增强移植版
zh.what: UZDoom 是一个现代、功能丰富的 DOOM 引擎移植版，基于 GZDoom 开发，为经典 DOOM 游戏提供高清分辨率、动态光照、3D 地板等高级特性，并支持现代 OpenGL 和 Vulkan 渲染器。它延续了 ZDoom 和 GZDoom 的传承，由社区维护，免费开源。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎源代码、构建脚本、品牌资源（如 SVG 图标和横幅）、翻译状态文件以及贡献者列表。支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 平台，并提供详细的构建指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan 渲染 API，并可能使用 CMake 等构建工具。基于 GZDoom 代码库，继承了其技术栈。
zh.hot: 作为 GZDoom 的活跃分支，UZDoom 凭借其先进渲染器和强大脚本能力吸引了大量 DOOM 模组社区用户。本周新增 32 星，总星数达 2065，在 C++ 周榜排名第 16，显示其持续受到关注。
uses: DOOM 玩家：体验增强画质和现代渲染效果，重温经典游戏。
模组开发者：利用强大的脚本能力和扩展支持，创建自定义内容。
引擎爱好者：研究基于 GZDoom 的现代移植版代码，学习游戏引擎开发。
开源贡献者：参与翻译、代码贡献或社区维护。

en.tag: Feature-centric DOOM engine source port based on GZDoom
en.what: UZDoom is a modern, feature-rich source port for the classic game DOOM, based on GZDoom. It enhances the original engine with high-resolution graphics, dynamic lighting, 3D floors, and extensive modding support, while supporting modern OpenGL and Vulkan renderers. It continues the legacy of ZDoom and GZDoom, is free and open-source, and is maintained by a dedicated community.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, build scripts, branding assets (such as SVG icons and banners), translation status files, and a contributors list. It supports Linux, Windows, and macOS platforms, with detailed build instructions.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging OpenGL/Vulkan rendering APIs, and likely using CMake for building. Based on the GZDoom codebase, inheriting its tech stack.
en.hot: As an active fork of GZDoom, UZDoom attracts DOOM modding communities with its advanced renderer and powerful scripting. With 32 stars added this week and a total of 2065, it ranks #16 on the C++ weekly trending list, showing sustained interest.
uses: DOOM players: Experience enhanced graphics and modern rendering effects, reliving the classic game.
Mod developers: Create custom content using powerful scripting and extensive modding support.
Engine enthusiasts: Study the codebase of a modern GZDoom-based port to learn game engine development.
Open-source contributors: Participate in translation, code contributions, or community maintenance.

zh.tag: 跨平台 Android 实时投屏与控制工具
zh.what: QtScrcpy 是一款通过 USB 或网络显示和控制 Android 设备的软件，无需 root 权限。它支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS 三大平台，注重轻量、高性能、低延迟和非侵入性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 QtScrcpy 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Windows/macOS/Ubuntu）、截图、文档（如按键映射脚本规则），以及作者开发的更专业的投屏软件 QuickMirror 的推广信息。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架开发，依赖 adb 进行设备通信，支持 GPU 视频渲染（在 QuickMirror 中提及）。
zh.hot: 作为 scrcpy 的 Qt 图形化版本，它提供了更友好的界面和按键映射功能，方便游戏玩家和开发者使用。今日新增 174 星，总星数超 3.1 万，位列 C++ 日榜第三，持续受到关注。
uses: 安卓开发者：无需 root 即可调试和演示应用，实时查看设备屏幕。
游戏玩家：通过按键映射脚本，用键盘鼠标玩手机游戏（如 PUBG Mobile）。
技术支持：远程协助或批量管理多台 Android 设备（结合 QuickMirror 可管理 500+ 台）。

en.tag: Cross-platform Android real-time display and control tool
en.what: QtScrcpy is a software that displays and controls Android devices via USB or over the network, requiring no root privileges. It supports GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS, focusing on lightness, performance, low latency, and non-intrusiveness.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of QtScrcpy, cross-platform build configurations (Windows/macOS/Ubuntu), screenshots, documentation (e.g., key mapping script rules), and promotional info for the author's more professional screen casting software QuickMirror.
en.stack: Developed primarily with C++ and Qt framework, relies on adb for device communication, and supports GPU video rendering (mentioned in QuickMirror).
en.hot: As a Qt graphical version of scrcpy, it offers a friendlier UI and key mapping features, appealing to gamers and developers. With 174 stars today and over 31k total, it ranks #3 on the C++ daily trending list, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Android developers: debug and demo apps without root, view device screen in real time.
Gamers: play mobile games (e.g., PUBG Mobile) with keyboard and mouse via key mapping scripts.
Tech support: remote assistance or batch management of multiple Android devices (with QuickMirror, manage 500+ devices).

zh.tag: 英特尔开源 AI 推理优化与部署工具套件
zh.what: OpenVINO 是一个开源工具包，用于优化和部署深度学习模型，提升推理性能。它支持多种主流框架（如 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX）训练的模型，并能将其转换为中间表示（IR）格式，从而实现跨平台的高效推理。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时、模型优化工具、前端转换器（支持多种框架）、插件（CPU/GPU/NPU）以及丰富的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、C++、Node.js 等 API，并支持通过 pip、conda、brew 等包管理器安装。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 推理需求激增，OpenVINO 作为成熟的优化工具，在边缘和云部署中广受欢迎，本周新增 39 星，位列 C++ 周榜第 17 名。
uses: 开发者：在边缘设备或云端部署深度学习模型，提升推理速度并降低资源消耗。
数据科学家：将 PyTorch/TensorFlow 等模型转换为 OpenVINO 格式，实现跨平台部署。
AI 应用集成：与 Hugging Face Optimum Intel 集成，直接部署 transformers 和 diffusers 模型。

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
en.what: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models, boosting inference performance. It supports models trained with popular frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX, and converts them to an intermediate representation (IR) format for efficient cross-platform inference.
en.content: The repository includes the core runtime, model optimization tools, frontend converters for multiple frameworks, plugins for CPU/GPU/NPU, and extensive samples and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it offers Python, C++, and Node.js APIs, and can be installed via pip, conda, brew, and other package managers.
en.hot: With the surge in AI inference demand, OpenVINO as a mature optimization toolkit is widely adopted for edge and cloud deployment, gaining 39 stars this week and ranking #17 on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Developers: Deploy deep learning models on edge devices or cloud to boost inference speed and reduce resource usage.
Data scientists: Convert PyTorch/TensorFlow models to OpenVINO format for cross-platform deployment.
AI application integration: Integrate with Hugging Face Optimum Intel to deploy transformers and diffusers models directly.

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: ESP32 的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32 Marauder 是一套专为 ESP32 芯片设计的 WiFi 和蓝牙攻击与防御工具集。它提供了多种功能，如网络扫描、数据包注入、deauth 攻击、蓝牙嗅探等，适用于安全研究和渗透测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、预编译的发布版本、详细的 Wiki 文档以及用于构建和测试的自动化工作流。固件基于 C++ 编写，支持多种 ESP32 开发板，并提供了命令行和 Web 界面进行交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 ESP-IDF 框架，依赖 Arduino 库和 ESP32 的 WiFi/蓝牙协议栈。构建系统支持 PlatformIO 和 Arduino IDE，并集成了 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 11,000 颗星，本周新增 114 颗，位列 C++ 周榜第 20 名。其热度源于对 WiFi/蓝牙安全研究的高需求，以及提供了易于使用的工具集和活跃的社区支持。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于测试 WiFi 网络的安全性，执行渗透测试和漏洞评估。
网络安全爱好者：学习 WiFi/蓝牙协议和攻击技术，进行实验和演示。
嵌入式开发者：参考其代码结构，学习 ESP32 的无线通信和固件开发。
教育机构：作为教学工具，展示无线网络安全概念和实践。

en.tag: A suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for the ESP32
en.what: ESP32 Marauder is a suite of WiFi and Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools designed for the ESP32 chip. It offers various features such as network scanning, packet injection, deauth attacks, and Bluetooth sniffing, suitable for security research and penetration testing.
en.content: The repository contains complete firmware source code, precompiled releases, detailed wiki documentation, and automated workflows for building and testing. The firmware is written in C++ and supports various ESP32 development boards, offering both command-line and web interfaces for interaction.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, based on the ESP-IDF framework, with dependencies on Arduino libraries and the ESP32's WiFi/Bluetooth protocol stacks. The build system supports PlatformIO and Arduino IDE, and integrates GitHub Actions for continuous integration.
en.hot: The project has over 11,000 stars on GitHub, with 114 new stars this week, ranking 20th on the C++ weekly trending list. Its popularity stems from the high demand for WiFi/Bluetooth security research, the ease-of-use toolset, and active community support.
uses: Security researchers: to test WiFi network security, perform penetration testing and vulnerability assessment.
Cybersecurity enthusiasts: to learn WiFi/Bluetooth protocols and attack techniques, conduct experiments and demonstrations.
Embedded developers: to reference its code structure and learn ESP32 wireless communication and firmware development.
Educational institutions: as a teaching tool to demonstrate wireless network security concepts and practices.

zh.tag: 开源免费AI网关，单端点聚合264家模型提供商并智能压缩省token
zh.what: OmniRoute 是一个开源的免费 AI 网关，通过单一 API 端点聚合了 264+ 家模型提供商（含 90+ 免费 tier），让你能把 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等主流编程工具无缝接入免费的 Claude、GPT 或 Gemini。它内置 RTK+Caveman 双层压缩算法，可自动减少 15%–95% 的 token 消耗，并支持智能故障自动回退、MCP/A2A 协议以及多模态接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含可直接部署的网关核心、Web 管理后台（Dashboard）、PWA 与桌面端应用，以及详细的路由策略配置、免费额度文档和 Provider 接入模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 全栈构建，网关层采用 Node.js 高并发架构，前端提供 React 驱动的 Dashboard 与 PWA，并支持 Desktop 端封装。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3,605 Star、总星数突破 1.8 万并登上 GitHub 周榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对「零成本调用多模型」的强烈需求——聚合 90+ 免费提供商与高达 95% 的 token 压缩能力，直接切中了 AI 应用落地时的成本焦虑。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小型团队 —— 想用 Claude/GPT/Gemini 但预算有限，通过免费 tier 聚合实现零成本调用。
AI 编程工具重度用户 —— 将 Cursor、Cline、Claude Code 等 IDE 插件的底层模型切换到免费提供商。
网关/中间件自建者 —— 需要统一端点管理多模型路由、自动容灾和 token 压缩的企业内部 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback
en.what: OmniRoute is an open-source free AI gateway that aggregates 264+ providers—including 90+ free tiers—behind a single API endpoint, letting you plug Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other tools into free Claude, GPT or Gemini instances. It features RTK+Caveman stacked compression to cut token usage by 15–95%, alongside smart auto-fallback, MCP/A2A support, and multimodal APIs.
en.content: The repo ships with a deployable gateway core, a web admin dashboard, PWA and desktop apps, plus routing strategy configs, free-tier documentation, and provider integration templates.
en.stack: Built entirely in TypeScript on a Node.js backend for high-concurrency gateway operations, with a React-based web dashboard and PWA, plus desktop packaging.
en.hot: It gained 3,605 stars this week, reaching 18.4k total and hitting #16 on GitHub Trending, as developers rush to cut AI costs—aggregating 90+ free providers and slashing token usage by up to 95% directly addresses the biggest barrier to shipping AI apps.
uses: Indie devs & small teams —— Access Claude/GPT/Gemini at zero cost by pooling 90+ free tiers instead of paid APIs.
Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

zh.tag: AI 驱动的全球实时态势感知仪表盘
zh.what: World Monitor 是一个实时全球情报仪表盘，利用 AI 聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件和基础设施状态，提供统一的态势感知界面。它支持多个垂直领域（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等）的定制化视图。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码、CLI 工具和 npm 包，提供多种主题变体（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等），以及 MCP 服务器集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 npm 包管理，支持 Web 应用和 CLI 两种形态，集成了 MCP 服务器。
zh.hot: 凭借 AI 驱动的实时全球情报聚合和多个垂直领域定制视图，上线后迅速获得 6.5 万+ Star，日增近 1300，登顶 GitHub 日榜。
uses: 地缘政治分析师 —— 实时监控全球事件与基础设施状态
金融投资者 —— 跟踪大宗商品、能源等市场动态
科技从业者 —— 获取科技领域新闻与趋势
普通用户 —— 通过 Happy 变体关注积极新闻

en.tag: AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard for situational awareness
en.what: World Monitor is a real-time global intelligence dashboard that uses AI to aggregate news, monitor geopolitical events, and track infrastructure status in a unified situational awareness interface. It offers customized views for various verticals like tech, finance, commodities, and energy.

uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates

Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

en.tag: The first Office suite built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

zh.tag: 让Claude具备看视频能力的Agent插件，一键解析任意视频

en.tag: Agent plugin that gives Claude eyes: downloads, frames & transcribes any video
en.what: It gives Claude and other AI agents the ability to "watch" videos via a simple /watch command. The tool downloads the video, extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped transcripts (free captions first, Whisper as fallback), and feeds everything to the AI. This lets Claude actually see what's on screen and hear the audio instead of guessing from titles or partial transcripts.
en.content: The repo contains the Python core of the /watch plugin, plus installation configs and docs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and over 50 Agent Skills hosts. It ships as a CLI plugin with zero-config setup, automatically installing yt-dlp and ffmpeg on first run.
en.stack: Built in Python, it relies on yt-dlp for video fetching, ffmpeg for frame extraction and audio demuxing, and falls back to the OpenAI Whisper API when free captions are unavailable. It integrates with agent environments via plugin protocols.
en.hot: With 8,992 stars and 1,876 added this week alone, it hit #15 on GitHub's Python Trending list. It solves the critical gap of AI agents being unable to perceive video, winning developers over with zero-config setup, multi-platform support, and a true "see-and-hear" experience.

Developers & QA engineers: diagnose bugs from screen recordings by having the AI pinpoint issue frames
Learners & researchers: turn long videos or course playlists into searchable, timestamped notes
Product managers & analysts: strip hype from launch videos and extract substantive feature updates

zh.tag: 一个代理指挥多代理协作的智能体发行版
zh.what: firstmate 是一个智能体发行版，让你通过一个主代理（first mate）来指挥多个子代理并行完成任务。它自动为每个子代理分配独立的 git 工作区，监督执行，并交付 PR 或报告。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AGENTS.md、内置技能和辅助脚本，构成一个便携式智能体发行版。支持 tmux、herdr/zellij、cmux 或 Orca 后端，并提供 ship/scout 两种任务模式。

团队希望在不安装复杂工具的情况下，利用现有编码智能体实现自动化协作。
对智能体编排和“代理发行版”理念感兴趣的研究者或爱好者。

en.tag: An agent distro to run a crew of agents from one first mate
en.what: firstmate is an agent distro that lets you command a crew of agents through a single first mate. It spawns autonomous agents in visible sessions, gives each a clean git worktree, supervises them, and delivers PRs or reports.

zh.tag: 开源低延迟语音代理框架，支持全本地模块化VAD-STT-LLM-TTS流水线

en.tag: Low-latency modular voice-agent pipeline with fully local VAD-STT-LLM-TTS stack

en.hot: It hits the sweet spot for privacy and control with a fully swappable, fully local stack amid the voice-agent boom; it gained 1,334 stars this month for a total of 6,149, hitting #10 on the Python monthly trending list, and already powers thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production.
uses: Developers and startups building local voice assistants who need to keep data on-premise
Hardware/robotics vendors looking to add LLM-powered voice interfaces via an OpenAI Realtime-compatible protocol
Researchers and engineers experimenting with low-latency dialog systems who want to swap VAD, STT, or TTS components

uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

zh.tag: 流式3D重建的几何上下文Transformer基础模型
zh.what: LingBot-Map 是一个前馈式 3D 基础模型，能够从流式数据中实时重建三维场景。它通过几何上下文 Transformer 架构，在单一流式框架内统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索编码与长程漂移校正。
zh.content: 仓库提供交互式演示脚本 demo.py、离线批量渲染管线，以及 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 评估基准；预训练模型权重已同步发布在 HuggingFace 与 ModelScope。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch 构建，核心采用 Transformer 架构，支持 SDPA 与 FlashInfer 双后端以加速超长序列的流式推理。
zh.hot: 该模型可在 518×378 分辨率下以约 20 FPS 稳定处理超 10,000 帧的长序列，月增 4,765 Star，总星数突破 12,000，跻身 GitHub Python 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 自动驾驶与机器人感知 —— 需要实时从连续视频流构建大规模 3D 场景地图。
AR/VR 内容生成 —— 为沉浸式应用提供高效的长序列几何重建与离线渲染能力。
计算机视觉研究者 —— 探索流式 3D 基础模型、几何 Transformer 与长程漂移校正的前沿方向。

en.tag: Geometric Context Transformer for real-time streaming 3D reconstruction
en.what: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data in real time. It unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction within a single streaming framework via its Geometric Context Transformer architecture.
en.content: The repo ships an interactive demo script (`demo.py`), an offline rendering pipeline, and evaluation benchmarks for KITTI and Oxford Spires, with pretrained weights hosted on both HuggingFace and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch with a Transformer core, supporting both SDPA and FlashInfer backends to accelerate inference over extremely long sequences.
en.hot: Delivering stable ~20 FPS inference at 518×378 across sequences exceeding 10,000 frames, the project gained 4,765 stars this month, surpassing 12,000 total and hitting #18 on GitHub’s monthly Python Trending list.
uses: Autonomous driving & robotics teams — for real-time large-scale 3D mapping from continuous video streams.
AR/VR content creators — seeking efficient long-sequence geometric reconstruction and offline rendering for immersive experiences.
Computer-vision researchers — exploring streaming 3D foundation models, geometric Transformers, and long-range drift correction.

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: LLM 结构化输出生成引擎

zh.hot: 本周新增 813 星，总星数超 1.5 万。LLM 应用开发中结构化输出是刚需，Outlines 提供优雅的解决方案，被 NVIDIA、Cohere、HuggingFace 等采用。
uses: 开发者构建需要可靠 JSON 输出的 LLM 应用（如 API 调用、数据提取）
需要跨模型切换且保持输出格式一致的项目

en.tag: Structured output generation engine for LLMs
en.what: Outlines is a library that guarantees LLM outputs conform to predefined structures (JSON, XML, Pydantic models, etc.). It constrains outputs during generation, avoiding fragile post-hoc parsing. Supports multiple model backends (OpenAI, vLLM, Ollama, etc.) with a unified API.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, model integrations (OpenAI, vLLM, Transformers, etc.), structured output types (JSON, Regex, Pydantic, etc.), examples, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depends on Pydantic, regex, and model backend SDKs (e.g., openai, vllm).
en.hot: Gained 813 stars this week, total over 15k. Structured output is a must-have in LLM app development; Outlines provides an elegant solution, adopted by NVIDIA, Cohere, HuggingFace, etc.

Projects needing consistent output formats across different models
Teams wanting to avoid manual parsing and validation of LLM outputs

zh.tag: MCP 官方 TypeScript SDK，构建服务器与客户端
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方 TypeScript SDK，用于构建 MCP 服务器和客户端。它提供标准化的方式让应用程序为 LLM 提供上下文，分离上下文提供与 LLM 交互的职责。
zh.content: 仓库包含服务器库（工具/资源/提示、Streamable HTTP、stdio、认证辅助）、客户端库（传输、高级辅助、OAuth 辅助）、可选中间件包（Express、Fastify、Hono、Node.js HTTP）以及可运行示例。

开发者构建 MCP 客户端，连接并调用 MCP 服务器
框架集成者使用中间件包将 MCP 集成到 Express、Fastify 等框架
学习 MCP 规范与实现，参考示例代码快速上手

en.tag: Official TypeScript SDK for MCP servers and clients
en.what: This is the official TypeScript SDK for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), used to build MCP servers and clients. It provides a standardized way for applications to supply context to LLMs, separating the concerns of context provision from actual LLM interaction.
en.content: The repository includes server libraries (tools/resources/prompts, Streamable HTTP, stdio, auth helpers), client libraries (transports, high-level helpers, OAuth helpers), optional middleware packages (Express, Fastify, Hono, Node.js HTTP), and runnable examples.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supporting Node.js, Bun, and Deno runtimes. Uses Standard Schema for tool and prompt schemas, published as split packages via npm.
en.hot: As the official MCP SDK, the v2 release aligns with the 2026-07-28 spec, becoming key infrastructure for AI tooling, with 13k stars and sustained popularity.
uses: Developers building MCP servers to provide tools, resources, and prompts to AI assistants
Developers building MCP clients to connect and invoke MCP servers
Framework integrators using middleware packages to integrate MCP into Express, Fastify, etc.

en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code

Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows
