zh.tag: Android 上的强大代码编辑器
zh.what: Acode 是一款专为 Android 设备设计的强大文本/代码编辑器，支持多种编程语言，内置 JavaScript 控制台，并允许在浏览器中即时预览网页。它提供丰富的社区插件，可扩展编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代码（src/）、公共文档与编译文件（www/）以及构建工具（utils/）。支持多语言，可通过 CLI 工具轻松管理语言文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Web 技术构建，可能使用 Cordova 或类似框架打包为 Android 应用。依赖 pnpm 进行包管理。
zh.hot: 本月新增 562 星，总星数 6488，在 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）排名第 20。作为 Android 上少有的开源代码编辑器，受到开发者青睐。
uses: 移动开发者：在手机上快速编辑代码或查看项目文件
网页开发者：编写 HTML/CSS/JS 并即时预览效果
编程学习者：利用内置控制台练习 JavaScript
插件开发者：通过社区插件扩展编辑器功能

en.tag: Powerful code editor for Android
en.what: Acode is a powerful text/code editor for Android, supporting multiple programming languages, with a built-in JavaScript console and instant preview of websites in a browser. It offers a large collection of community plugins to enhance coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains core code (src/), public docs and compiled files (www/), and build tools (utils/). It supports multiple languages, with CLI tools for easy language file management.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built with web technologies, likely packaged as an Android app using Cordova or similar. Uses pnpm for package management.
en.hot: Gained 562 stars this month, total 6488, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending monthly (JavaScript). As a rare open-source code editor on Android, it's favored by developers.
uses: Mobile developers: quickly edit code or view project files on the go
Web developers: write HTML/CSS/JS and preview instantly
Programming learners: practice JavaScript with built-in console
Plugin developers: extend editor functionality via community plugins

zh.tag: 自托管有声书与播客服务器
zh.what: Audiobookshelf 是一个自托管的有声书和播客服务器，支持流式播放所有音频格式，自动下载播客节目，并提供多用户权限管理。它还能同步每个用户的播放进度，并自动检测媒体库更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码、Web 前端（Vue，正在迁移至 React）、Android 和 iOS 应用（测试版），以及文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，前端基于 Vue（正在迁移至 React），后端使用 Node.js，支持多种音频格式和元数据抓取。
zh.hot: 该项目提供了功能丰富且完全开源的自托管解决方案，替代商业有声书服务，近期获得 489 颗星，月榜排名第 21 位，吸引了大量注重隐私和自主控制的用户。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控自己的有声书和播客媒体库，避免依赖商业云服务。
家庭或小团队：需要多用户支持和个性化权限管理，共享媒体库。
移动用户：通过 Android/iOS 应用或 PWA 在手机上随时随地收听，并同步进度。
播客听众：自动下载和管理播客订阅，支持离线收听。

en.tag: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server
en.what: Audiobookshelf is a self-hosted audiobook and podcast server that streams all audio formats on the fly, auto-downloads podcast episodes, and supports multi-user with custom permissions. It syncs progress per user across devices and auto-detects library updates.
en.content: The repository contains the full server-side code, a web frontend (Vue, being rewritten in React), Android and iOS apps (beta), plus documentation and installation guides.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with a Vue frontend (migrating to React) and a Node.js backend, supporting various audio formats and metadata fetching.
en.hot: It offers a feature-rich, fully open-source self-hosted alternative to commercial audiobook services, gaining 489 stars this month and ranking #21 on the monthly trending list, appealing to privacy-conscious and self-hosting enthusiasts.
uses: Self-hosters: Want full control over their audiobook and podcast library, avoiding commercial cloud services.
Families or small teams: Need multi-user support with custom permissions to share a media library.
Mobile users: Listen on the go via Android/iOS apps or PWA with progress syncing.
Podcast listeners: Auto-download and manage podcast subscriptions for offline listening.

zh.tag: 让 AI 输出更像人写的：审计并改写掉 AI 腔
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的写作技能包，供 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Hermes 等 AI 代理使用。它能审计文本并标记出 AI 写作痕迹（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语），然后自动重写或原地编辑，让内容更自然、更像真人写的。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个技能定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript）、演示 GIF 和文档。提供三种模式：重写（默认，带二次校验）、仅检测（只标记不修改）、原地编辑（最小改动并输出报告），还支持语气配置（casual/professional/technical/warm/blunt）。
zh.stack: 主语言是 JavaScript，作为 agentskills.io 兼容的技能包使用，依赖代理自身的工具调用能力（如 Edit 工具）。无需额外安装，直接放入代理的技能目录即可。
zh.hot: 本月新增 655 星，总星数近 3000，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 22 名。因为 AI 写作痕迹成了普遍痛点，这个工具直接解决“AI 味太重”的问题，且适配多种主流代理，实用性强。
uses: 内容创作者：用 AI 起草后快速去除 AI 腔，提升文章自然度
开发者：集成到 Claude Code 等代理中，自动审计代码注释或文档
团队协作：在编辑流程中检测 AI 生成内容，保证品牌语气一致
教育/写作教练：用 Detect 模式展示 AI 写作特征，辅助教学

en.tag: Audit & rewrite content to remove AI writing patterns for any agent
en.what: A portable writing skill for AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes. It audits text, flags AI writing patterns (e.g., 'Certainly!', vague hype), then rewrites or edits in place to make content sound more human.
en.content: Includes a skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript detector engine, demo GIF, and docs. Three modes: Rewrite (default, with second pass), Detect (flag only), Edit (minimal in-place changes with report), plus voice profiles (casual/professional/technical/warm/blunt).
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, packaged as an agentskills.io-compatible skill. Relies on the agent's native tools (e.g., Edit), no extra dependencies—just drop into the agent's skills folder.
en.hot: Gained 655 stars this month (total ~2962), ranking #22 on JavaScript trending. It addresses the widespread pain of 'AI-sounding' text and works across major agents, making it highly practical.
uses: Content creators: quickly de-AI-ify AI drafts for more natural articles
Developers: integrate into Claude Code etc. to audit comments/docs automatically
Teams: detect AI-generated content in editing pipelines to keep brand voice consistent
Educators/writing coaches: use Detect mode to illustrate AI writing tells

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务端
zh.what: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器，旨在提供极致的性能和可定制性。它支持最新的 Java 和 Bedrock 版本，同时保持原版游戏机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器核心实现，包括世界加载、区块生成、玩家管理、实体 AI、红石、插件系统等模块，目前处于积极开发中。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust，利用多线程和零成本抽象实现高性能；依赖 tokio 异步运行时和自定义网络协议实现。
zh.hot: Rust 语言的高性能和安全性吸引了大量 Minecraft 社区关注，今日新增 108 星，总星数 8415，位列 GitHub 日榜第 18 名。
uses: Minecraft 服务器管理员 —— 希望部署高性能、低资源占用的服务端
Rust 开发者 —— 学习 Rust 在游戏服务器领域的实践
Minecraft 模组/插件开发者 —— 基于其插件系统进行扩展

en.tag: A fast, efficient Minecraft server built entirely in Rust
en.what: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, designed for maximum performance and customizability. It supports the latest Java and Bedrock editions while adhering to vanilla game mechanics.
en.content: The repository contains a full server core implementation, including world loading, chunk generation, player management, entity AI, redstone, plugin system, etc., currently under heavy development.
en.stack: Tech stack is Rust, leveraging multi-threading and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; relies on tokio async runtime and custom network protocol implementation.
en.hot: The high performance and safety of Rust attract massive attention from the Minecraft community, with 108 stars added today and 8415 total, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Minecraft server admins — seeking high-performance, low-resource server software
Rust developers — learning Rust in game server development
Minecraft mod/plugin developers — extending functionality via its plugin system

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: 轻量级 Bitwarden 自托管服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 的第三方轻量级服务器实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方客户端。它允许用户在低资源环境下自托管密码管理器，替代官方资源密集型的服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Web Vault、API 和后台管理功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言，使用 Rocket 框架，依赖 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 数据库，支持 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 64,210 星标，是自托管密码管理领域的标杆项目。其轻量、安全且完全兼容官方客户端的特性，吸引了大量追求隐私和资源优化的用户。
uses: 个人用户 —— 在低配 VPS 或 NAS 上自托管密码管理器
小型团队 —— 无需付费订阅即可使用 Bitwarden 功能
隐私爱好者 —— 完全掌控密码数据，避免云服务依赖

en.tag: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server
en.what: Vaultwarden is an alternative lightweight server implementation of Bitwarden, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It enables self-hosted password management on low-resource environments, replacing the official resource-heavy service.
en.content: The repository contains the complete server-side code, supports deployment via Docker, Podman, and others, and provides Web Vault, API, and admin features.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Rocket framework, supports SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, and offers Docker containerization.
en.hot: With 64,210 stars, it's a benchmark in self-hosted password management. Its lightweight, secure, and fully compatible nature attracts users seeking privacy and resource efficiency.
uses: Individual users — self-host password manager on low-end VPS or NAS
Small teams — use Bitwarden features without paid subscription
Privacy enthusiasts — full control over password data, avoiding cloud dependency

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的可扩展 SQL 查询引擎
zh.what: Apache DataFusion 是一个用 Rust 实现的内存查询引擎，支持 SQL 和 DataFrame API，用于构建分析型数据系统。它提供查询优化、执行和分布式处理能力，可嵌入到其他应用中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心查询引擎（解析、逻辑/物理计划、优化器、执行器）、DataFrame API、SQL 接口，以及用于扩展的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，依赖 Arrow 列式内存格式，支持 Parquet、CSV、JSON 等数据源，并可通过 DataFusion 的扩展点集成自定义函数和存储后端。
zh.hot: 作为 Apache 顶级项目，DataFusion 凭借高性能和可嵌入性成为 Rust 数据生态的核心组件，本月新增 162 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 13，持续吸引数据基础设施开发者关注。
uses: 数据平台开发者：构建查询引擎或分布式 SQL 层
嵌入式分析应用：在 Rust 应用中集成 SQL 查询能力
数据科学家：利用 DataFrame API 进行交互式分析
数据库内核研究者：学习查询优化与执行实现

en.tag: Extensible SQL query engine built in Rust
en.what: Apache DataFusion is an in-memory query engine implemented in Rust, supporting SQL and DataFrame APIs for building analytical data systems. It provides query optimization, execution, and distributed processing capabilities, and can be embedded into other applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core query engine (parsing, logical/physical planning, optimizer, execution), DataFrame API, SQL interface, along with examples and documentation for extension.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on Arrow columnar memory format, supports data sources like Parquet, CSV, JSON, and can integrate custom functions and storage backends via DataFusion's extension points.
en.hot: As an Apache top-level project, DataFusion's high performance and embeddability make it a core component of the Rust data ecosystem. With 162 new stars this month and ranking 13th on the Rust trending list, it continues to attract data infrastructure developers.
uses: Data platform developers: building query engines or distributed SQL layers
Embedded analytics apps: integrating SQL query capabilities into Rust applications
Data scientists: using DataFrame API for interactive analysis
Database kernel researchers: learning query optimization and execution implementations

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢思维协作平台
zh.what: Buzz 是一个自托管的协作空间，让人类和 AI 代理在同一个房间里工作。它基于 Nostr 中继，所有消息、工作流步骤和审查批准都是签名事件，形成统一的审计轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心服务器（Rust 实现）、客户端界面、文档（如 VISION.md、ARCHITECTURE.md）以及截图。它提供频道、画布、工作流、语音会议等功能，代理拥有与人类相同的操作权限。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Nostr 协议。项目包含大量 Rust crates，并可能涉及前端技术（如 React 等）用于客户端界面。
zh.hot: 本月新增 star 超过 26k，总 star 达 26.7k，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜。其独特定位——让代理真正参与开发流程而非仅聊天——引发了广泛关注。
uses: 开发团队：希望让 AI 代理协助代码审查、补丁提交和问题分类，同时保留完整审计日志。
开源项目维护者：需要管理社区协作，并让代理处理重复性任务。
AI 研究者：探索代理与人类在共享工作空间中的协作模式。
自托管爱好者：偏好私有部署，掌控数据与中继。

en.tag: A hive-mind workspace where humans and agents build together on a Nostr relay
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Built on a Nostr relay, every message, workflow step, and review approval is a signed event in one log, providing a unified audit trail.
en.content: The repository includes the core server (Rust), client UI, documentation (VISION.md, ARCHITECTURE.md), and screenshots. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and agents have the same surface area as humans.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging the Nostr protocol. The project includes numerous Rust crates and likely frontend technologies (e.g., React) for the client.
en.hot: With over 26k stars added this month, reaching 26.7k total, it hit the GitHub Trending monthly list. Its unique positioning—letting agents actually participate in development workflows rather than just chat—has sparked significant interest.
uses: Development teams: want AI agents to assist with code review, patch submission, and issue triage, with full audit trails.
Open-source maintainers: need to manage community collaboration and delegate repetitive tasks to agents.
AI researchers: exploring collaboration patterns between agents and humans in shared workspaces.
Self-hosting enthusiasts: prefer private deployment and control over data and relay.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的极速 Python 包与项目管理器
zh.what: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Python 包和项目管理工具，旨在替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv 等多个工具。它提供比 pip 快 10-100 倍的性能，并支持项目依赖管理、脚本运行、Python 版本管理等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 uv 的 Rust 源码、文档、基准测试和安装脚本。主要组件包括命令行接口、依赖解析器、全局缓存和锁文件机制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。可通过 curl 或 pip 安装，无需 Rust 或 Python 环境。
zh.hot: uv 凭借其惊人的速度和全面的功能迅速走红，已获得 88k+ star。本周新增 354 star，位列 Rust 周榜第 9，反映出开发者对高性能 Python 工具链的强烈需求。
uses: Python 开发者：替代 pip 和 poetry，加速依赖安装和项目管理
CI/CD 环境：利用其速度和缓存机制，减少构建时间
多版本 Python 管理：通过 uv 安装和管理不同 Python 版本
脚本运行：直接运行带内联依赖声明的 Python 脚本

en.tag: An extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust
en.what: uv is a Python package and project manager written in Rust, designed to replace pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, and more. It is 10-100x faster than pip and offers comprehensive project management, script execution, and Python version management.
en.content: The repository contains uv's Rust source code, documentation, benchmarks, and installation scripts. Key components include a CLI, dependency resolver, global cache, and lockfile mechanism.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Installable via curl or pip without requiring Rust or Python.
en.hot: uv has gained massive popularity due to its incredible speed and comprehensive features, amassing 88k+ stars. With 354 new stars this week, ranking #9 on the Rust weekly trending list, it reflects developers' strong demand for high-performance Python tooling.
uses: Python developers: replace pip and poetry for faster dependency installation and project management
CI/CD environments: leverage speed and caching to reduce build times
Multi-version Python management: install and manage Python versions via uv
Script running: run Python scripts with inline dependency metadata

zh.tag: Rust 全栈跨平台 UI 框架，一套代码覆盖 Web、桌面与移动端
zh.what: Dioxus 是一个基于 Rust 的全栈应用框架，开发者只需维护一套代码库即可构建 Web、桌面和移动应用。它提供了类似 React 的组件化开发体验，并内置基于 Signals 的状态管理、热重载与零配置启动能力。通过 Server Functions 还能直接在同一代码库中编写后端逻辑，实现真正的全栈开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 UI 库、跨平台渲染器（Web/桌面/移动端）、CLI 打包工具以及 Server Functions 全栈运行时。此外还提供了丰富的官方示例、文档站点和多语言 README，方便开发者快速上手。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 生态，核心使用自研的 Virtual DOM 与 Signals 响应式系统，编译目标涵盖 WebAssembly、桌面端（基于 Winit/Tao）及移动端原生渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.8K Star 的热度和本周 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名的成绩，Dioxus 吸引了大量希望用 Rust 替代 JavaScript 技术栈的开发者。其“一套代码、多端运行”的全栈能力，加上对热重载和零配置体验的重视，精准击中了 Rust 社区对高性能跨平台 UI 方案的强烈需求。
uses: Rust 开发者 —— 希望用单一代码库同时覆盖前端页面与桌面/移动原生应用的项目。
全栈工程师 —— 想在前端组件中直接调用 Server Functions，减少前后端语言切换成本的团队。
跨平台应用团队 —— 需要高性能、内存安全且拒绝 Electron 厚重方案的产品组。

en.tag: Rust fullstack cross-platform UI framework for web, desktop, and mobile
en.what: Dioxus is a Rust-based fullstack framework that lets developers build for the web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase. It offers a React-like component model with zero-config setup, integrated hot-reloading, and signals-based state management. Server Functions enable backend logic to live alongside the UI, streamlining fullstack development in Rust.
en.content: The repo contains the core UI library, cross-platform renderers for web, desktop, and mobile, a CLI bundler, and a fullstack runtime for Server Functions. It also ships with extensive examples, documentation, and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built entirely on Rust, featuring a custom Virtual DOM and signals-based reactivity, compiling to WebAssembly, desktop (via Winit/Tao), and mobile native targets.
en.hot: With 36.8K stars and ranking 18th on this week's GitHub Rust Trending, Dioxus is drawing developers eager to replace JavaScript stacks with Rust. Its promise of a single codebase spanning web, desktop, and mobile—backed by hot-reload and zero-config DX—directly addresses the Rust community's demand for high-performance cross-platform UI solutions.
uses: Rust developers —— teams wanting a single codebase for web, desktop, and mobile apps without sacrificing performance.
Fullstack engineers —— those looking to colocate Server Functions with UI components to cut language-switching overhead.
Cross-platform product teams —— groups that need memory-safe, high-performance alternatives to heavy Electron-style solutions.

zh.tag: 为并行 AI 代理工作流打造的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用于 Git worktree 管理的命令行工具，专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计。它帮助开发者高效管理多个工作树，使 AI 代理能够并行处理不同任务，同时保持代码库的整洁和同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具、文档站点（docs/）以及用于测试和 CI 的配置。核心功能围绕 worktree 的创建、切换、清理和同步，提供直观的命令行接口。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Git 命令行，支持 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可证。项目通过 GitHub Actions 进行 CI，并使用 codecov 跟踪代码覆盖率。

uses: AI 代理开发者：需要并行运行多个 AI 代理进行代码生成或审查，同时保持仓库整洁。
团队协作：多个开发者或代理同时处理不同功能，需要隔离的工作树。
CI/CD 工程师：在自动化流程中需要快速创建和销毁临时工作树。
Git 高级用户：希望更高效地管理多个工作树，减少分支切换开销。

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows. It helps developers efficiently manage multiple worktrees, enabling AI agents to work on different tasks in parallel while keeping the repository clean and synchronized.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, documentation site (docs/), and configuration for testing and CI. Core features revolve around creating, switching, cleaning, and syncing worktrees, with an intuitive command-line interface.
en.stack: Written in Rust, relies on Git CLI, dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0. CI is handled via GitHub Actions, with code coverage tracked by Codecov.
en.hot: Since its release earlier this year, Worktrunk has quickly become the most popular Git worktree manager, gaining 600 stars this month to reach 6,374 total, ranking #9 on the Rust monthly trending list. Its precise focus on parallel AI agent development addresses the pain point of branch management in multi-agent collaboration.
uses: AI agent developers: need to run multiple AI agents in parallel for code generation or review while keeping the repo clean.
Team collaboration: multiple developers or agents working on different features simultaneously need isolated worktrees.
CI/CD engineers: need to quickly create and destroy temporary worktrees in automated pipelines.
Advanced Git users: want to manage multiple worktrees more efficiently, reducing branch switching overhead.

zh.tag: 非官方 Jellyfin 桌面客户端，基于 CEF 与 mpv
zh.what: 这是一个非官方的 Jellyfin 桌面客户端，使用 CEF 和 mpv 构建，提供跨平台支持（Linux、macOS、Windows）。它旨在为用户提供更流畅、更原生的桌面体验，弥补官方客户端的不足。

媒体爱好者：需要跨平台（Linux/macOS/Windows）的媒体播放客户端。
开发者：对 Rust + CEF + mpv 集成感兴趣的桌面应用开发者。

en.tag: Unofficial Jellyfin desktop client built on CEF and mpv
en.what: An unofficial Jellyfin desktop client built with CEF and mpv, offering cross-platform support (Linux, macOS, Windows). It aims to provide a smoother, more native desktop experience, filling gaps in the official client.

en.hot: Gained 704 stars this month, reaching 1770 total, ranking #16 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly, reflecting strong demand for a high-quality desktop client among Jellyfin users.

Media enthusiasts: needing a cross-platform (Linux/macOS/Windows) media player client.
Developers: interested in Rust + CEF + mpv integration for desktop apps.

zh.tag: 离线、隐私优先的 Rust 英语语法检查器
zh.what: Harper 是一个快速、开源的英语语法检查器，注重隐私保护，所有处理均在本地完成。它旨在提供比 Grammarly 更轻量、比 LanguageTool 更高效的替代方案，支持多种编辑器集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、命令行工具、语言服务器（harper-ls）、WebAssembly 版本以及 Obsidian 插件等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 WebAssembly 编译，提供 npm 包（harper.js）和 Obsidian 插件。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3369 星，总星数达 14366，因其隐私友好、性能卓越（毫秒级检查、内存占用仅为 LanguageTool 的 1/50）而受到关注。
uses: 注重隐私的写作者，希望避免云端语法检查工具的数据收集。
需要快速、轻量级语法检查的开发者，可集成到编辑器或 CI 流程。
Obsidian 用户，希望在不离开笔记应用的情况下获得本地语法检查。
对 Rust 或 WebAssembly 感兴趣，想学习或贡献开源项目的开发者。

en.tag: Offline, privacy-first English grammar checker powered by Rust
en.what: Harper is a fast, open-source English grammar checker that prioritizes privacy by processing everything locally. It aims to be a lighter, more efficient alternative to Grammarly and LanguageTool, with integrations for various editors.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, CLI tools, a language server (harper-ls), a WebAssembly build, and an Obsidian plugin.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, compiles to WebAssembly, offers an npm package (harper.js) and an Obsidian plugin.

uses: Privacy-conscious writers who want to avoid cloud-based grammar checkers' data collection.
Developers needing a fast, lightweight grammar checker for editor or CI integration.
Obsidian users who want local grammar checking without leaving their notes app.
Developers interested in Rust or WebAssembly, looking to learn or contribute to an open-source project.

zh.tag: 面向智能体的实时事件流处理平台
zh.what: RisingWave 是一个专为智能体 AI 设计的事件流处理平台，能够持续从数据库、事件流和 Webhook 中摄取数据，进行增量处理，并以低延迟提供最新结果。它用一个系统替代了传统的 Debezium + Kafka + Flink + 数据库的组合。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 实现的流处理引擎，支持 SQL 接口、多种数据源（Webhook、CDC、Kafka 等）、增量计算和低延迟服务。还提供快速启动脚本、文档、演示和基准测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Kafka、Pulsar、Kinesis 等消息系统，以及 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等数据库的 CDC 连接器。
zh.hot: 随着智能体 AI 对实时数据需求的增长，RisingWave 简化了事件流处理架构，本月新增 104 星，在 Rust 月榜排名第 18，受到开发者关注。
uses: 智能体 AI 开发者：需要实时数据输入和低延迟响应的应用
数据工程师：希望简化流处理管道，减少系统组件
实时分析场景：需要持续更新结果和快速查询的业务

en.tag: Real-time event streaming platform for agentic AI
en.what: RisingWave is an event streaming platform for agentic AI that continuously ingests data from databases, event streams, and webhooks, processes it incrementally, and serves fresh results at low latency, replacing the traditional stack of Debezium + Kafka + Flink + serving DB with a single system.
en.content: The repository contains a full Rust-implemented stream processing engine with SQL interface, support for various sources (webhooks, CDC, Kafka, etc.), incremental computation, and low-latency serving. It also includes quick start scripts, docs, demos, and benchmarks.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with dependencies on message brokers like Kafka, Pulsar, Kinesis, and CDC connectors for databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL.
en.hot: With the growing demand for real-time data in agentic AI, RisingWave simplifies event streaming architecture, gaining 104 stars this month and ranking #18 on the Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Agentic AI developers: apps needing real-time data input and low-latency responses
Data engineers: looking to simplify stream processing pipelines and reduce components
Real-time analytics: businesses needing continuously updated results and fast queries

zh.tag: Rust 异步运行时，构建可靠、高性能异步应用
zh.what: Tokio 是一个事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 的异步运行时，用于编写可靠、异步、精简的 Rust 应用。它提供多线程工作窃取调度器、基于操作系统事件队列的 reactor，以及异步 TCP/UDP 套接字等核心组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时核心库、调度器、reactor、网络模块、定时器等，以及丰富的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖操作系统事件队列（epoll、kqueue、IOCP 等），提供异步 I/O 和并发原语。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中最流行的异步运行时，Tokio 凭借零成本抽象和高性能，成为构建网络服务的基石，持续获得大量关注。
uses: Rust 开发者构建高性能网络服务（如 Web 服务器、代理、数据库客户端）
需要异步 I/O 和并发处理的应用，如聊天系统、实时数据处理
学习 Rust 异步编程和运行时原理的开发者

en.tag: Rust async runtime for building reliable, high-performance async apps
en.what: Tokio is an event-driven, non-blocking I/O runtime for writing reliable, asynchronous, and slim applications in Rust. It provides a multithreaded work-stealing scheduler, a reactor backed by OS event queues, and async TCP/UDP sockets.
en.content: The repo contains the runtime core library, scheduler, reactor, networking modules, timers, and extensive examples and documentation.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leverages OS event queues (epoll, kqueue, IOCP), provides async I/O and concurrency primitives.
en.hot: As the most popular async runtime in the Rust ecosystem, Tokio's zero-cost abstractions and high performance make it a cornerstone for building network services, consistently attracting significant attention.
uses: Rust developers building high-performance network services (web servers, proxies, database clients)
Applications needing async I/O and concurrency, like chat systems, real-time data processing
Developers learning Rust async programming and runtime internals

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates line-level structured review comments.
en.content: The repo contains Go CLI source code, built-in fine-tuned rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), support for OpenAI & Anthropic compatible APIs, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, depends on Git and LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), supports agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: Open-sourced from Alibaba's battle-tested internal tool, its hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, and built-in rulesets have attracted many developers, gaining 162 stars today and 10964 total.
uses: Development teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review on commits, improving code quality
Individual developers — run locally for quick detection of potential defects and security vulnerabilities
Open source maintainers — manage PR reviews with reduced manual effort

zh.tag: GitHub 官方命令行工具，将 PR、Issue 等带到终端
zh.what: gh 是 GitHub 官方推出的命令行工具，让你在终端中直接管理仓库、PR、Issue、Actions 等。它与 git 无缝协作，支持 GitHub.com、GitHub Enterprise Cloud 和 Server。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git 和 GitHub API。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方 CLI，拥有 45k+ Star，是开发者日常高频使用的工具。今日新增 16 Star，持续活跃。

DevOps 工程师 —— 集成到 CI/CD 脚本中自动化 GitHub 操作
编码代理 —— 通过 Agent skill 让 AI 代理直接调用 gh 命令

en.tag: GitHub's official CLI, bringing PRs, issues, and more to your terminal
en.what: gh is GitHub's official command-line tool that lets you manage repositories, pull requests, issues, Actions, and more directly from your terminal. It works seamlessly with git and supports GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud, and Server.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and an Agent skill for coding agents. It supports multiple installation methods on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网与远程访问基础设施
zh.what: Tailscale 基于 WireGuard 协议构建安全的虚拟专用网络，让用户无需公网 IP 或端口转发即可将设备组成私有网络。它集成了身份验证和两因素认证（2FA），简化了团队和设备之间的安全远程访问与内网穿透。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 tailscaled 守护进程与 tailscale 命令行工具的核心源码，覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS 及 BSD 系统的网络栈与控制逻辑。移动端 App 的底层网络库亦来源于此，但各平台 GUI 包装代码位于其他独立仓库。
zh.stack: 项目以 Go 语言为主开发，要求使用最新版 Go 1.26 编译，并基于 WireGuard 协议实现加密通信。构建脚本 `build_dist.sh` 用于将版本信息嵌入二进制，支持多种 Linux 发行版及跨平台打包。
zh.hot: 凭借“零配置”即可在任意设备间建立加密组网的能力，Tailscale 已成为远程办公和云原生时代的核心网络工具，GitHub 累计获得 34k+ Stars，本周再以 583 新增 Star 登上 Go 语言 Trending 榜第 2 名。
uses: 远程办公团队 —— 无需公网 IP 即可安全访问公司内网与私有云资源
开发运维人员 —— 快速搭建跨云、跨地域的容器与服务器调试网络
个人技术爱好者 —— 将家庭 NAS、树莓派等设备组成加密私有网络
安全合规企业 —— 基于 SSO/2FA 的零信任网络替代传统 VPN 方案

en.tag: Zero-config WireGuard VPN for secure remote access and private networking
en.what: Tailscale builds secure virtual private networks on top of WireGuard, allowing devices to form a private mesh network without public IPs or port forwarding. It integrates identity-based authentication and two-factor authentication (2FA) to simplify secure remote access and intranet penetration for teams and devices.
en.content: The repository primarily contains the core source code for the `tailscaled` daemon and the `tailscale` CLI tool, covering the networking stack and control logic for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD systems. It also serves as the underlying network library for mobile apps, while platform-specific GUI wrappers reside in separate repositories.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go and requiring the latest Go 1.26 release, it implements encrypted communication over the WireGuard protocol. The `build_dist.sh` script embeds version metadata into binaries, supporting packaging for multiple Linux distributions and cross-platform deployments.
en.hot: Its "zero-config" approach to encrypted mesh networking across any device has made it an essential tool for remote work and cloud-native environments. With over 34k total stars and 583 new stars this week, it ranks #2 on GitHub's Go Trending chart, reflecting strong community traction.
uses: Remote teams — Securely access corporate intranets and private cloud resources without public IPs
DevOps engineers — Quickly build debug networks across multi-cloud and multi-region servers and containers
Homelab enthusiasts — Encrypt and interconnect personal devices like NAS and Raspberry Pi into a private mesh
Security-focused enterprises — Replace legacy VPNs with zero-trust networking based on SSO and 2FA

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: 单文件开源实时后端，内置数据库、用户认证与管理后台
zh.what: PocketBase 是一个开源 Go 后端，将 SQLite 数据库、实时订阅、文件存储、用户认证和管理后台打包在一个可执行文件中。它让开发者无需部署和维护多个服务，就能快速启动包含后端的全栈项目。
zh.content: 仓库提供各平台预构建可执行文件、Go 框架源码与基础示例，以及官方 JavaScript 和 Dart SDK；预构建版本默认启用 JS VM 插件，允许通过 JavaScript 扩展后端逻辑。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 1.25+ 构建，内嵌 SQLite 并提供 REST-ish API；客户端通过 JavaScript（浏览器、Node.js、React Native）或 Dart（全平台）SDK 与后端交互。
zh.hot: 凭借「一个文件搞定后端」的极简理念，PocketBase 已积累近 6 万 Star，日增 37 星并登上 Go 语言日榜，成为个人开发者和快速原型场景中 Firebase 的热门轻量替代品。
uses: 个人开发者与独立黑客 —— 无需运维，单二进制文件即可部署上线全栈应用
移动/Web 原型团队 —— 借助 Dart/JS SDK 快速搭建带实时同步与文件存储的后端
追求成本可控的中小项目 —— 作为 Firebase 的自托管开源替代，减少云服务依赖

en.tag: Open-source realtime backend in a single file with embedded DB, auth and admin UI
en.what: PocketBase is an open-source Go backend that bundles an embedded SQLite database with realtime subscriptions, file storage, user authentication, and an admin dashboard into a single portable executable. It enables developers to bootstrap full-stack projects without deploying and managing multiple separate services.
en.content: The repository ships prebuilt executables for multiple platforms, the Go framework source code with base examples, plus official JavaScript and Dart SDKs; the prebuilt binary enables a JS VM plugin by default for extending backend logic with JavaScript.
en.stack: Built with Go 1.25+ around an embedded SQLite database and exposed through a REST-ish API; client interaction is handled via official JavaScript (Browser, Node.js, React Native) and Dart (Web, Mobile, Desktop, CLI) SDKs.

Cost-conscious small-to-medium projects — a self-hosted, open-source alternative to Firebase that reduces cloud vendor lock-in

zh.tag: 云存储的 rsync：跨平台文件同步与加密
zh.what: Rclone 是一个命令行程序，用于在不同云存储提供商之间同步文件和目录，支持 70+ 存储后端。它提供类似 rsync 的功能，包括加密、缓存、挂载等高级特性。

媒体服务器 —— 挂载云存储为本地磁盘，用于 Plex 等

zh.tag: 开源 Google Maps 数据抓取工具，支持 CLI/Web/REST

en.tag: Open-source Google Maps scraper with CLI, Web UI, and REST API
en.what: This is an open-source tool to scrape business data from Google Maps, extracting names, addresses, phone numbers, websites, ratings, review counts, coordinates, emails, and more. AI agent users: instruct agents in natural language to perform scraping tasks

zh.tag: 跨平台安全文件传输工具，支持端到端加密与断点续传
zh.what: croc 是一款命令行工具，可在任意两台计算机之间简单、安全地传输文件与文件夹。它基于 PAKE 协议实现端到端加密，无需配置本地服务器或端口转发，通过中继即可完成跨平台传输。支持断点续传、多文件传输、IPv6-first 及代理（如 Tor）等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、CLI 主程序、中继服务器实现，以及多平台安装脚本和 CI 配置。README 提供了详细的安装指南（涵盖 Homebrew、Scoop、Nix 等主流包管理器）和动态演示 GIF。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 PAKE 算法实现密钥交换，通过自定义中继协议传输数据，支持 IPv6/IPv4 双栈及 SOCKS5 代理（如 Tor）。
zh.hot: 凭借「开箱即用、安全无痛」的跨设备传输体验，croc 在开发者社区积累了 35.6K Star，本周再增 167 星并冲入 GitHub Go 周榜第 20 名。它填补了传统 scp/rsync 配置繁琐与即时传输工具缺乏加密之间的空白。
uses: 开发运维人员 —— 在不同服务器或本地与远程之间快速安全地传输配置文件与日志
跨平台协作团队 —— 在 Windows、macOS、Linux 同事之间即开即用地分享大文件或项目目录
隐私敏感用户 —— 借助端到端加密和 Tor 代理，在不信任网络中安全收发文件
命令行爱好者 —— 替代 scp/rsync，无需配置 SSH 或端口转发即可点对点传输

en.tag: Secure CLI tool for effortless cross-platform file transfers with encryption
en.what: croc is a CLI tool that lets any two computers simply and securely transfer files and folders. It uses PAKE for end-to-end encryption and works through a relay, eliminating the need for local servers or port forwarding. It supports resumable transfers, multiple files, IPv6-first with IPv4 fallback, and proxies like Tor.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go source code, CLI entry point, relay server implementation, and cross-platform install scripts with CI configs. The README includes detailed installation guides for Homebrew, Scoop, Nix, and more, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Go, it uses PAKE for key exchange, a custom relay protocol for data transfer, and supports IPv6/IPv4 dual-stack with SOCKS5 proxy support (e.g., Tor).
en.hot: With an out-of-the-box, pain-free cross-device transfer experience, croc has earned 35.6K stars, gaining 167 this week and hitting #20 on GitHub's Go Trending chart. It fills the gap between tedious scp/rsync setup and instant tools that lack encryption.
uses: DevOps/Developers —— quickly and securely transfer configs and logs between servers or local and remote machines
Cross-platform teams —— instantly share large files or project folders across Windows, macOS, and Linux colleagues
Privacy-conscious users —— send files securely over untrusted networks using end-to-end encryption and Tor proxy support
CLI power users —— replace scp/rsync without needing SSH setup or port forwarding for ad-hoc transfers

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的安全组网与访问控制平台
zh.what: NetBird 是一个开源的零配置点对点组网平台，基于 WireGuard 创建加密的覆盖网络，自动连接设备，无需开放端口或配置复杂防火墙。它还提供集中的访问控制系统，支持 SSO、MFA 和细粒度访问策略，适用于组织或家庭网络。

uses: 希望替代传统 VPN 的团队，快速搭建安全的远程访问网络
需要细粒度访问控制和安全组网的个人开发者或家庭用户
对 AI 代理安全访问 LLM API 和私有资源感兴趣的技术团队

en.tag: Secure WireGuard-based overlay network with SSO, MFA and access controls

It also offers centralized access control with SSO, MFA, and granular policies, suitable for organizations or home networks.
en.content: The repository contains core components: client, server, admin web UI (dashboard), public API, and an optional AI Agent Network (Beta) module for identity-aware access control for AI agents.

Individual developers or home users needing granular access control and secure networking
Technical teams interested in secure access for AI agents to LLM APIs and private resources

en.tag: Daemonless container and pod management tool

zh.tag: 极致美观的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态平铺的 Wayland 合成器，注重外观而不牺牲功能。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性、丰富的视觉效果（渐变边框、模糊、动画、阴影等）、强大的插件系统、内置插件管理器、撕裂支持（提升游戏性能）等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hyprland 合成器的完整源代码、文档链接、安装指南、配置示例和画廊展示。代码库以 C++ 编写，易于扩展和阅读。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，不依赖 wlroots、libweston、kwin 或 mutter，完全独立实现。依赖 Wayland 协议和相关库。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，Hyprland 在 Linux 桌面用户中广受欢迎，Star 数达 36,817，今日新增 24，持续活跃开发。
uses: Linux 桌面用户 —— 追求美观、高效、可定制的平铺窗口管理体验
Wayland 爱好者 —— 希望体验最新 Wayland 特性的用户
开发者 —— 对合成器实现感兴趣，或希望为其开发插件的开发者

en.tag: A highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with stunning visuals
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It offers the latest Wayland features, extensive eye candy (gradient borders, blur, animations, shadows), a powerful plugin system, built-in plugin manager, tearing support for better gaming performance, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Hyprland compositor, documentation links, installation guides, configuration examples, and a gallery. The codebase is written in C++ and is designed to be easily expandable and readable.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, Hyprland is fully independent and does not rely on wlroots, libweston, kwin, or mutter. It depends on Wayland protocols and related libraries.
en.hot: With its stunning visuals and high customizability, Hyprland has gained immense popularity among Linux desktop users, amassing 36,817 stars (24 new today) and maintaining active development.
uses: Linux desktop users — seeking a beautiful, efficient, and customizable tiling window management experience
Wayland enthusiasts — users wanting to experience the latest Wayland features
Developers — interested in compositor implementation or developing plugins for Hyprland

zh.tag: 低延迟语音 AI 工具包，构建实时语音代理
zh.what: Moonshine Voice 是一个开源 AI 工具包，用于构建实时语音代理和界面。它提供语音转文本、意图识别和文本转语音功能，所有处理均在设备端完成，确保低延迟和隐私保护。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、预训练模型、跨平台示例应用（iOS、Android、macOS、Windows、Raspberry Pi 等）以及微控制器部署支持。提供高级 API 用于转录、TTS、语音克隆、说话人识别和对话代理。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，支持 Python、iOS、Android、macOS、Linux、Windows 等多平台。模型基于 PyTorch 训练，推理使用 ONNX Runtime 或自定义引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借极低延迟（优于 Whisper）和完全本地运行的特点，吸引了近万 Star，今日新增 282，适合隐私敏感和实时场景。
uses: 语音助手开发者 —— 快速集成低延迟 STT/TTS 到应用中
边缘设备开发者 —— 在 Raspberry Pi、微控制器上部署语音 AI
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、金融等需要本地处理的语音应用
多语言语音应用 —— 支持中英西日韩等多语种 STT 和 TTS

en.tag: Low-latency speech AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents
en.what: Moonshine Voice is an open-source AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents and interfaces. It offers speech-to-text, intent recognition, and text-to-speech, all running on-device for low latency and privacy.
en.content: The repo includes the core library, pre-trained models, cross-platform example apps (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Raspberry Pi, etc.), and microcontroller deployment support. High-level APIs for transcription, TTS, voice cloning, speaker diarization, and conversational agents.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with bindings for Python, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, Windows. Models trained with PyTorch, inference via ONNX Runtime or custom engine.
en.hot: With ultra-low latency (outperforming Whisper) and fully on-device processing, it has gained nearly 10K stars (+282 today), appealing to privacy-conscious and real-time applications.
uses: Voice assistant developers — integrate low-latency STT/TTS into apps
Edge device developers — deploy voice AI on Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers
Privacy-sensitive scenarios — medical, finance requiring on-device processing
Multilingual voice apps — STT/TTS supporting English, Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, etc.

zh.tag: 微软官方 Windows 终端与命令行宿主开源仓库

开发者：学习微软大型 C++ 项目架构与 Windows 控制台实现

en.tag: Microsoft's official open-source repo for Windows Terminal and console host
en.what: This is Microsoft's official source repository for Windows Terminal and the Windows console host. It contains the implementation of Windows Terminal, Windows Terminal Preview, and conhost.exe, along with shared components and sample projects.

zh.tag: 自建 VPN 的开源客户端，支持多协议与混淆
zh.what: Amnezia VPN 是一个开源 VPN 客户端，允许用户在自己的服务器上轻松部署 VPN 服务。它支持多种经典协议（如 OpenVPN、WireGuard、IKEv2）以及带流量混淆的协议（如 Cloak、Shadowsocks、AmneziaWG、XRay），并提供分流功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端和移动端的客户端代码，提供安装脚本、文档和界面资源。主要目录包括客户端应用、协议实现、以及用于服务器部署的 Docker 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，跨平台支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。依赖 Qt 框架、OpenSSL、以及各 VPN 协议库（如 WireGuard、OpenVPN）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1606 星，总星数达 1.4 万+，因其自建 VPN 的易用性和强大的混淆功能而受到关注，尤其适合网络受限地区的用户。
uses: 需要自建 VPN 的个人用户，希望快速部署并连接自己的服务器。
在严格网络环境下需要绕过封锁的用户，利用混淆协议隐藏流量特征。
开发者和技术爱好者，希望定制或贡献 VPN 客户端代码。
企业或组织需要内部安全远程访问，可基于此客户端搭建专属 VPN。

en.tag: Open-source VPN client for self-hosted servers with multi-protocol & obfuscation
en.what: Amnezia VPN is an open-source VPN client that lets users easily deploy VPN servers on their own machines. It supports classic protocols like OpenVPN, WireGuard, IKEv2, and obfuscated protocols such as Cloak, Shadowsocks, AmneziaWG, and XRay, plus split tunneling.
en.content: The repo contains client code for desktop and mobile, with installation scripts, docs, and UI assets. Key directories include client apps, protocol implementations, and Docker configs for server deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Uses Qt framework, OpenSSL, and VPN protocol libraries like WireGuard and OpenVPN.
en.hot: Gained 1,606 stars this month, reaching 14k+ total, due to its ease of self-hosting VPN and robust obfuscation features, appealing to users in restricted regions.
uses: Individuals wanting to self-host VPN and quickly deploy on their own servers.
Users in censored networks needing to bypass blocks with obfuscation protocols.
Developers and tinkerers looking to customize or contribute to VPN client code.
Organizations requiring secure remote access, can build custom VPN on this client.

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.

AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 开源统一XDR与SIEM安全平台，保护端点与云负载
zh.what: Wazuh是一个免费开源的安全平台，用于威胁预防、检测和响应。它由部署在监控系统上的端点安全代理和收集分析代理数据的管理服务器组成，并已与Elastic Stack集成，提供搜索和数据可视化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含Wazuh的核心组件，包括代理（agent）、管理服务器（manager）、规则集、文档和安装脚本。支持入侵检测、日志分析、文件完整性监控和漏洞检测等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++编写，依赖Elastic Stack（Elasticsearch、Kibana）进行数据存储和可视化，支持跨平台部署（Linux、Windows、macOS等）。
zh.hot: 本月新增431星，总星数达16485，位列C++趋势榜第25。作为开源安全平台的代表，其统一XDR和SIEM能力受到广泛关注。
uses: 安全运维团队：用于集中监控和管理企业安全事件，实现威胁检测与响应。
合规审计人员：利用文件完整性监控和日志分析满足PCI DSS等合规要求。
云原生环境：保护容器和云工作负载，集成威胁情报识别风险。
开源爱好者：学习大型C++安全项目架构和实现。

en.tag: Open-source unified XDR and SIEM platform for endpoint and cloud workload protection
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open-source security platform for threat prevention, detection, and response. It consists of an endpoint security agent deployed on monitored systems and a management server that collects and analyzes agent data, fully integrated with the Elastic Stack for search and visualization.
en.content: The repository contains core components of Wazuh, including agents, manager, rulesets, documentation, and installation scripts. It supports intrusion detection, log analysis, file integrity monitoring, and vulnerability detection.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) for data storage and visualization, and supports cross-platform deployment (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.).
en.hot: With 431 stars added this month and a total of 16,485, it ranks 25th on the C++ trending list. As a leading open-source security platform, its unified XDR and SIEM capabilities attract significant attention.
uses: Security operations teams: for centralized monitoring and management of security events, enabling threat detection and response.
Compliance auditors: leveraging file integrity monitoring and log analysis to meet regulatory requirements like PCI DSS.
Cloud-native environments: protecting containers and cloud workloads with integrated threat intelligence.
Open-source enthusiasts: learning the architecture and implementation of a large-scale C++ security project.

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为实时生成分析数据报告而设计。它能够对海量数据进行极速查询，支持 SQL 接口，适用于在线分析处理（OLAP）场景。

zh.hot: ClickHouse 因其极致的查询性能和实时分析能力而广受欢迎，拥有 48k+ Stars，本周新增 159 Stars，在 C++ 周榜排名第 15。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 构建实时 OLAP 数据管道和仪表盘
DevOps/SRE —— 监控和可观测性数据存储与查询
数据分析师 —— 对海量数据进行交互式探索分析
产品经理 —— 了解用户行为分析场景下的技术选型

en.tag: Real-time analytics column-oriented database management system
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system designed for real-time generation of analytical data reports. It enables blazing-fast queries on massive datasets, supports SQL interface, and is suitable for online analytical processing (OLAP) scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, and documentation for the ClickHouse database. It provides installation methods for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and offers rich community resources such as tutorials, documentation, videos, and Slack groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on LLVM, libcxx, zlib-ng, and other low-level libraries, supporting multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: ClickHouse is widely popular for its extreme query performance and real-time analytics capabilities, with over 48k Stars and 159 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly trending list.

DevOps/SRE — storing and querying monitoring and observability data
Data analysts — interactive exploration and analysis of massive datasets
Product managers — understanding technical choices for user behavior analytics

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。

zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。

mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).

en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 开源软件KVM，一套键鼠控制多台电脑
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键鼠共享应用，让你用一台电脑的键盘、鼠标或触控板控制附近的其他电脑，实现无缝协作。它相当于软件 KVM（不含视频），默认启用 TLS 加密，支持 Wayland 和剪贴板共享。

zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，跨平台支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。依赖包括 TLS 加密库、Wayland 协议支持，以及各平台的 GUI 框架。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有 27,974 颗星，本月新增 798 颗，位列 C++ 月榜第 20 名。其热度源于对经典工具 synergy 的延续，以及免费开源、功能完善（如 TLS、Wayland）的特点，吸引了大量多设备用户。

开发者/运维：管理多台服务器或开发机，无需切换外设
跨平台用户：在 Windows、macOS、Linux 之间无缝共享键鼠

en.tag: Open-source software KVM to share one keyboard/mouse across computers
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open-source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control nearby computers using one computer's keyboard, mouse, or trackpad, enabling seamless workflow. It acts as a software KVM (without video), with TLS encryption enabled by default, Wayland support, and clipboard sharing.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation (README, Wiki links), and packages for stable and continuous releases. It also hosts community discussion channels on Matrix and IRC.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Dependencies include TLS libraries, Wayland protocol support, and platform-specific GUI frameworks.
en.hot: With 27,974 stars and 798 added this month, ranking #20 in the C++ monthly trending, its popularity stems from being a continuation of the classic synergy tool, offering a free, open-source, feature-rich solution (TLS, Wayland) that appeals to multi-device users.
uses: Multi-computer office users: control multiple machines from one keyboard/mouse for efficiency
Developers/ops: manage servers or dev machines without switching peripherals
Cross-platform users: share keyboard/mouse seamlessly between Windows, macOS, Linux
Open-source enthusiasts: looking for a free alternative to commercial KVM or legacy synergy

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码，包括核心引擎、CLI 客户端、Python/R/Java/Wasm 等客户端绑定，以及文档和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 Python、R、Java、Wasm 等客户端，并与 pandas、dplyr 等深度集成。
zh.hot: DuckDB 因其嵌入式分析数据库的独特定位而广受欢迎，star 数已超 4 万，本月新增 908，在 C++ 月榜中位列第 15。
uses: 数据科学家：在本地快速分析大型 CSV/Parquet 文件，无需部署数据库服务器
数据分析师：使用 SQL 直接查询数据文件，简化工作流程
应用开发者：将 DuckDB 嵌入应用中，提供分析功能，无需外部数据库

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database for fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of DuckDB, including the core engine, CLI client, client bindings for Python/R/Java/Wasm, as well as documentation and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, supports clients for Python, R, Java, Wasm, and integrates deeply with pandas and dplyr.
en.hot: DuckDB is popular for its unique positioning as an embedded analytical database, with over 40k stars and 908 added this month, ranking 15th in the C++ monthly list.
uses: Data scientists: quickly analyze large CSV/Parquet files locally without deploying a database server
Data analysts: use SQL to directly query data files, simplifying workflow
Application developers: embed DuckDB in applications to provide analytical capabilities without an external database

zh.tag: 开源免费的三维参数化建模软件
zh.what: FreeCAD 是一款免费开源的跨平台三维参数化建模软件，主要用于设计真实物体。它支持参数化建模，允许用户通过修改历史参数来轻松调整设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 FreeCAD 的完整源代码，涵盖核心建模模块、图形界面、Python API 以及文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖 OpenCASCADE 几何内核、Coin3D 3D 场景库、Qt 图形界面，并提供 Python API。
zh.hot: FreeCAD 是开源 CAD 领域的明星项目，拥有超过 3.2 万 star，持续活跃，今日新增 23 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 15 名。
uses: 产品设计师和机械工程师，用于参数化建模和设计验证。
建筑师和建筑爱好者，用于建筑信息建模和设计。
学生和教师，用于学习 CAD 和三维建模。
程序员和开发者，利用 Python API 进行二次开发和自动化。

en.tag: Open-source parametric 3D modeler for real-life objects
en.what: FreeCAD is a free and open-source cross-platform parametric 3D modeler primarily for designing real-life objects. It supports parametric modeling, allowing users to easily modify designs by changing parameters in the model history.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of FreeCAD, including core modeling modules, GUI, Python API, and documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Developed in C++, relies on OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, Coin3D 3D scene library, Qt GUI, and offers a Python API.
en.hot: FreeCAD is a star project in the open-source CAD domain with over 32k stars, consistently active, gaining 23 stars today and ranking 15th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Product designers and mechanical engineers for parametric modeling and design validation.
Architects and architecture enthusiasts for BIM and design.
Students and teachers for learning CAD and 3D modeling.
Programmers and developers for customization and automation via Python API.

zh.tag: 以 KVCache 为核心的 LLM 服务分离式架构平台
zh.what: Mooncake 是 Moonshot AI 为其 Kimi 大模型服务打造的 serving 平台，采用以 KVCache 为中心的分离式架构，将预填充（prefill）与解码（decode）阶段解耦，以提升吞吐和资源利用率。它通过分布式 KVCache 池和高效传输引擎，实现高并发、低延迟的 LLM 推理服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的 C++ 实现、Python 传输引擎（mooncake-transfer-engine）、FAST25 论文及幻灯片、真实负载 traces、文档和 Docker 镜像。项目还提供多种 PyPI 包，支持 CUDA、NPU、MUSA 等不同硬件环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，并配套 Python 传输引擎；依赖 CUDA、RDMA（如 EFA）等高性能网络技术，支持多种加速硬件（CUDA、NPU、MUSA）。
zh.hot: 作为 Kimi 背后的 serving 平台，Mooncake 在 FAST25 发表论文并开源，凭借其创新的 KVCache 分离式架构和实际生产验证，迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增 445 stars，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: LLM 服务提供商：希望借鉴 Kimi 的生产级 serving 架构，优化推理性能与成本。
系统研究者：研究分离式架构、KVCache 管理或高性能网络传输的学者。
AI 基础设施工程师：需要部署或优化大规模 LLM 推理服务的工程师。

en.tag: A KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture platform for LLM serving
en.what: Mooncake is the serving platform for Kimi, Moonshot AI's leading LLM service. It uses a KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates prefill and decode phases to improve throughput and resource utilization. With a distributed KVCache pool and efficient transfer engine, it enables high-concurrency, low-latency LLM inference.
en.content: The repository includes core C++ implementation, Python transfer engine (mooncake-transfer-engine), FAST25 paper and slides, real-world traces, documentation, and Docker images. It also provides multiple PyPI packages supporting CUDA, NPU, MUSA, and other hardware environments.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with a Python transfer engine; relies on high-performance networking like CUDA and RDMA (e.g., EFA), supporting various accelerators (CUDA, NPU, MUSA).
en.hot: As the serving platform behind Kimi, Mooncake published a paper at FAST25 and open-sourced it. Its innovative KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture and proven production deployment quickly attracted developers, gaining 445 stars this month and ranking on the C++ trending list.
uses: LLM service providers: looking to adopt Kimi's production-grade serving architecture to optimize inference performance and cost.
Systems researchers: studying disaggregated architectures, KVCache management, or high-performance network transfer.
AI infrastructure engineers: needing to deploy or optimize large-scale LLM inference services.

zh.tag: 回合制末日生存游戏，开放世界与深度模拟
zh.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead 是一款设定在末日后的回合制生存游戏。玩家需要在严酷、持久且程序生成的世界中挣扎求生，搜刮物资、对抗各种怪物，并与其他幸存者竞争。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的游戏源代码、文档、构建配置和示例截图。游戏支持多种平台，提供稳定版和实验版下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 SDL 和 ncurses 库，支持跨平台构建（Linux、macOS、Windows、BSD）。
zh.hot: 作为一款经典开源生存游戏，拥有 12.9k 星标，本月新增 341 星，长期活跃的开发社区和深度玩法持续吸引玩家。
uses: 喜欢深度模拟和复杂机制的生存游戏玩家
对开源游戏开发和 C++ 编程感兴趣的开发者
希望体验高自由度、程序生成世界的玩家

en.tag: Turn-based post-apocalyptic survival game with deep simulation
en.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is a turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players struggle to survive in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated world, scavenging for supplies, fighting monsters, and competing with other survivors.
en.content: The repository contains the full game source code, documentation, build configurations, and sample screenshots. The game supports multiple platforms with stable and experimental releases.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on SDL and ncurses libraries, with cross-platform build support for Linux, macOS, Windows, and BSD.
en.hot: As a classic open-source survival game, it has 12.9k stars with 341 added this month, and its long-active development community and deep gameplay continue to attract players.
uses: Players who enjoy deep simulation and complex mechanics in survival games
Developers interested in open-source game development and C++ programming
Players seeking high freedom and procedurally generated worlds

zh.tag: 开源离网 LoRa 网状通信设备固件
zh.what: Meshtastic 固件是开源离网网状通信系统的官方设备固件，利用 LoRa 技术实现长距离、低功耗的通信，不依赖互联网或蜂窝网络。它支持文本消息、位置共享和遥测功能，适用于户外探险、应急准备和远程操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源代码、构建和刷写说明、文档链接以及社区贡献指南。支持多种硬件平台，如 ESP32、nRF52、RP2040/RP2350 和基于 Linux 的设备。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 PlatformIO 和 Arduino 框架，支持多种微控制器架构。
zh.hot: 随着对离网通信和应急准备需求的增长，Meshtastic 项目持续受到关注，本月新增 207 颗星，总星数达 8086，反映出社区活跃度和项目实用性。
uses: 户外爱好者：在无信号区域进行团队通信和位置共享。
应急响应人员：在灾难导致通信中断时建立临时通信网络。
技术爱好者：学习和定制 LoRa 网状网络固件。
远程作业团队：在偏远地区进行遥测数据传输。

en.tag: Open-source firmware for off-grid LoRa mesh communication devices
en.what: The Meshtastic firmware is the official device firmware for an open-source, off-grid mesh communication system, using LoRa technology for long-range, low-power communication without internet or cellular infrastructure. It enables text messaging, location sharing, and telemetry, ideal for outdoor adventures, emergency preparedness, and remote operations.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, build and flashing instructions, documentation links, and community contribution guidelines. It supports multiple hardware platforms including ESP32, nRF52, RP2040/RP2350, and Linux-based devices.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it relies on PlatformIO and Arduino frameworks, supporting multiple microcontroller architectures.
en.hot: With growing interest in off-grid communication and emergency preparedness, Meshtastic continues to gain attention, adding 207 stars this month to reach 8086 total, reflecting active community and practical utility.
uses: Outdoor enthusiasts: team communication and location sharing in no-signal areas.
Emergency responders: establishing temporary communication networks when infrastructure fails.
Tech hobbyists: learning and customizing LoRa mesh network firmware.
Remote operations teams: transmitting telemetry data in remote areas.

zh.tag: 跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器，已可运行 Bloodborne 等独占大作
zh.what: shadPS4 是一款使用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上运行 PS4 游戏。目前它已能成功启动并运行《血源诅咒》《如龙0》等热门独占作品，尽管仍处于开发初期，尚未达到完美体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、图形/音频后端、指令翻译模块及系统服务实现，同时提供文档、兼容性列表与截图。用户可搭配独立的 QtLauncher 获得完整的图形界面体验。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，利用 Vulkan 等图形 API 实现 GPU 指令转译与渲染，跨平台兼容 Windows、Linux 与 macOS。
zh.hot: 凭借已能运行《血源诅咒》等 PS4 独占 3A 大作的突破性进展，该项目吸引了大量玩家与开发者关注，本周新增 332 Star 并累积至 32K+，跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 硬核主机玩家 —— 想在 PC 或 Mac 上体验 PS4 独占大作。
模拟器开发者 —— 研究 PS4 系统架构、图形渲染与指令转译技术。
开源贡献者 —— 参与兼容性测试、漏洞修复与性能优化。
游戏研究者 —— 分析 PS4 游戏运行原理与系统调用实现。

en.tag: Cross-platform PS4 emulator already running exclusives like Bloodborne
en.what: shadPS4 is an early-stage PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++, enabling users to run PS4 titles on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It can already boot and play popular exclusives such as Bloodborne and Yakuza 0, though it remains a work in progress with known issues.
en.content: The repository houses the emulator core, graphics/audio backends, instruction translation modules, and system service implementations, along with documentation, compatibility lists, and screenshots. Users can pair it with the separate QtLauncher for a full GUI experience.
en.stack: Built primarily in C++, it leverages Vulkan and other graphics APIs to translate and render GPU instructions, with cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: Its breakthrough ability to run PS4 exclusives like Bloodborne has drawn massive attention from gamers and developers, earning 332 new stars this week for a total of 32K+ and placing it 16th on GitHub's C++ Trending chart.
uses: Hardcore console gamers who want to play PS4 exclusives on PC or Mac.
Emulator developers studying PS4 system architecture, graphics rendering, and instruction translation.
Open-source contributors helping with compatibility testing, bug fixes, and performance optimization.
Game researchers analyzing PS4 game execution principles and system call implementations.

zh.tag: 本地 AI 服务器，让 GPU/NPU 跑起云端级模型
zh.what: Lemonade 是一个本地 AI 服务器，提供与云端 API 相同的功能，但完全免费且保护隐私。它支持在用户的 NPU 和 GPU 上运行最新的聊天、编程、语音和图像生成模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lemonade Server（可连接数百个应用的服务）和 Embeddable Lemonade（可嵌入到应用中的便携二进制文件），并提供模型管理器、内置聊天/图像/语音界面以及移动端应用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，针对 AMD Ryzen AI、Radeon 和 Strix Halo PC 进行了优化，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Docker。
zh.hot: 凭借 5.3k+ 星标和月增 475 星，Lemonade 因提供免费、私密的本地 AI 体验而受到关注，尤其吸引希望在自有硬件上运行先进模型的开发者。
uses: 希望在不依赖云端的情况下使用 AI 聊天、编程助手的个人用户
需要在应用中集成本地多模态 AI 的开发者
关注隐私保护、希望数据不出本机的企业或团队
AMD 硬件用户，希望充分利用 Ryzen AI 和 Radeon 性能

en.tag: Local AI server to run cloud-grade models on your own GPU/NPU
en.what: Lemonade is a local AI server that provides the same capabilities as cloud APIs, but 100% free and private. It runs the latest models for chat, coding, speech, and image generation on your own NPU and GPU.
en.content: The repo includes Lemonade Server (a service connectable to hundreds of apps) and Embeddable Lemonade (a portable binary for embedding into apps), plus a model manager, built-in chat/image/speech interfaces, and mobile apps.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, optimized for AMD Ryzen AI, Radeon, and Strix Halo PCs, with support for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Docker.
en.hot: With 5.3k+ stars and +475 this month, Lemonade is gaining traction for offering a free, private local AI experience, especially appealing to developers who want to run advanced models on their own hardware.
uses: Individuals wanting AI chat/coding assistants without cloud dependency
Developers needing to embed local multimodal AI into their apps
Privacy-conscious enterprises/teams keeping data on-premises
AMD hardware users maximizing Ryzen AI and Radeon performance

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是微软开源的机器学习推理与训练加速引擎，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn 等经典 ML 库导出的模型。它通过图优化和硬件加速器利用，在不同设备上提供最佳性能，并支持多节点 GPU 训练加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ONNX Runtime 源码、文档、示例和发布信息，涵盖推理与训练两大模块，并提供多种执行提供程序（如 QNN）的插件支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种硬件和操作系统，依赖 ONNX 格式，并集成 CUDA、TensorRT 等加速库。
zh.hot: 作为 AI 推理的关键基础设施，ONNX Runtime 持续获得开发者关注，今日新增 11 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 10，其稳定性和跨框架支持是长期热度所在。
uses: 需要跨平台部署模型的 AI 工程师，可加速推理并降低成本
使用 PyTorch 训练 Transformer 模型的研究者，可一键加速多节点 GPU 训练
在边缘设备或异构硬件上运行模型的开发者，利用硬件加速器优化性能
希望统一不同框架模型推理流程的团队，通过 ONNX 格式实现互操作

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is Microsoft's open-source ML inference and training acceleration engine, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow, as well as classical ML libraries. It leverages graph optimizations and hardware accelerators to deliver optimal performance across devices, and accelerates multi-node GPU training for transformer models.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, docs, examples, and release info for ONNX Runtime, covering both inference and training modules, with plugin support for various execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports multiple hardware and OS, depends on ONNX format, and integrates acceleration libraries like CUDA and TensorRT.
en.hot: As key infrastructure for AI inference, ONNX Runtime maintains steady developer interest, gaining 11 stars today and ranking #10 on the C++ daily trending list, with its stability and cross-framework support driving long-term popularity.
uses: AI engineers deploying models cross-platform with faster inference and lower costs
Researchers training transformer models in PyTorch, accelerating multi-node GPU training with one line
Developers running models on edge or heterogeneous hardware, leveraging hardware accelerators
Teams unifying inference across frameworks via ONNX format for interoperability

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个广受欢迎的头文件优先 JSON 库，为 C++ 开发者提供直观、STL 风格的 API 来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它支持将 JSON 与 C++ 数据结构无缝互转，大幅降低了现代 C++ 项目中处理 JSON 的复杂度。
zh.content: 仓库以单头文件（json.hpp）为核心分发形态，同时包含完整的测试套件、基准测试、文档网站源码及多包管理器（Conan、vcpkg 等）支持配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 后端/客户端开发者需要轻量、高性能 JSON 解析与序列化
嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing
